tei:div.tei:p: bya::ba 'gu/ //shā chi/hā sbya mu:/(sbya 085305 000ji 'ang 5055'acu 7 bci kho migaX 507 khor
r+sha nga — — —deng zhe saX /4 bye po shās —— 497 nga dzī lho dzo/4)ske'i kyi stsol snga4tswaḥsgodzo byedzi ༷'i pho go/dro tshwa pho tsho
r+sha nga — — —deng zhe saX /4 bye po shās —— 497 nga dzī lho dzo/4)ske'i kyi stsol snga4tswaḥsgodzo byedzi ༷'i pho go/dro tshwa pho tsho
thub bstan e waṃ dpo tshogs/༄༄/ /shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad bzhugs so/ /rje btsun tā ra nā thas mdzad/deb dang po/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /

stol norardzo rdzog ༷ wadhe ༷ kadro//gyi/4471—rdzo ge ri ༷) sna/dziX ༷ rnga (li rmi zer 〉 rdo7zhe ri tshoni k+shi+o rngo// rlo ba 4tswa rtser ——— rtse dzo r+shalames nga0 ji ༷༷paX depo ༄ ༄ ༄༄ sa rab rkam 'i rwa tho zlo snge la pho 79 na——da —rjor+shanaswā shā rku li r+shasde dri— /shirwa spyo 0rjo —23— — rdeldo rdzis

rdo te/ to ge 7༄ rdo ༷ kā 〉〈sna — ————3ོ༷༷ rdzotre+o ༷ ngo (wa)/—ru sde〈 4 81 khriXrdo ri ci kyi //riX pa༄rdo sbye bye3 ༷༷ wa/| /phrophro hūṃ bye〉 /du shī dge(789༷ bo rmi dzi—— tsho bye ༷dz+ra da lta'i ston pa shākya thub/ chos sku rgyal bayum r+pā mo/cha44ཿdhe phro rngo sdeXske ri44444 snyetso'i dzom4444sngosalge d+ku 4226444mi zlokhye'ur+sā skerdo rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i phyag bris/

kun mkhyen tā ra nā tha'i rtogs brjod nyung ngu /mkhyen pa'i cha shas res kyang chos kun gzigs/ /gsung dbyangs gcig gis rab 'byams chos sgra sgrogs/ /sku gcig nyid kyang sna tshogs zlos gar can/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba shākya seng ger 'dud/ /mkhas mang snga phyi'i rgol ba'i dkyil 'khor las/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i thal skad sgrogs pa can/ /gangs can tshad ma'i ston pa dol po ba/rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rnam thar rjes su dran/ /'phags yul paṇa thub bye ba'i blo gros kyang /gang gi mkhyen pa'i rlabs la 'gran min zhing / /gsang chen bstan la zla med phyag rjes can/ /dkyil 'khor bdag nyid sgrol ba'i mgon po rgyal/ /gang gis gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul rol mo'i gdangs/ /gang gis thos 'dzin lhung ba'i skal bzang phyir/ /gang dag bdag blo'i yul las ches 'gongs kyang / /gang shes brjod 'dis gzur gnas spro ba skyed/ /de yang thub bstan 'dzin pa'i gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yongs su grags pa'i dbu ma la rang stong dang gzhan stong gnyis las/ phyi ma'i ring lu/sa

chen po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad sgrub kyi shing rta ba bla na med pa rgyal ba jo nang pa zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid rtser g.yo ba'i bdag nyid kyi gdan rabs nges don bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan rgyal ba'i zin kun mkhyen chen po tā ra nā tha'am rje btsun chen po kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mchog gi rnam thar rags rim zhig ngo sprod pa la dad ldan rnams kyis cung 'ig gsan par mdzod/ de yang bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi ya gyal rdo rje g.yu sgron pa'i gnas kha rag 'brang bya ba'i phu sngon rwa lo'i brgyud pa rim phebs kyi bzhugs gnas phyis chos 'khor sdings su grags/ deng gi dus gong dkar rdzong dang rin spungs rdzong gi sa cha 'brel mtshams su gnas/yab rwa lo'i gdung rgyud rnam rgyal phun tshogs dang yum rdo rje bu dga' lha mo gnyis kyi sras su rab byung bcu pa'i bgrang bya dgu pa shing mo phag (spyi lo 1575lo )gi chu stod zla 6tshes 8kyi nyi shar la grod pu 'ja' tshon lnga ldan gyi nang sku bltams/ de yang kha phye ma thag khye'u sku la sha mtshan khrag gi thig le li khri'i tshangs skud kyi rnam pa can/ phyag zhabs la 'khor lo dang sku la gur gum gyi dri ngan ldan pa/ spyan gyis phyogs kun gzigs bzhin zhal nas sum bha ni'i sngags lan gsum brjod pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung / mtshan la pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes gsol/ yi dam lha'i zhal dang /zhing khams kyi snang ba du ma gzigs/ smra shes tsam nas nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes yang yang gsungs/ sku tshe sngon ma'i sbyin bdag grwa rigs lha cha rten gsum nye gnas dpal 'byor gyis zhabs phyi bgyis pa sogs gsal bar gsungs pas kun ngo mtshar bskyed/ 'on kyang gsang thabs kyis sku bskyed bsrings/ nyin zhig sku 'khor lhan rgyas nang du gsol ba mdzad ma~Xs gang byung cha med par rnal 'byor ba sku sha sngo sang nge ba sku la nus rgyan

dang stag sham gsol ba mi thod rlon pa thogs pa ral pa'i cod pan can zhig byon par gzhan kun skrag kyang rje nyid dgyes shing de la phyag 'tshal te gsung gling yang gnang / des kyang rnam 'joms kyi khrus dang phur bu zhig gnang /phur bu de slob dpon pad+mas jo mo ma dgon mtsho rgyal la gnang / des sna nam bdud 'joms la gnang / des bsam yas su gter du sbas/ phyis rje g.yung ston pas bton lugs sogs rgyas par gsungs nas phyir gshegs so/ phur bu de da lta mdo smad jo nang pa'i chos sde chen po 'dzam thang bsam grub nor bu'i gling du bzhugs/ dgung lo bzhi la lon skabs sde pa sna dkar rtse bas bskul ma dang 'brel mkhan lung rigs rgya mtshor mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang rje gong ma'i lung bstan shogs khra sogs ches mthun pas rgyal rtse nas mkhan nyid kyis gtsos byang bdag bkra shes stobs rgyal sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ rje kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid du mnga' gsol te chos lung byang rtser khri 'don mdzad/ rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgor rje gong ma'i bu chen rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang /thugs sras lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun thub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs mdo dbus khams gsum gyi bla chen mang du phebs/ dgung lo brgyad bzhes skabs stag lung pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan las rab tu byung / mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ sprul pa'i bshes gnyen rgya gar ba dza la nā tha mchog gis mtshan tā ra nā tha zhes su bstsal ba'i gzigs snang byung/mkhas mchog byams pa lhun grub sogs kyis gtsos jo nang dang / sa skya/shangs pa/ bu lugs/ 'brug pa/ kum tshang / stag lung / 'bri gung sogs kyi bla chen mang du bsten/ dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa na mkhan 'asnyil

'dzin kun dga' rgyal mtshan sogs mkhan slob grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ rgya gar grub chen sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po las rgyud sde'i dbang dang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan te sngags bla med kyi gzhung la bod 'dir sngon med kyi blo skyed lnga brgya tsam byung bar rje nyid kyis gsungs shing / rgya gar gyi slob dpon paṇ+ḍi ta kri dang paṇ+ḍi ta ta la lha dra sogs las zab chos mang po dang sgra sogs phyi nang gi rig gnas mtha' yas pa gsan bsam mdzad de mkhas pa'i rtser son zhing rje nyid kyis brtsams pa'i sgra mdo dbyangs can ma'i 'grel pa sogs bod kyi sgra rig pa'i gzhung kun gyi nang nas ches phul du byung ba zhig yin la kun gyis tshad mar 'dzin/ rgya gar gyi grub chen bod yul du chos zhu bar phebs te bla mar bkur ba ni rje 'di kho na'o/'phags yul gyi skad rigs kun chung ngu nas rang shes su yod par gsungs/dgung lo nyer gcig skabs jo nang ri khrod du gdan sa mdzad/ jo nang dus khrid chen mo btsugs te chos khrid rgyas par gnang ba'i skabs kun mkhyen chen po'i zhal gzigs te nges don bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol/ sngags kyi sa bcu gsum 'di skor du bsgrod zin par gsang rnam du gsungs/dgung grangs nyer drug skabs stag lung sogs dbus phyogs su phebs skabs rwa sgrong du rgya dpe gzigs pa na gshin rje dgra nag gi rgyud skad gnyis kyis smra ba'i spobs pa che zhing shugs myur bas kun ngo mtshar skyes te bsngags brjod mdzad/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi jo bo'i sku gzugs la zhal gser dang nam bza' sgron pa dang 'brel kun mkhyen chen po nga 'dra mar zhal gser dang nam bza' sgron pa'i dus gsung 'byon zhing smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho zhes pa de btsams/ ra mo che'i dar po che btsugs/ dgung lo zhe gcig par gtsang sde /da phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang lha 'bangs sogs phul la

brten nas (1615lo)rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal zhes bya ba'i gnas gzhi gsar bzhings mdzad pa sogs bshad sgrub las rkogasum gyi bstan la phyag bzhes 'gran zla dang bral bar mdzad mthar dus rabs 'di'i nang rje btsun tā ra nā zhes kun gyis bsngags par gyur/ ma zad sog yul du bstan pa mang du spel bas bka' shangs pa rnying ma dge ldan rnams kyi bstan pa la phan pa cher gnang ba rje'i rang rnam du gsal lo/dgung lo re gcig pa bod rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag lo'i hor zla 2tshes 28la gzugs sku mya ngan las 'das/ rje nyid kyi 'phrin las skyong ba'i slob ma'i gtso bo sprul sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang / mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/ mkhan rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal/ rje btsun ma 'phrin las dbang mo sogs jo nang pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams dang /gtsang sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal yab sras dang byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal sogs bstan pa stobs kyis 'degs pa'i sa skyong sbyin bdag kyang mang du byung la rje btsun mchog gi ljags rtsom skor la rgya gar chos 'byung / myang chos 'byung / dus 'khor/ 'jigs byed/ bde mchog sgrol ma/ mgon po/ shangs pa chos 'byung sogs chos 'byung khag bcu tsam dang / rnam thar skor la ston pa'i mdzad brgya o rgyan pad+ma'i rnam thar sogs rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu'i rnam thar dang paṇa grub mang po'i rnam thar/ rin 'byung brgya rtsa dang sgra mdo dbyangs can ma'i 'grel pa/ gso nang tshad snyan sdeb sbyor rtsis zlos sogs kyi gzhung 'grel/ bzang spyod/ dus 'khor bde —mchog gsang 'dus bskyed rdzogs kyi rnam bshad sogs dang / khyad par theg mchog rgyas pa'i dbu ma gzhan stong gi lta grub skor dang / rgyud sde'i cho ga du ma sogs glegs bam bzhi bcu lhag mdzad de mdo sngags spyi dang khyad sdur

nges don dbu ma chen po rje jo nang pa'i ring lugs tshang la ma nor ba gsal bar byas shing sbyor drug nyams len gyi rgyun spel te thub brgyud bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs par mdzad do/ /jul bstanano spyi daji kun masbyin rdo sdong pa'i/ /rdor+sha byi ༵ rten pa/ / /pa /dī ༵༵༵ ṭ+wāṃ// /rang gzhan kun gyis 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /myang gzhung nang bstan chos sde chen po nges don chos 'khor gling ngam yongs grags su rtse chen chos sde'i btsun gzugs mu to ba spos khang sgrol bzang phun tshogs sam kun dga'i ming gis gus pa chen pos phul/ /

dkar chagabacom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ (1)'phags ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i dka' 'grel 'gran zla med pa'i rgyal po tshig le'ur byas pa bzhugs/ (4)sher snying gi tshig 'grel bzhugs/ (13)shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo rnam par bshad pa sngon med legs bshad bzhugs/ (30)sher phyin gyisado rnam par bshad pa sngon da legs bshadakyi dkar chag zhib pa/mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba (30)dang po dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa rgyas par bstan pa/ (30)1 tsa ba'i sa bcad dang po gleng bslang ba'i tshul gyi ngo mtshar bskyed pa/ (4 2 )(1)gling gzhi'i tshig (42)(2)mdo sde'i chos 'byung ba'i sgo/ (48)2 co ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa bar du zab cing rgya che ba'i don gtan la dbab pa (51)gcig dris lan gyi sgo nas rgyas par gtan la dbab pa/ (rdo1)

(1)dris pa/ (51)(2)dris lan/ (53)sher phyin la spyod tshul mdor bstan pa/ (53)sher phyin gyi ngo bo rgyas par bshad pa/ (54)(1)zab po'i mtshan nyid rnam pa brgyad kyi sgo nas rang bzhin sher phyin gtan la phab pa (54)(2)mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas pa'i sgo nas lam sher phyin ji ltar sgom tshul/ (99)(2)de rtogs pa'i lam gyi yon tan/ (113)(4)lam des thob pa'i 'bras bu mngon du gyur tshul/ (114)(5)gzungs sngags kyi phan yon bstan pa/ (127)(6)don bsdu'i phyir du sher phyin la slob par gdams pa/ (129)gnyis/ mthun 'gyur gyi sgo nas the tshom bsal ba (129)2 rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa mthar 'khor rnams kyis yi rang mngon par bstod pa/ (130)paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra'i 'grel tshul/ (131)gnyis pa sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim par sbyar ba la dang po spyi don/ (134)(1)phar phyin skabs brgyad dang rim par sbyar ba'i dang po rnam mkhyen/ (139)(2)lam shes/ (142)(2)gzhi shes/ (144)(dī)rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ (148)

(1)dris pa/ (51)(2)dris lan/ (53)sher phyin la spyod tshul mdor bstan pa/ (53)sher phyin gyi ngo bo rgyas par bshad pa/ (54)(1)zab po'i mtshan nyid rnam pa brgyad kyi sgo nas rang bzhin sher phyin gtan la phab pa (54)(2)mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas pa'i sgo nas lam sher phyin ji ltar sgom tshul/ (99)(2)de rtogs pa'i lam gyi yon tan/ (113)(4)lam des thob pa'i 'bras bu mngon du gyur tshul/ (114)(5)gzungs sngags kyi phan yon bstan pa/ (127)(6)don bsdu'i phyir du sher phyin la slob par gdams pa/ (129)gnyis/ mthun 'gyur gyi sgo nas the tshom bsal ba (129)2 rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa mthar 'khor rnams kyis yi rang mngon par bstod pa/ (130)paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra'i 'grel tshul/ (131)gnyis pa sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim par sbyar ba la dang po spyi don/ (134)(1)phar phyin skabs brgyad dang rim par sbyar ba'i dang po rnam mkhyen/ (139)(2)lam shes/ (142)(2)gzhi shes/ (144)(dī)rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ (148)

(5) sbyor/ (150)(6)mthar gyi sbyor ba/ (150)(7)skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ (153)(8)chos kyi sku/ (154)4 de nyid cung zad rgyas par bshad pa/ (156)(1)yang mngon rtogs kyi don sher snying gi tshig dang rim bzhin sbyar ba/ (171)(2)yang sher snying gi mdo'i nying khu sgom pa'i lag tu len tshul/ (174)(2)mdo 'di'i 'grel pa'i skor gleng ba/ (179)(4)sngon med legs bshad che long tsam ngos bzung ba/ (182)(5)dpar byang / (185)

sher snying rtso ba/༄7/ / bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rgya gar skad du/ bha ga wa ti pradzñā pā ra mi tā hri da ya/ bod skad du/bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab bya rgod phung po'i ri la dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs te/ yang de tshe bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so/ /yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pornama'aphags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyod pa nyid la rnam par blta zhing phung po lnga po de dag la yang rang bzhin gyis stong par rnam par blta'o/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyad pa spyod par 'dod pa des/ ji ltar bslab par bya/ de skad ces smras pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis tshe dang ldan pa shā ra dwa ti'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ 1/shā

sher snying rtsa ba/ri'i bu/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo rgyad pa spyod par 'dod pa des 'di ltar rnam par blta bar bya ste/ phung po lnga po de dag kyang / rang bzhin gyis stong par yang dag par rjes su blta'o/ /gzugs stong pa'o/ /stong pa nyid gzugs so/ /gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ /de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang /rnam par shes pa rnams stong pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu de lta bas na chos thams cad stong pa nyid de/ mtshan nyid med pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gags pa/ dri ma med pa/ dri ma dang bral ba med pa/ bri ba med pa/ gang ba med pa'o/ /shā ri'i bu de lta bas na/ stong pa nyid la gzugs med/ tshor ba med/ 'du shes med/ 'du byed rnams med/ rnam par shes pa med/mig med/ rna ba med/ sna med/ lce med/ lus med/ yid med/gzugs med/ sgra med/ dri med/ ro med/ reg bya med/ chos med do/ /mig gi khams med pa nas yid kyi khams med/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar du yang med do/ /ma rig pa med/ ma rig pa zad pa med pa nas rga shi med/ rga shi zad pa'i bar du yang med do/ /de bzhin du sdug bsngal ba dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog pa dang / lam med/ ye shes med/ thob pa med/ ma thob pa yang med do/ /shā ri'i bu de lta bas na/byang chub sems dpa' rnams la thob pa med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la brten cing gnas te sems la sgrib pa med cing skrag pa med do/ /phyin ci log las shin tu 'das nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar phyin to/ /dus gsum du mngon par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams canā kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la brten nas/ bla

sher snying rtsa ba/na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de lta bas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags/ rig pa chen po'i sngags/ bla na med pa'i sngags/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam par byed pa'i sngags/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ mi rdzun pas na bden par shes par bya ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags smras pa/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te pa ra ga te pa ra saṃ ga te bo d+dha swāhā/shā ri'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la bslab par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin de las bzhings te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin nas/ legs so legs so rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te ji ltar khyod kyis bstan pa de bzhin du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la spyad par bya ste/ de bzhin pa rnams kyang rjes su yi rang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang byug dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/ / / /3

sher snying dka' 'grel/'phags ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i dka' 'grel 'gran zla med pa'i rgyal po tshig le'ur byas pa bzhugs so/na mo burna ya/ 'phags ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma snying po'i 'grel pa tshig le'ur byas pa/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gis bdag blo gsal mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma mchog la gus pas 'dud/ /rgyal ba mi pham mgon po la'ang / /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal lo/ / 1shes rab pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /gnyis med ye shes rang ngo bo/ /de la gnyis su med tshul gyis/ /dngos po thams cad phyag 'tshal 'dud/ / 2rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i yum/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ma ste/ /de yi snying po mdor bsdus pa/ /nyi shu lnga pa bdag gis bshad/ /2slob dpon phal cher ('bum nas sdud pa'i bar ma gtogs )mdo 'di —— sogs/ /dngos po brgyad po mi 'chad pas/ /sher phyin dngos gzhi'i mdo ma yin/ /sher phyin mdo yi yan lag ste/ /4rnam thar sgo gsum sogs ston pas/ /(phar phyin gyi )snying po mdor bsdus tsam yin gsungs/ /shes rab pha rol phyin tshul la/ /mos pa'i skal ba bzang po yis/ /5'di yi don sems bsgom pa las/ /ji zhig ltar la brnyed dka' ba'i/ /dngos brgyad lam rim rnyed pa 'di/ /rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi mthu/ /6'di la (spyi don gzhung don gnyis/ dang po la thun mong dang / thun mong min pa gnyis/ dang po thun

sher snying dka' 'grel/mong la )sher phyin ngo bo dang / /nyams len bsgom pa'i man ngag dang / /bgrod bya lam gyi rim pa'o/ /dang po phyogs kyi glang po yi/ /7brgyad stong don bsdu bzhin du bzung / /shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /bsgrub bya de don sbyor ba yi/ /ragazhung lam dag la de yi sgra/ /gnyis pa (bsgom pa'i man ngag la lta sgom spyod 'bras bzhi las )lta ba bdag med gnyis/ /sgom pa zhi gnas lhag mthong gnyis/ /spyod pa pha rol phyin drug sogs/ /kha'abras bu sku gsum ye shes lnga/ /gsum pa (bgrod bya lam rim la )lam lnga sa bcu dang / /byang chub phyogs chos sum cu bdun/ /'di dag shin tu rgya che ba/ /1༷mi pham mgon po'i gzhung bzhin ltos/ /da ni (sher snying gi 〉thun mong min don bshad/ /mdo 'di nam zhig gsungs pa dang / /mthar thug dgongs pa gang du gnas/ /11dngos su gsung ba po yang su/ /'di yi dgos sogs chos bzhi gang / /mi yi yul du ji ltar dar/ /'di dag mdo yi bshad pa la/ /12'jug pa'i thog mar sbyar bar bya/ /dus ni yum rgyas glurnams las sngon/ /dgongs pa nges 'grel la sogs par/ /rgyal ba nyid kyis bkral phyir dang / /12('khor lo tha mar ma zad )sher phyin nyid kyi mdo sder yang / /byams zhus le'ur mtshan nyid gsum/ /gsung phyir dgongs pa'isgromathar thug ni/ /rnam rig dbu ma las gzhan min/ /14gnas skabs gdul bya la ltos nas/ /ngo bo nyid med smra ba'ang rung / /'di yi tshig don phal che ba/ /smra mkhas rnams kyis rtogs sla zhing / /15rgya bod mkhas pa sngon byon rnams/ /kun gyis yang yang bshad pa'i phyir/ /sbas don mngon rtogs rim pa 'di/ /shes na tshig don sngar byung ba'i/ /16'grel bshad dang bstun bshad par byos/ /gsung ba po la bka' gsum tshang / /brjod bya dngos —bstan lam lnga dang / /mtshan nyid gsum po yang yang bstan/ /17sbas spyan

sher snying dka' 'grel/mngon rtogs brgyad car 'chad/ /dgos pa la sogs gzhan dang mtshungs/ /yum gyi mdo sde rgyas pa las/ /snga rol mi yi yul du byon/ /18phyogs 'dir dri med bshes gnyen gyis/ /bsgyur cing bshad la rgyas par mdzad/ /dngos —bstan tshig gi bsdus don ni/ /'di skad bdag thos la sogs pas/ /19gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs lnga bstan/ /de tshe bcom ldan la sogs pas/ /mdo sde zab mo'i gleng bslang gi/ /tshul gyi sher phyin zab mo 'di/ /20'dzin 'chang 'chad dang sgom pa kun/ /rgyal ba'i nus mthu kho nas bstan/ /shā ri bus shes bya la sogs/ /shes rab pha rol phyin tshul la/ /21spyod pa'i dri ba mtshams sbyor bcas/ /phung po lnga stong zhes sogs kyis/ /stong pa nyid ni —gsal bar ston/ /dri ma dri bral med ces pas/ /22kun byang rten 'brel bkag pa'i phyir/ /mtshan ma med pa'i rnam bar dang / /bri gang med pa'i tshig gis ni/ /'bras bu bkag phyir smon med bstan/ /22de ltar cung zad —mdor bstan pa'i/ /rgyas bshad gzugs med zhes sogs te/ /gzugs med sogs kyis stong nyid bstan/ /ma rig med sogs mtshan med ste/ /24sdug bsngal med sogs smon med do/ /sher phyin 'di la gnas sogs kyis/ /lam gyi phan yon bstan pa yin/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sngags sogs/ /25phan yon dang bcas gzungs sngags bstan/ /de ltar ces sogs sher phyin la/ /slob par rjes su gdams pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan ting 'dzin las/ /26bzhings sogs mdo yi tshig gis ni/ /don bsdus sgo nas the tshom — glu bsal/ /de skad bka' bstsal zhes sogs kyis/ /yi rang sgo nas mjug rkobasdus pa'o/ /27da ni man ngag mngon rtog bshad/ /mkhyen gsum rgyud ldan brten bshad dang / /'bras lam sher phyin sgom pa po'i/ /gtso bo brten gyi ga~X zag bstan/ /2/sgom bya lam gyi mngon rtogs bshad/ /sgrod bya lam gyi

sher snying dka' 'grel/ngo bo bstan/ /rjes gdams mthun 'gyur yi rang ste/ /don tshan bdun du bshad par bya/ /29dang po gleng gzhis legs bstan te/ /nyan thos zhi rko'atshol la sogs kyi/ /tshig dang sbyor bar 'dod na yang / /blo ldan ji ltar dga' bar mdzod/ /2༷gnyis pa thub chen ting 'dzin la/ /bzhugs pa la sogs mdo tshig gis/ /'bras bu'i sher phyin sangs rgyas dang / /lam gyi sher phyin rgyal ba'i sras/ /21'phags pa rnams kyi sgom bya ste/ /so so skye dang theg dman gyi/ /'phags pa'ang sher phyin sgom mod kyi/ /sher phyin yongs rdzogs med par ston/ /22gsum pa la ni dngos po brgyad/ /de nas sangs rgyas zhes pa nas/ /bri ba med ces bya ba'i bar/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid ston/ /22gzugs ni stong pa zhes sogs kyis/ /mkhyen pa'i ngo bo'ang gsal bstan cing / /khyad par rnam mkhyen mtshon byed chos/ /sher phyin slob par 'dod sogs kyi/ /24dri lan sems bskyed ngo bo dang / ji ltar slab dang 'di ltar lta/ /zhes pa'i tshig gis gdams ngag dang / /phung po lnga stong zhes bya bas/ /2dinges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi ston/ /gzugs la stong nyid bzhi sbyor gyis/ /chos dbyings rang gi ngo bo dang / /rang bzhin dbyer med chos can gyi/ /26dbye ba'ang shugs la 'phangs pa yin/ /chos rnams stong nyid zhes sogs kyis/ /dmigs pa gsal bar bstan pa dang / /mtshan nyid med dang ma skyes pas/ /27ched du bya ba shugs la bstan/ /bri ba med dang gang med kyis/ /sgrub pa rnam bzhi'i ngo bo yang / /gsal bstan dbye ba shugs la 'phangs/ /28de ltar rnam mkhyen mtshon byed bcu/ /legs par shes de tshul 'dir mkhas/ /de dag gi ni rgyu mtshan yang / sems bskyed ngo bo 'dod pa ste/ /29khyad par phar phyin slob 'dod ces/ /'jug sems 'di las gsal ba ci/ /ji ltar slab snyam dogs can la/ /slob tshul 'doms pa gdams shāg

sher snying dka' 'grel/yin/ /4༷sbyor lam bzhi ki'i nyams len yang / /phung sogs stong par ——bsgom pa de/ /cung zad gsal snang skyes pas na/ /rtog bsgom kho na ma yin la/ /41chos nyid mngon sum ma rtogs shing / /'dzin pa cung zad dang —bcas pas/ /rtog med mngon sum lam yang min/ /gal te 'phags pa'i lam yin na/ /42stong par lta zhes ci phyir gsungs/ /'phags rnams gang du'ang mi lta'o/ /gal te thos bsam tsam yin na/ /phyin ci log gi blo can phyir/ /42yang dag par zhes gsung mi 'gyur/ /de phyir sbyor lam kho na'o/ /chos rnams thams cad stong nyid de/ /mgon po byams pas 'di skad ske gsungs/ /44med pa'i stong pa nyid shes shing / /de bzhin yod pa'i stong nyid dang / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid shes na/ /stong nyid shes pa zhes brjod do/ /45kun brtags kun rdzob tu yang med/ /gzhan dbang bden par grub pas stong / /yongs thub gnyis kyis stong pa'i phyir/ /chos rnams thams cad stong nyid yin/ /46gzugs ni stong pa zhes gsung pas/ /gzugs kyi kun brtags med par bstan/ /stong nyid gzugs so zhes pas ni/ /gzugs snang 'char ba don med kyang / / 47gzugs kyi gzhan dbang rnam rig de/ /gzugs su snang bar ston pa yin/ /gzugs las gzhan na stong nyid dang / /stong nyid las gzhan gzugs med ces/ /48gsungs pas chos nyid yongs grub dang / /gzugs 'dzin can gyi rnam rig de/ /ngo bo gcig dang tha dad bkag / gzugs la dper mtshon mdzad nas ni/ /49stong pa nyid du bstan pa 'dis/ /chos rnams chos dbyings gcig par bstan/ /chos can phung po lnga po dag / so sor bstan pas chos tha dad/ /5༷bstan phyir sgrub pa'i rten gyur pa/ /chos dbyings 'di las gsal ba gang / /chos rnams —bsdus cad stong zhes pas/ /dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad bstan/ /

sher snying dka' 'grel/51mtshan nyid med dang ma skyes pa/ /ma 'gags ces pas rim pa bzhin/ /sems dang rtogs pa spangs pa ste/ /chen po gsum po gsal bar mdzad/ /52sgrub pa rnam pa bzhi po ni/ /skyon yon rang bzhin med rtogs pas/ /skyon spangs yon tan sgrub pa'i phyir/ /sgrub cing nyams su len pa ste/ /ga dri ma bri ba med ces dang / /yon tan gang ba med ces pas/ /shin tu gsal bar nges shes bskyed/ /de ltar gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi/ /54chos kun rnam pa sgrothams cad du/ /skye med bshad pas rnam mkhyen yin/ /gzugs med ces pa la sogs pas/ /phung khams skye mched ma lus pa/ /55med par bstan pas mthong sgom gyi/ /lam shes dmigs pa bstan pa'i phyir/ /tshig de dag gis lam shes so/ /ma rig med ces bya la sogs/ /56nyan rang gnyis dang thun mong gi / mngon rtogs thabs min gzhi shes dang / /ma rig zad pa med sogs kyis/ /thabs mkhas gzhi shes bstan pa yin/ /57sdug bsngal ba dang ces sogs kyis/ /rnam kun mngon rdzogs sbyor ba yi/ /sgom bya rnam pa gsal bar bstan/ /de phyir rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'o/ /58rgyal sras rnams la thob med phyir/ /yum la brten cing gnas zhes pas/ /goms pa brtan byed sbyor ba ni/ /shin tu gsal phyir rtser phyin pa'i/ /ga sbyor ba rang gi ngo bo —— bshad/ /sems la sgrib med skrag med ces/ /rtags kyi rtse mo'i sbyor ba'o/ /phyin ci log nas mthar phyin bar/ /6༷mthar gyis pa yi sbyor ba ste/ /'dir ni phyin log rnam pa gsum/ /bslab pa phyin ci log gnyen por/ /pha rol phyin pa drug po bstan/ /61lta ba phyin ci log bzhi la/ /gnyen por dngos kun bdag med gsungs/ /rtag la mi rtag 'dzin pa sogs/ /log lta phyin ci log gnyen por/ /62rjes dran drug po bstan pa'i phyir/ /phyin ci log las 'das zhes pas/ /mthar gyis pa yi mtshon byed chos/ /bcu gsum maspyar

sher snying dka' 'grel/bsdus pa yis gsungs/ /62de dag mthar gyis goms pa la/ /mthar gyis pa yi sbyor ba zhes/ /gsungs pa mthar phyin zhes pas bstan/ /dus gsum rgyal ba yum 'di la/ /64brten nas mngon par sangs rgyas ces/ /gsungs pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ /yin te ci phyir sangs rgyas rnams/ /skad cig gnyis par 'tshang rgya ba'i/ /65lam la sbyor ba der rtags phyir/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sngags sogs/ /'bras bu chos sku'i mngon rtogs ste/ /'di la sngags zhes bya ba ni/ /66bdag yid mtshan ma las skyabs nas/ /gzhan dag skyob pa'i don du sbyar/ /shes rab pha rol phyin zhes pas/ /ngo bo nyid sku'i spangs pa bstan/ /67rig pa ces pas rtogs pa ste/ /bla na med pas longs sku'o/ /mi mnyam mnyam pa sprul pa'i sku/ /sdug bsngal zhi ba 'phrin las so/ /68de nas 'bras bu chos sku de/ /mi thun bden par bstan pa yis/ /chos dbyings 'gyur med bden thub ni/ /mdo 'dis mchog tu gsal bar snye bstan/ /69bzhi pa bgrod bya lam ngo bo/ /sngags la dum bu lngar bsgos pas/ /ston ces 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sras/ /dam pa sangs rgyas gsung ba ni/ /70dpyod ldan kun gyis blang bar byos/ /song ba zhes pa lan gnyis kyis/ /tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam/ /pha rol song zhes mthong lam ste/ /71'khor ba'i pha rol song phyir ro/ /pha rol yang dag song zhes pa/ /de yi rgyun sbyor sgom pa'i lam/ /byang chub ces pa mthar phyin no/ /72rjes ma gdams sogs gsum rtogs par sla/ /yum rgyas rnams dang tshig gi lam/ /mi mtshungs phyir na dngos po brgyad/ /mi ston snyam du mi bsam ste/ /72'bum sogs gcig gcig las bsdus dang / /'di ni mdo gzhan dus gzhan du/ /gsungs phyir ngag tshig gcig mi dgos/ /sangs rgyas mthu zhes bya ༵ sogs/ /74tshig kyang phal cher mtshungs pa'ang yin/ /yongs ye yum

sher snying dka' 'grel/mdo rgyas pa'ang / /shing rta chen po rnam mang gis/ /dngos brgyad bshad pa ma mdzad pas/ /75'di la 'ang gcig tu mi dgos mod/ /stong phrag brgya pa la sogs la/ /dngos brgyad sbas don chings yod kyi/ /'di la sbyor ba rang bzo tsam/ /76yin ces the tshom mi bya ste/ /rgyu mtshan gong du bshad pa ltar/ /lung dang rig pas grub phyir dang / /mtshan las kyang ni rtogs phyir ro/ /77sher phyin rang gi ngo bo tsam/ /bstan pas snying por 'gyur na ni/ /rab bstsal rnam par gnon pa yis/ /zhus pa'i mdo sogs ci phyir min/ /78gzhung nyung kho nas yin na ni/ /yi ge gcig ma'ang cis mi 'jog/ de phyir shes phyin mdo kun gyi/ /snying po 'dus par 'jog dgos pas/ /79dngos brgyad don bzang mi ston na/ /sbas don mngon rtogs med 'gyur bas/ /kun gyi don ston ga la zhig / sher phyin mdo phran mang na yang / /ra 'di nyid kho na shes phyin gyi/ /snying por bzhag pa'i nus pa dang / /dam pa thams cad shes phyin gyi/ /mdo phran gzhan pas 'di kho na/ /81mchog tu gces par mdzad pa yi/ /dgongs pa'i snying po 'ang shes par byos/ /nyan thos rgyal sras dbye ba dang / /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /82bdag med gnyis dang mtshan nyid gsum/ /stong nyid bcu drug rten 'brel dang / /bden bzhi spyi dang bye brag dang / /ye shes dang ni 'phrin las sogs/ /ra shes rab pha rol phyin rgyas dang / /theg chen mngon pa sogs su shes/ /gzhung nyung ba la don mang ba/ /tshul 'di ji bzhin rtogs pa dkon/ /84sngon gyi dam pa mkhas rnams kyi/ /thugs mtshor legs bshad nor bu 'di/ /bzhugs pa sha stag yin mod kyi/ /yi ge'i lam du 'khod pa med/ /85de phyir phyi rabs mkhas rlom can/ /brnyed dang grags 'dod 'di dag gi/ 'di 'dra'i legs bshad ga la shes/ /phyi nas mdo 'di sbas don dardo1 / /

sher snying dka' 'grel/86sbyor ba 'ga' zhig byung srid na/ /bdag gam bdag rjes 'brangs pa —'am/ /bdag gi legs bshad brkus pa ru/ /blo ldan rnams kyis shes par mdzod/ /87deng dus legs bshad gsar pa cung zad tsam/ /mthong na de la brten nas rtog bzo'i tshig /brgya phrag rtsom zhing legs bshad smra ba po/ /de la sdang smra byed cing bshad pa ngom/ /ra/g.yo can dam par brdzus pas sa gzhi khyab/ /drang po'i rang bzhin skye bo brgya la 'ga'/ /sngon med legs bshad gsar du sbyor na mkhas/ /bdag bstod gzhan smod skye bo dam pa skyimin/ //'amado sde kun gyi snying po mchog 'di la/ /rgyas 'grel byed pa dpag tu med mod kyi/ /legs sbyangs sgom zhing rtags mtshan rnyed pa las/ /sbyar ba'i rnam bshad 'di ni rgyal po yin/ /9༷zhes pa 'phags ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i 'grel pa tshig le'ur byas pa zhes bya ba/ shes rab snying po'i dka' 'grel 'gran zla med pa ste/ mdo tshigs bcad nyi shu rtsa lngas dngos po brgyad ston cing rgyal ba'i bka'i don mtha' dag 'dus pa'i tshul du dgongs pa 'grel ba/ 'grel pa'i rgyal po 'di ni/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha la/ rab 'byams smra ba shākya rgyal mtshan la sogs pas bskul nas/ /rang lo nyer dgu pa chu mo yos kyi lo nag pa'i zla ba'i nyer gnyis kyi nyin/ thun mtshams gcig la sbyar ba'o/ /'dis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gtso // sgrir pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa thams cad du dar bar gyur cig /12

sher snying tshig 'grel/༄nan /sher snying gi chig 'grel bzhugs so/ /na mo bu ya/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo don phyogs tsam smos na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes pa don mang po la 'jug kyang / dngos dang gtso bo ni/ shes bya thams cad kyi gnas lugs gnyis med kyi ye shes bde gshegs snying po de yin la/ mdo sde 'dis sher phyin de'i rang bzhin spros bral gyi mtshan nyid dang / 'gyur ba med pa'i mtshan nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad pa'i mtshan nyid de/ don gyi gtso bo gsum po de ston cing / tshig shin tu nyung ngu'i phyir snyingawo'o/ /ji ltar ston zhe na/ gzugs med ces pa la sogs pas spros bral dang /ma:sapa zhes pa la sogs pas 'gyu/ med dang / gzugs stong pa'o zhes pa la rigasdu /shā / sdu ṅgi dṛ snakāshā daste pa /gle/nga bslang ba dang / don gtan la dbab pa dang / yi rang mngon par bstod pa'o/ /gnyis kāng/ po la/ gleng gzhi'i tshig dang / mdo sde'i chos 'byung ba'i sgo dang po ni/ 'di skad sogs te/ gnas rgyal po'i khab kyi nang tshan bya rgod phung po'i ri la/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'khor dge slong ste nyan thos dgra bcoms pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen po dang / zhing khams sna tshogs nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya chen po dang / thabs cig pa lhan cig tu bzhugs shing / dirdor

sher snying tshig 'grel/༄nan /sher snying gi chig 'grel bzhugs so/ /na mo bu ya/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo don phyogs tsam smos na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes pa don mang po la 'jug kyang / dngos dang gtso bo ni/ shes bya thams cad kyi gnas lugs gnyis med kyi ye shes bde gshegs snying po de yin la/ mdo sde 'dis sher phyin de'i rang bzhin spros bral gyi mtshan nyid dang / 'gyur ba med pa'i mtshan nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad pa'i mtshan nyid de/ don gyi gtso bo gsum po de ston cing / tshig shin tu nyung ngu'i phyir snyingawo'o/ /ji ltar ston zhe na/ gzugs med ces pa la sogs pas spros bral dang /ma:sapa zhes pa la sogs pas 'gyu/ med dang / gzugs stong pa'o zhes pa la rigasdu /shā / sdu ṅgi dṛ snakāshā daste pa /gle/nga bslang ba dang / don gtan la dbab pa dang / yi rang mngon par bstod pa'o/ /gnyis kāng/ po la/ gleng gzhi'i tshig dang / mdo sde'i chos 'byung ba'i sgo dang po ni/ 'di skad sogs te/ gnas rgyal po'i khab kyi nang tshan bya rgod phung po'i ri la/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa 'khor dge slong ste nyan thos dgra bcoms pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen po dang / zhing khams sna tshogs nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rgya chen po dang / thabs cig pa lhan cig tu bzhugs shing / dirdor

sher snying tshig 'grel/tshogs thams cad chos 'di'i snod du gyur cing rgyud smin pa'i dus cig na/chos sher phyin snying po'i tshig 'di skad ma nor bar/ bsdud pa po phyag na rdo rje bdag gis thos so/ /zhes gnas dus nges pa dang / 'khor tshogs dpang por gzhag pas/ ston pa'i gsung du nges shes bskyed cing / ngo mtshar ba'i dad pa bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa mdo sde chos 'byung ba'i sgo ni/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das sogs so/ /rtogs par dka' bas na zab mo ste gnas lugs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes ni snang ba ste/dngos su mthong ba'i don yin la/ ye shes de dang ldan pa'i mnyam gzhag ni ting nge 'dzin te/ bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin de la rtag tu bzhugs pa yin kyang / der nadus kyi gdul bya rnams kyi snang ba la/ zab mo snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin de la gsar du mnyam par gzhag pa ltar snang ngo / /yang bcom ldan 'das mnyam par gzhag ma thag pa de'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan rasagazigs dbang phyug kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo mngon sum du rtogs shing spyod pa'i ye shes/ting nge 'dzin dang rjes su 'brel ba'i mnyam gzhag rnam par lta ba ste mkhyen pa'i ye shes la gnas pa dang / de 'dra ba'i sher phyin la dngos su spyod pa'i rgyu/ phung po lnga po rang bzhin gyi ngo bos ma grub cing stongs par/ ye shes kyi rnam par blta zhing sgom mo/ /phung po lnga po rang bzhin gyi stong pa de nyid/sher phyin zab mo las logs su bstan pas/ sher phyin zab mo ni rang gi ngo /spra trī /sdo zlo ṭ+wāṃ /ba pa'i phyir/ 'di ni gzhan stong dbu ma gsal bar ston 14 spyan ras gzigs kyi sher phyin la gsar du mnyam par gzhag pa'i tshul

sher snying tshig 'grel/bstan ma thag pa de nas zhes snga phyi mtshams sbyor te/ gnyis pa don gtan la /shā trī ༵ ༵ ba/ sa/ /// gyi sgo nas gtan la phab pa dang mthun 'gyur gyi sgo dang po la dris pa dang / lan bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas sangs rgyas kyis mthus sogs te/ shā ri'i bu la sogs pa nyan thos rnams kyi rang stobs kyis chos zab mo 'di 'dri bar yang mi shes mod/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i mthu las/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci smras ce na rigs kyi bu skyes pa'am/ rigs kyi bu bud med yin yang rung ste/ gang su yang rung ba la la dag byang chub tu sems bskyed nas shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo 'di la/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas spyad pa spyod pa ste/ nyams len byed par 'dod pas/sgom tshul ji ltar bslab par bya dgos zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa lan la/ sher phyin la spyod tshul mdor bstan/ sher phyin gyi ngo bo rgyas par bshad/ de rtogs pa'i lam gyi phan spran bstan/ lam des rtogs pa'i 'khas bu ba/da/zlo/ tram̐ ṭ+wāṃ ṭā ṭā sdor+sha/ /bye //ngas sngags bstan/ don bsdu'i tshul du /ra dang po ni/ de skad sogs te/ shā ri'i bus de skad ces smras pa dang /de'i lan du byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ji skad cidri zer na/ rigs kyi bu'am riga~X kyi bu tram̐ gang la la /sarabakyipharoX shā // ༵ /sna tram̐ // shā rdotā par 'a da pa / tshul 'a ltar rnam pa tsho

sher snying tshig 'grel/'dir spyad pa zhes pa ni/ spyad byed las su bya ba'i tshig yin la/spyod pa ni spyod tshul te/ byed pa'i tshig yin pas spyad bya sher phyin de la spyod lugs ji lta bu zhes pa ste/ nyams su blang bya sher phyin gang la/ nyams su lta/ pa'i thabs gang gis tshul ji ltar nyams len byed par 'dod la zhes spyod pa'i ngo bo ni chos spyod bcu dang phar phyin drug la sogs pa'o/ /ji ltar rnam par blta bar bya ce na/ phung po lnga po de dag dang / gzhan yang khams dang skye mched la sogs pa'i dbye ba'i sgo nas kyang / snang grags kyi chos de dag thams cad rang bzhin nam rang gi ngo bos ma grub pa'i tshul gyis ma nor bar yang dag pa'i gnas lugs la/ yul can sgom pa'i ye shes kyis kyang gnas lugs dang rjes su mthun par blta zhing sgom mo/ /gnyis pa sher phyin gyi ngo bo rgyas par bshad pa la/ rang bzhin sher phyin gtan la dbab pa dang / lam sher phyin sgom pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ gzugs stong pa'o sogs te/ bden gnyis thun mong du sbyar na/ da lta byis pa so so skye bo rnams la gzugs phung du snang ba'i gnas 'di na/ gzugs phung ni yod pa ma yin te/ gzugs de ni 'khrul snang tsam ma gtogs rang gi ngo pos stong pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gzugs kyi rang ldog nas med cing ma yin pa'i stong pa'o/ /gzugs kyi shul na stong pa'i chos nyid gnas pa de nyid stong pa nyid dngos de/ 'di ni bden cing yod pa dang yin pa'i stong nyid do/ /gnas tshul la yod pa'i chos nyid stong pa nyid la byis pa so so skye bo rnams la gzugs phung du snang yang 'khrul snang tsam ma gtogs ngo bos med do/ /gzugs khyad gzhir byas na de las gzhan du chos dbyings stong nyid logs su gnas pa ma yi/ 6te/ gzugs snang 'char ba'i gnas de nyid chos dbyings yin pa'i

sher snying tshig 'grel/phyir dang / khyad gzhi gzugs phung nyid yod ma myong bas/ gzugs phung gi chos nyid la tha dad du rang so 'dzugs pa'i gya mi 'pher ba'i phyir dang /chos nyid kyi rig pa de yang spros bral yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs dang do bdo ba'i zla bo tha dad pa'i mtshan nyid mi 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /chos dbyings stong pa nyid de nyid khyad gzhir bzung na/ de las gzhan du gzugs yod pa ma yin te/ chos nyid gnas kyang gzugs phung med pa'i phyir dang / rgyusgromatshan snga ma rnams kyis yang phyir ro/ /dper na mkhris nad can gyi dung la bltas na/ gong bu dkar po 'khyil ba can du mi mthong gi ser po 'khyil ba can du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /mthong yang ser po 'khyil ba de ni 'khrul snang tsam ma gtogs gdod nas med la/ dkar po ni yod pas na gang la ser por snang ba 'char ba dang dkar po gnyis gzhi tha dad med pa'i tshul gyi gcig pa la bsams nas/ ser por mthong ba de ni gzhan ma yin gyi dung ngo /dung ni khyod kyis mthong ba'i ser po de'o/ /khyod kyis mthong ba'i ser po de las gzhan na dung med do/ /dung las gzhan du khyod kyis mthong ba'i ser po de grub pa ma yin no/ /zhes brjod pa lta bu yin te/ don la shin tu 'byor ro/ /rang stong smra ba rnams kyi ltar na ni/ stong pa la don dam gyis khyab par 'dod pas/ gzugs phung don dam bden par thal bar 'gyur la/ stong pa nyid gzugs ma yin gzugs las gzhan pa yang ma yin zhes brjod par 'thad kyi/ gzugs stong pa'o/ /stong pa nyid gzugs so zhes pa 'di mi rung ngo / /de ltar na 'di ni gzhan stong dbu ma chen po gsal bar ston pa'i tshig gnyis pa'o/ /'di ltar 'chad pa ni mdo 'di'i dngos bstan dgag tshig tu gsal ba ltar bstan pa yin la/ sbas don ltar bshad na sgrub tshig kho na te/chos nyid don dam pa'i gzugs gang yin pa de ni stong pa nyid kyi ye shes so

sher snying tshig 'grel/stong pa nyid kyi ye shes gang yin pa de chos nyid kyi gzugs su snang ngo / /zhes bstan pas/ de gnyis gzhi mthun pa yod pa tsam du go yang/ stong pa'i ye shes don dam gyi gzugs ma yin pa yang srid/ don dam gyi gzugs stong pa'i ye shes ma yin pa yang srid snyam pa'i dogs pa dgag pa'i phyir/gzugs las kyang sogs so/ /de la skabs 'dir stong pa zhes pa stong rkyang ma yin te gnyis stong gi ye shes so/ /don dam pa'i gzugs phung ni gzugs phung ma yin mod/ chos dbyings rnam pa thams cad pa'i nang gi gzugs phung gi rnam pa don dam pa de ni/ chos nyid kyi gzugs phung ngam/ don dam gyi gzugs phung zhes bya'o/ /de'i 'og ma rnams la yang rigs 'gre ste/de bzhin du tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa rnams stong pa'o/ /stong pa nyid tshor ba nas rnam par shes pa'i bar ro/ /tshor ba nas rnam par shes pa'i bar las stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/stong pa nyid las kyang tshor ba nas rnam par shes pa'i bar gzhan ma yin no/ /zhes sbyar ro/ /de lta bu'i stong pa nyid bshad pa'i mjug bsdu ba ni/ de lta bas na chos thams cad stong pa nyid de zhes pa ste/ ji skad du/ chos kyi dbyings ni ma gtogs pa/ gang phyir chos med de yi phyir/ zhes je btsun gyis gsungs pa'o/ /mtshan nyid med pa zhes pa ni/ kun rdzob ni rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i phyir de dang de'i mtshan nyid med de/ bum pa bden par med pas bum pa'i mtshan nyid kyang bden par med pa bzhin no/ /don dam ni rang gi ngo bos yod kyang / don dam gyi mtshan nyid rang bzhin gyis ma grub ste/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum ni blos gzhag pa tsam yin gyi gnas lugs la med pas so/ /de bzhin du skye ba med pa'i phyir 'gag pa med ces bya ste/ skye me/ 8dang 'gag med 'di gnyis la yang snga ma dang 'dra ste/ kun rdzob la ni

sher snying tshig 'grel/snang ngo tsam du skye 'gag gi mtshan nyid yod kyang 'khrul snang tsam yin gyi/kun rdzob nyid ye nas med na/ de la skye rgyu dang 'gag rgyu med pa'i phyir skye 'gag med la/ don dam ni rang gi ngo bos stong pa yod kyang / de la skye 'gag gnas gsum ma grub pas ma skyes shing ma 'gags pa'o/ /de ltar na/stong pa ni 'dus byas kyis stongs pa'i don yin pas/ 'dus byas dang /mtshan nyid dang / skye ba dang / 'gag pa rnams kun brtags tsam yin pas med par bstan la/ chos nyid ni kun brtags kyis stong pa'i don no/ /'dus byas tsam kun brtags su byar mi rung ngo snyam na/ 'dus byas yin na kun brtags yin pas ma khyab kyang / 'dus byas thams cad la kun——brtags kyi mtshan nyid 'jug pas khyab ste/ 'dus byas thams cad kyang mdor bsdu na/ yul dang yul can gnyis su zad do/ /yul can gyi steng na yul gzung ba las/ yul can nyid logs su tshugs thub galtar snang ba de ni kun brtags yin pas shes pa thams cad la kun brtags de 'jug la/shes pa las logs su yul gzung ba phyi don yod par snang yang / kun snyebartags yin zhing de nyid gzugs sogs yul dang / mig sogs dbang po thams cad la 'jug pa yin no/ /de dag las gzhan brtags yod kyi dngos po dang / dngos med thams cad ni kun brtags yin pa smos ma dgos te/de'i phyir 'dus byas thams cad la kun brtags kyi mtshan nyid 'jug pa yin no/ /des na gzhan dbang kun brtags kyi mtshan nyid can yin zhing / kun brtags kyang gzhan dbang gi mtshan nyid can no/ /yongs grub dngos ni de ltar ma yin kyang / yongs grub brtags pa ba yang de dag dang 'dra'o/ /da ni dkyus la 'jug par bya ste/ dri ma ni 'khor ba ste/ las nyon gyi dbang gis sdug bsngal sna tshogs 'byung bar snang ba'i dri ma 'khor ba yang rang ༵ ngo

sher snying tshig 'grel/bos med la/ dri ma dang bral ba ni mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ lam sgom pas sgrib pa spangs nas byang chub thob pa yin na/ lam sgom pa yang bden par med la sgrib pa rang bzhin med pa'i phyir/ sgrib pa dang bral bar snang ba yang blo'i 'char tshul tsam las ngo bos med do/ /yang dag pa'i sangs rgyas bden par grub kyang / de thob par snang ba ni blo'i 'char tshul yin pas/ kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam mo/ /de ltar na/ kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang bar bya ba'i lam 'di dag ni/ gzhan dbang yin la de ngo bos med par bstan pas/ chos nyid la gzhan dbang gis ma gos shing / gzhan dbang rang gi ngo bos stongs par bstan to/ /don dam dbyings de la 'khor ba'i gnas skabs na yon tan bri ba dang / sbyang 'das kyi gnas skabs na/sgrib pa spangs shing bri ba ltar snang yang 'khor ba pa dang rnal 'byor pa'i blo'i 'char tshul yin gyi/ gnas tshul la bri ba med cing / 'khor ba'i dus na skyon gyis gang ba dang / myang 'das kyi dus na yon tan gyis gang bar snang ba yang / gong ma dang 'dra ste bden par ma grub bo/ /de'i rgyu mtshan sgrib pa gdod nas ma thub pa'i phyir dang / yon tan gdod nas rang chas su gnas pa'i phyir 'phel 'grib tu snang ba ni log snang tsam mo/ /'dis ni don dam yongs grub la kun rdzob 'khor 'das kyis stongs par bstan cing / /yongs grub don dam gyi ye shes de 'khor 'das kun khyab yin yang / 'khor 'das so sos gos pa med la/ de med pas 'pho 'gyur med pa'i phyir rtag par bstan to/ /'di ni gzhan stong dbu ma gsal bar bstan pa'i tshig gsum pa'o/ /de ltar na/ stong nyid dang / mtshan nyid med pa dang / ma skyes pa dang / ma 'gags pa dang / dri ma med pa dang / dri bral med pa dang /bri ༵ med pa dang / gang ba med pa ste/ zab mo mtshan nyid brgyad ces

sher snying tshig 'grel/grags la/ des na rang bzhin sher phyin stong pa nyid kyi ye shes de/ stong nyid yin pa nas gang ba med pa'i bar du yin no/ /gnyis pa lam sher phyin sgom pa'i tshul ni/ mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug la slob pa'i dbang du byas nas/ dang po phung po la mkhas par bslab pa ni/ shā ri'i bu de lta bas na stong pa nyid la gzugs med ces bya ba ste/stong pa'i gzhi bde gshegs snying po don dam pa'i sems nyid/ yongs grub stong pa nyid chen po de la chos can glo bur gyi dri ma/ gzugs kyi phung po med/tshor ba'i phung po med/ 'du shes kyi phung po med/ 'du byed kyi phung po med/rnam par shes pa'i phung po med do/ /de'i rgyu mtshan ni de lta bas na zhes pa ste/stong pa nyid nas gang ba med pa'i bar du zab mo brgyad kyi rang bzhin gyi phyir ro/ /shu ri'i bu zhes bya ba ni bod pa'o/ /stong pa nyid la zhes pa'i tshig 'di ni/ma thob pa yang med do zhes pa'i bar thams cad la sbyor rgyu ste thog ma'i gsal byed do/ /'di ni stong nyid kyi ye shes khyad gzhir byas nas/ de la kun rdzob kyi chos gang yang med par ston pa yin pas/ gzhan stong dbu ma chen po gsal bar ston pa'i tshig bzhi pa yin no/ /rang stong smra bar grags pa rnams kyi ltar na/ stong pa nyid la gzugs med ces pa mi rung ste/ khyad gzhi stong nyid ma grub pa'i phyir/ de la khyad chos gzugs logs su 'gog pa nam du yang mi 'thad la/ rang stong pa'i stong nyid blo ngor grub zin la gzugs sogs 'gog na bkag zin 'gog par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /de rnams kyi ltar /go/ sa ṭ+wāṃ/zugs med pa ni stong pa nyid do zhes/ mdo tshig bskur te 'don gnyis pa skye mched la bslab pa ni/ stong nyid kyi ye shes de la/ mig gi skye mched med/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ rna ba med/ sna med/ lce lha/da/

sher snying tshig 'grel/lus med/ yid kyi skye mched med/ gzugs kyi skye mched med/ sgra med/dri med/ ro med/ reg bya med/ chos kyi skye mched med do/ /gsum pa khams la mkhas par bslab pa ni/ stong nyid kyi ye shes de la/mig gi khams med pa nas/ yid kyi khams kyi bar du med do/ /mig gi khams dang / rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus/ yid kyi khams te drug dang /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos kyi khams te drug dang / mig gi rnam shes/ rna ba'i rnam shes/ sna'i rnam shes/ lce'i rnam shes/ lus kyi rnam shes/yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar du yang med pa'o/ /bzhi pa rten 'brel la mkhas par bslab pa ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes la/ ma rig pa med pa nas/ rga shi'i bar du med de/ ma rig pa'i yan lag med/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ 'du byed kyi yan lag dang / rnam par shes pa dang / ming gzugs dang / skye mched dang / reg pa dang /tshor ba dang / sred pa dang / len pa dang / srid pa dang / skye ba dang /rga shi'i yan lag med cing / lam bsgoms pas ma rig pa'i yan lag zad cing / 'gogs pa med pa dang / de bzhin du sbyar te/ 'du byed kyi yan lag 'gags pa med pa dang / rnam shes kyi yan lag 'gags pa dang /ming gzugs kyi yan lag 'gags pa dang / skye mched drug gi yan lag 'gags pa dang / reg pa 'gags pa dang / tshor ba 'gags pa dang /sred pa 'gags pa dang / len pa 'gags pa dang / srid pa 'gags pa tātā du/ ya/ zlo / //gas pa dang / rga shi'i yan lag zad cing 'gags pa'i lnga pa bden pa la mkhas par bslab pa ni/ stong nyid kyi steng na phung kha~X skye mched rten 'brel ma lus pa de bzhin du/ stong nyid kyi ye shes la/

sher snying tshig 'grel/sdug bsngal bden pa thams cad dang / kun 'byung bden pa thams cad dang /ngo 'a/gas bden gapar// rna/sa da/ /rilam /de/ rnams ngo bos /tā byed/ pa/ ṭ+wāṃ pardo / kā sdir+sha bye // lhag ṅgi ba na stong tshod rnan la/ blang drug pa gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la mkhas par bslab pa ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes la/ lam gyis bsdus pa'i ye shes med cing / des nges par 'byung ba yang med/ dngos po rnams kyi rgyu 'bras kyi gnas skabs so so thob par 'gyur ba yang med la/ rgyu min las 'bras bu'i gnas skabs ma thob pa yang med do/ /de dag thams cad kyi don gyi mdo 'di ltar gzung ste/'khor ba'i sems can rnams dang / lam sgom pa po thams cad la/ chos dbyings de gzugs sogs gzhi'i chos kyi 'khrul pa dang / lam dang 'bras bu'i chos kyi snang ba sna tshogs su shar zhing / gnas lugs de'i rang gzugs su ma mthong la/ des na gzhi lam gyi snang ba de dag thams cad med bzhin du snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ thos bsam gyi dus su de ltar gtan la phab nas/bsgoms pas gzugs phung nas ma thob pa'i bar gyi chos thams cad rig pa'i ngo bor rang sang du btang ste/ rang bzhin stong nyid kyi ye shes de la mnyam par 'jog dgos par bstan to/ /ngo bo nyid med gsum du 'chad pa dang 'di gnad gcig pas/ gsum du bshad pa'i grub don la'ang don dam dbyings yang dag par gnas pa de/ glo bur kun rdzob kyis stongs pa tsam kho na 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na kha cig bshad tshul de gnyis 'gal bar skesems pa ni/ ma go ba lus che ba'i tshul lo/ /de ltar drug las phung khams skye mched gsum la bslab pas ni/ chos nyid kyi mtshan nyid la mkhas par 'gyur la/ rten 'brel dang bden bzhi la bslab pas blang dor 'jug 2rdog

sher snying tshig 'grel/sdug bsngal bden pa thams cad dang / kun 'byung bden pa thams cad dang /ngo 'a/gas bden gapar// rna/sa da/ /rilam /de/ rnams ngo bos /tā byed/ pa/ ṭ+wāṃ pardo / kā sdir+sha bye // lhag ṅgi ba na stong tshod rnan la/ blang drug pa gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la mkhas par bslab pa ni/ stong pa nyid kyi ye shes la/ lam gyis bsdus pa'i ye shes med cing / des nges par 'byung ba yang med/ dngos po rnams kyi rgyu 'bras kyi gnas skabs so so thob par 'gyur ba yang med la/ rgyu min las 'bras bu'i gnas skabs ma thob pa yang med do/ /de dag thams cad kyi don gyi mdo 'di ltar gzung ste/'khor ba'i sems can rnams dang / lam sgom pa po thams cad la/ chos dbyings de gzugs sogs gzhi'i chos kyi 'khrul pa dang / lam dang 'bras bu'i chos kyi snang ba sna tshogs su shar zhing / gnas lugs de'i rang gzugs su ma mthong la/ des na gzhi lam gyi snang ba de dag thams cad med bzhin du snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ thos bsam gyi dus su de ltar gtan la phab nas/bsgoms pas gzugs phung nas ma thob pa'i bar gyi chos thams cad rig pa'i ngo bor rang sang du btang ste/ rang bzhin stong nyid kyi ye shes de la mnyam par 'jog dgos par bstan to/ /ngo bo nyid med gsum du 'chad pa dang 'di gnad gcig pas/ gsum du bshad pa'i grub don la'ang don dam dbyings yang dag par gnas pa de/ glo bur kun rdzob kyis stongs pa tsam kho na 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /des na kha cig bshad tshul de gnyis 'gal bar skesems pa ni/ ma go ba lus che ba'i tshul lo/ /de ltar drug las phung khams skye mched gsum la bslab pas ni/ chos nyid kyi mtshan nyid la mkhas par 'gyur la/ rten 'brel dang bden bzhi la bslab pas blang dor 'jug 2rdog

sher snying dzig 'grel/la mkhas shing / gnapa dkā gnas ma yin pa la bslab pas rgyu rkyen 'bras bu la mkhasna // ༵ sdo r+shar+sha nā ṭ+wāṃ /la/ma gyi phan yon ni/ de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' sogs so/ /thob pa med pa'i phyir zhes pa mtha'i gsal byed de/ gzugs med ces pa tshun chad thams cad la snyeg par mngon la/gtso bor thob pa spros pa ni/ gnas lugs la bskyed byed rgyus bskyed bya 'bras bu bskyed du rung ba dang mi rung ba gang yang ma grub ces par gzhan rnams kyang 'dus par dgongs so/ /des na 'di ltar gzugs nas ma thob pa'i bar gang yang dngos po'i gnas tshul la ma grub pa ltar/ theg chen pa rnams kyis sgom dgos pa de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mnyam gzhag ye shes kyi rang ngo la/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dngos po bya byed dang bcas pa gdod nas ma grub pa'i phyir/ /'khrul ngor rang sems la shar ba'i sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa yang / gshis la gdod nas med cing /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang las nyon gyis skrag cing / 'jigs pa yang —gshis la nam yang med pas/ med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa na/ gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba phyin ci log gi snang ba rnams rim pas spangs pas/ mthar 'khrul pa thams cad las shin tu 'das nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang gi mthar phyin cing reg par 'gyur ro/ /phyin ci log las rim pas 'das tshul ni/ mos spyod kyi gdang / 'phags pa'i sa bcu'i rim pas/ mthar rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bar ro/ /bzhi pa lam des thob pa'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur tshul ni/ dus gsum sogs te/ dus gsum du mngon par bzhugs pa ste sngon byung ba dang /da sdur bzhugs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na 'byon 'gyur gyi sangs rgyas thams

sher snying dzig 'grel/la mkhas shing / gnapa dkā gnas ma yin pa la bslab pas rgyu rkyen 'bras bu la mkhasna // ༵ sdo r+shar+sha nā ṭ+wāṃ /la/ma gyi phan yon ni/ de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' sogs so/ /thob pa med pa'i phyir zhes pa mtha'i gsal byed de/ gzugs med ces pa tshun chad thams cad la snyeg par mngon la/gtso bor thob pa spros pa ni/ gnas lugs la bskyed byed rgyus bskyed bya 'bras bu bskyed du rung ba dang mi rung ba gang yang ma grub ces par gzhan rnams kyang 'dus par dgongs so/ /des na 'di ltar gzugs nas ma thob pa'i bar gang yang dngos po'i gnas tshul la ma grub pa ltar/ theg chen pa rnams kyis sgom dgos pa de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mnyam gzhag ye shes kyi rang ngo la/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dngos po bya byed dang bcas pa gdod nas ma grub pa'i phyir/ /'khrul ngor rang sems la shar ba'i sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa yang / gshis la gdod nas med cing /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang las nyon gyis skrag cing / 'jigs pa yang —gshis la nam yang med pas/ med pa mngon sum du rtogs pa na/ gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba phyin ci log gi snang ba rnams rim pas spangs pas/ mthar 'khrul pa thams cad las shin tu 'das nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang gi mthar phyin cing reg par 'gyur ro/ /phyin ci log las rim pas 'das tshul ni/ mos spyod kyi gdang / 'phags pa'i sa bcu'i rim pas/ mthar rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi bar ro/ /bzhi pa lam des thob pa'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur tshul ni/ dus gsum sogs te/ dus gsum du mngon par bzhugs pa ste sngon byung ba dang /da sdur bzhugs pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na 'byon 'gyur gyi sangs rgyas thams

sher snying tshig 'grel/cad kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo mtshan nyid brgyad dang ldan pa 'di nyid la brten nas/ mkhas pa'i tshul drug gis bsgoms pas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas zin pa dang /'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de dag thams cad kyi dngos bstan la chos kyi bdag med kho na gsungs te/ gang zag gi bdag med ni de'i shugs la 'byung bar dgongs so/ /'on kyang gang zag gi bdag med byang chub sems dpas mi sgom pa ltar gsungs pa ni/ dgag gzhi phung po yod par byas nas/de'i steng du nga bdag med par sgom pa'i gang zag gi bdag med sgom tshul de 'dra mi byed ces pa'i don yin gyi/ spros bral gyi rnam pa can gyi gang zag gi bdag med ni rgyal sras rnams kyi sgom bya kho na'o/ /gnas tshul la nga bdag gang yang ma grub pa ni/ gang zag gi bdag med yin la/ gnas tshul la snang grags kyi shes bya gang yang yod ma myong ba ni chos kyi bdag med yin pas/snga ma phyi ma'i nang du 'dus pa'i phyir/ chos kyi bdag med bsgoms pas gang zag gi bdag med sgom par shugs la 'thub bo/ /lnga pa phan yon dang bcas pa'i gzungs sngags bstan pa ni/ de lta bas na shes rab kyi sogs te/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de lta bas na/ rang bzhigashes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi snang cha la/ rig sngags byung ste/ chos sku'i rgyu mthun pa'o/ /sngags de'i che ba ni/ 'dod pa'i don dang las thams cad 'grub par byed pa'i phyir/ rig pa chen po'i gsang sngags yin la/ sngags kyi ngo bo 'jig rten thams cad las 'das shing / theg pa dman pa zil gyis gnon pas/bla na med pa'i ye shes nyid rig sngags kyi rnam par shar ba dang / 'di yis 'dod pa'i las gzhan byed pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ rang don du mi /sdum

sher snying tshig 'grel/pa dang mnyam pa ste/ srid zhi gnyis la 'gran zla dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyang thob par byed pa'i sngags so/ /gzhan don du sems can gyi sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags kyang yin no/ /chos kyi sku bsru ba med pa'i phyir rdzun pa ma yin zhing / rang gi ngo bo mi 'gyur zhing rtag pas na bden par grub pa ste/ sngags 'di yang chos sku de dang ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir/mi bslu zhing mi brdzun pas na/ bden par shes par bya ste/ zhes pa'i don yin la/ 'di gzhan stong dbu ma chen po gsal bar ston pa'i tshig lnga pa yin no/ /sher phyin gyi rig sngags dngos ni/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs rgyud la —bzhugs pa de yin pas chos sku dngos dang bden thub dngos yin zhing /slob pa rnams dang so so skye bo rnams kyi ngag dang yid ngor snang ba de ni/ de 'dra dngos ma yin kyang / de thob byed kyi rgyu yin pas 'bras bu thob pa la mi bslu ba'i bden pa ni yin no/ /'on kyang rgyal bas gsungs pa'i rig sngags 'di lta bu dag so so skye bo lam ma zhugs kyi blo la shar ba tshun chad kyang /yongs grub tu gtogs shing zag med yin par gsungs so/ /phan yon de dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang pos smras shing bshad pa ni/ tabyathā/ zhes pa ni 'di lta ste/ ga te ni gshegs shing rtogs pa/ lan gnyis 'byung ba ni kun rdzob rtogs pa dang /don dam rtogs pa'o/ /pa ra ni mchog ste gnas lugs/ ga te rtogs pa/yang pa ra mchog sam ni yang dag pa/ ga te rtogs pa/ bo d+dha ni byung chub ste bden pa gnyis kyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i ye shes/byang chub ste chos dbyings dang ro gcig par gyur pa zhes pa'o/ /swā hā ni gzhi tshugs sheg pa ste/ sngags kyi mtha' 'grub par byed pa'o/ /drug pa don ba/sa tshul du sher phyin la slob par gdams pa ni/ shā ri'i bu byang chub

sher snying tshig 'grel/sems dpa' sogs te/ shā ri'i bu zhes bos nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis mkhas tshul drug la sogs pa de lta bu'i sgo nas/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo mtshan nyid brgyad ldan la bslab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa mthun 'gyur gyi sgo nas the tshom bsal ba ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das sogs te/ de ltar bshad pa'i rjes de nas/ bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs pa'i tshul bstan te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin nas/ ces mdor bstan la/ ji skad du/ ngo mtshar ba dang rtsod pa dang / /khro dang zhum dang nges bzung dang / /dga' dang dad pa dag las ni/ /tshig gcig lan gnyis 'byung ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ rab tu dgyes pas legs so legs so rigs kyi bu zhes spyan ras gzigs la bos nas/ khyod kyi bshad pa de ni ma nor ba de kho na bzhin no/ /de ni de kho na bzhin yin te de'i rgyu mtshan gyis ji ltar spyan ras gzigs khyod kyis bstan pa de bzhin du/ shā ri'i bu la sogs pa der 'dus kyi 'khor khyed rnams kyis kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la mkhas pa drug la sogs pa'i sgo nas/ spyod tshul de ltar spyad par bya dgos te/ spyan ras gzigs kyis bshad pa 'di dang / 'khor gzhan rnams kyis de dang mthun par sgrub pa 'di la/ da ltar bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa bdag gis yi rang mdzad par ma zad/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams thams cad kyis kyang rjes su yi rang bar mdzad do/ /zhes ston pa shākya seng ges dpal gyi mgur las gsungs so/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa yi rang mngon par bstod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces sogs te/'khor rnams sngar spyan ras gzigs kyis bstan pa 'di las lhag pa'i 2pyir

sher snying tshig 'grel/phyin gyi don zhig kyang yod dam snyam du the tshom dang bcas pa las bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal snga nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun gyis bstan kyang sher phyin gyi don de kho na bzhin yin te gzhan du ma yin no zhes bka' bstsal pa dang / dri ba byed pa shā ri'i bu dang / lan ldon pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang /thams cad dang ldan pa ni thams cad yod pa ste/ yul tha dad pa dang /rigs tha dad pa dang / 'gro ba tha dad pa dang / gzugs tha dad pa dang /longs spyod tha dad pa dang / skad rigs tha dad pa la sogs pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag yi rang zhes pa'o/ /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de'i gtso bo dang / phal pa'i khyad par smos na/ nam mkha' la spyod pa'i lha dang / sa steng na spyod pa'i mi dang / sa 'og na spyod pa'i lha ma yin dang / gnas gsum na spyod pa'i dri za ste/ gtso che ba bzhi po de dag smos pa'i 'jig rten phal pa'i 'khor dpag tu med pa rnams dga' zhing mgu la yi rang ste/ spyan ras gzigs kyis bshad pa dang mthun par bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa de la/ yid ston cing mngon par bstod de/ ches cher 'dzin pa dang nges bzung du byed do/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pas —mthun 'gyur de bzhin ma gsungs na ni/ 'khor rnams kyang yid ma ches pas dga' zhing tshim par mi 'gyur la/ gdul bya gzhan snang dang bsdun nas shā ri'i bu yang bdag gi dri ba skabs su ma babs sam snyam pa dang /spyan ras gzigs kyang bdag gis lan legs par ma ldon pa yang srid snyam du zhum zhing dogs pa dang bcas par 'gyur na/ ston pas legs so'i mthun 'gyur bka' bstsal pas/ shā ri'i bu yang / rang nyid kyi dri ba legs pas da/mi ba dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyang rang gi dri lan legs po

sher snying tshig 'grel/byung bar shes te mchog tu dgyes pa dang / 'khor gzhan rnams kyang yid ches shing the tshom chod pas/ mgu zhing tshim pa thob pa yin no/ /yang 'dir mdo sde zab mo 'di ni 'khor lo bar pa'i mdor gtogs pa yin na/ gzhan stong gi dbu ma ston par mi rigs so/ /zhes dang / de ston na bar mtha' gnyis la zab mi zab med par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smra ba byed pa dag byung na 'di skad ces brjod de/ 'khor lo gsum car gyi dgongs pa yang gzhan stong dbu ma yin cing / dang po dang bar ba nas kyang sgras zin la gsal bar ston pa'i tshig ci rigs pa ni yod do/ /don dam rnam par nges pa'i 'khor lo las ni/ 'khor lo dang bar gnyis ka las ches gsal zhing rgyas pa ma sbas shing mngon du phyung ba'am/ 'byams mas par gsungs pa dang / 'khor lo gsum la mchog dman gyi khyad par yang 'byung zhing / dgongs pa gcig pa yang yin pas skyon de gnyis med do/ /de bas na mdo 'di'i dngos bstan la/gzhan stong thun mong pa ni gsal bar ston zhing / thun mong ma yin pa bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po'i don/ rtag brtan g.yung drung rnam pa thams cad pa de sbas don gyi tshul gyis 'chad pa yin no/ /sher phyin snying po'i mdo'i tshig 'grel rmad du byung ba 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /gcig zhus/ dge legs 'phel/ / / /29

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/༄khya/ / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo rnam par bshad pa sngon med legs bshad bzhugs so/ /mchod brjod dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/oṃ su ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad ces bya ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyab dang rtag pa'i rang bzhin can/ /rgyal ba thugs rje'i bdag nyid la/ /gus pas btud nas mdo 'di'i don/ /cha tsam 'byed la sbo ba skyes/ /dang po dngos bstan stong nyidakyi rim pa rgyas par bstan pa/de la mdo 'di'i ming ni bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po zhes bya ste/ de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba ni/ji skad du/ 'phags pa thogs med zhabs kyis gang gsungs pa de kho na phyogs kyi glang po'i zhal snga nas kyis kyang drangs pa/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni de bzhin gshegs/ /bsgrub bya de don sbyor ba yi/ /gzhung lam dag la de sgra yin/ /ces gsungs te/ rang bzhin sher phyin dang / 'bras bu sher phyin dang / lam sher phyin te/ brjod bya don gyi pye/ phyin rnam grangs gsum dang / gzhung sher phyin ni/ rjod byed tshig

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/gi sher phyin te/ sher phyin gyi rnam grangs bzhi'o/ /de la rang bzhin sher phyin ni/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes chos dbyings gdod ma nas gnas pa gang yin pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i tha snyad gang la 'jug pa'i gzhi de'o/ /de nyid gzhi lam 'bras bu gang gi yang ldog cha dang ma sbrel bar/ rang rkang du bzhag pa'i tshe rang bzhin ces bya zhing / gnas lugs de nyid de bzhin gshegs pa ste/don dam pa'i sangs rgyas dngos kyang yin la/ de sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i skyes bu thob pa na/ skyes bu de'i 'bras bur 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang sprel nas/ 'bras bu sher phyin ces bya zhing /don la ye shes gcig nyid sangs rgyas kyi skyes bu kho na la ltos nas 'bras bu dang / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos spyi'i mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas rang bzhin du bzhagago/ / de bas na 'bras bu de dngos ni gdod ma rang byung yin pa'i phyir/ lam gyis bskyed mi dgos kyang / gang zag des 'bras bu de thob cing mngon du 'gyur ba ni/ lam gyis bskyed dgos pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i lam gyis bsdus pa spros bral rtogs pa'i ye shes ni lam sher phyin no/ /de gsum brjod byar ston par byed pa'i ngag tshig de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yin pa de la ni/ gzhung sher phyin ces bya ste/ skabs 'dir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes pa yang gzhung sher phyin no/ /gzhung de yang rnam pa gsum yod de/ sangs rgyas rang snang gi gsung dbyings theg pa chen po'i mdo sde ni/gnyis med kyi ye shes nyid rnam pa thams cad par shar ba'i nang tshan gyi mdo sde'i dag gi rnam pa don dam de yin pas 'di ni rang bzhin sher phyin nas 'bras bu sher phyin dang ngo bo gcig ste gzhung dang po'o/ /gzhan 'phags pa dang so so skye bo rnams kyi yid la sgra spyi'i rnam par shar ba'i ming tshig yi 31'i

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/tshogs pa theg chen gyi mdo sde ni gzhung gnyis pa'o/ /de dang mthun par ngag tu brjod pa'i sgra ni gzhung sher phyin gsum pa ste/ phyi ma 'di gnyis ni/rang bzhin 'bras bu lam gsum las ngo bo shin tu tha dad mod kyi/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi smon lam las byung ba/ chos kyi sku'i rgyu mthun pa sgrib gnyis spong bar byed pa'i nus mthu can yin pa'i phyir/ zag med kyi chos dang /rnam par byang ba'i dmigs pa dang / yongs grub kyi khongs su gtogs pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /de dag ni zhib por dpyad pa'i snying po yin la/dpyad pa ma btang bar rags bshad du byas na/ chos dbyings gnyis med ye shes kun khyab tsam rang bzhin dang / chos dbyings de sgrib pa spangs pa'i dag pa gnyis ldan sangs rgyas kyi chos sku ni 'bras bu dang / de thob byed rnam par mi rtog pa'i sgom pa ni lam dang / de gsum po ston byed sangs rgyas kyi bka' ni gzhung sher phyin no/ /zhes kyang rnam par bzhag go/ /gzhan yang theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rgyas pa mtha' dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brjod byar ston par byed pa'i phyir/ nges par na gzhung shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin mod kyi/ sher phyin gyi mtshan mdo thams cad la ma grags pas/skabs 'dir mdo sde gang la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan btags pa de nyid nges par bzung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das ma zhes pa ni/ gong du ji skad bstan pa'i rang bzhin dang 'bras bu sher phyin de nyid/ sangs rgyas nyid yin pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das zhes bya la/ de'i ngo bor sbyor ba thabs dang shes rab zung du 'jug pa yin kyang / skabs 'dir shes rab kyi cha gtso bor smos te/ bcom ldan 'das ma zhes mo rtags kyi sgras bstan pa yin no/ /de ston par byed pa'i gzhung la yang bcom ldan 'das ma zhes mtshan du ga~X zhing / de ltar na bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legagabashad/pa'i mdo 'bum pa la sogs pa thams cad kyi brjod bya'i don 'dus shing /tshig shin tu nyung ngus ston pa'i phyir snying po zhes bya'o/ /mdo rgyas pa de dag dang gzhung 'di la brjod bya'i ngo bo rgya che chung gi khyad par yod par 'dod pa mi 'thad la/ brjod bya ston tshul rnam grangs mi 'dra ba mang nyung gi khyad par ni shin tu che'o/ /de la mkhas pa chen po 'ga' zhig gis 'di skad gsungs te/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ 'bum pa la sogs pa sher mdo mtha' yas pa rnams yin la/ de'i don gyi snying po'am mchog ni rnam thar sgo gsum mo rnam thar sgo gsum rtogs pa'i ye shes ni/ lam she phyin gyi snying po yin la/ de nyid cha tshang bar ston byed kyi mdo yang gzhung sher phyin gyi snying por 'gyur bas/ tshig nyung ngus de 'dra ston pa ni sher phyin gyi snying po'o/ /de yang mdo 'dir stong pa nyid dang mtshan nyid med pa dang / ma skyes pa dang /ma 'gags pa dang / dri ma med pa dang / dri ma dang bral ba med pa dang /bri ba med pa dang / gang ba med pa ste rnam grangs brgyad gsungs so/ /de'i dang po gnyis stong nyid dang / bar pa bzhi mtshan med dang / tha ma gnyis smon med do/ /gzugs sogs chos rnams ngo bo nyid med pa dang / rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis stongs pa'i phyir stong nyid dang / kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten 'brel la bskyed byed kyi rgyu ma grub cing / rnam byang gi rten 'brel la 'gog byed kyi rgyu ma grub pa dang / dri ma ni kun nas nyon mongs yin la/dri ma dang bral ba ni rnam par byang ba'o/ /bzhi po de kun byang gi rgyu'i don dang 'brel bas/ de dag la blang dor gyi mtshan ma ma dmigs pa'i phyir mtshan ma med pa dang / skyon bri ba dang yon tan gyis gang ba ma grub ste/ bsal bzhag med pas na/ skyon spong yon tan thob pa'i phyir mi smon pas smon pa med pa'o/ /de la gcig du bral gyi rig pas ngo bos stongs pa dang / ༵ rje

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/gzegs mas rgyu'i mtshan ma med pa dang / yod med skye 'gog gis 'bras bu la smon pa med pa rnams grub la/ don de tsam zhig gis yum gyi snying por 'gyur zhing / gzhi lam 'bras gsum la rmongs pa sel ba'i don du/ rnam thar sgo gsum du phye ba yin gyi/ ngo bo'i sgo nas ni stong nyid gcig pur 'dus so zhes gsungs te/ gzhung gi tshig don 'chad pa'i skabs rnam pa gzhan du bshad dgos kyang / mtshan don gyi skabs 'dir bshad tshul 'di yang khas blang bar bya'o/ /de la mdo 'dis brjod bya'i don stong nyid kho na gtso bor bstan pa yin na/ stong nyid de yang ji skad du/ chos dbyings bstod pa las/ stong pa nyid ni ston pa'i mdo/ /rgyal bas ji snyed gsungs pa gang / /de dag kun gyis nyon mongs bzlog / khams de nyams par byed ma yin/ /ces dang / rang bzhin gsum la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa las kyang /kun btags dang ni gzhan gyi dbang / /nyon mongs mtshan nyid shes par bya/ /rnam par byang ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /yongs su grub par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes kyang gsungs te/ lung don dang lam bsgoms pas rtog pas brtags pa'i chos nyon mongs rnams 'gog pa yin mod/ yongs grub rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i khams/ chos dbyings dam pa zad mi shes de ni/ stong gzhi'i ngo bor rtag tu yod do/ /de'i phyir stong rkyang du blta bar mi bya ste/dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ gang zhig stong pa kho nar blta gyur pa/ /de ni gsor mi rung zhes rgyal bas gsungs/ /zhes dang / klu sgrub kyis kyang /gang dag stong pa nyid blta ba/ de dag sgrub tu med par gsungs/ /zhes so/ /rang stong par grags pa rnying pa rnams kyis bsams pa/ stong pa yang mi stong pa la bltos pa'i phyir/ mi stong pa'i chos mi srid pas stong pa yang mi sri/ 4de/ de'i phyir kho bo cag bsam byung gi rig pas kyang stong par mi

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/'dzin la/ sgom pa'i tshe gang du yang rnam par mi rtog pa'i phyir skyon med do snyam na/ mi stong pa gtan nas mi srid par go ba de ka bsam byung gi blos stong rkyang du lta ba zang ma yin pa'i steng du/ stong ba yang mi srid par go bas na/ de bas kyang ches shin tu stong par 'dzin pa ma rung bar song ste/ grong khyer gyi mi rnams shi bas stongs par gyur ba'i rjes su/ khyim rnams kyang zhig na ches stongs par 'gyur ba bzhin no/ /des na bsam byung de ni stong bar 'dzin pa yin par grub la/ gzhan yang dngos gzhi mi rtog pa tsam yin du chug kyang / 'dzin pa mngon 'gyur ba'i rnam par rtog pa log pa tsam gyi sgom pa ni/ stong nyid du blta ba rang de min shas che yang de tsam zhig ni sgrib pa gang gi yang gnyen por 'gyur ba ma yin te/ de 'dra de sngar brjod pa'i lta ba de dang 'brel lam ma 'brel/ 'brel na ni/ dngos gzhi'i skabs der 'dzin stangs mi gsal ba'i cha shas kho nas yon tan du ma ster nus shing 'tshengs na ma gtogs/ sbyor ba thos bsam skabs las lhag rgyu ci yang ma byung la/ de ni stong rkyang du 'dzin pa de kho nas bsgos pa yang yin no/ /'dzin stangs mi gsal ba tsam de la ni/ ngo mtshar ba'i phan yon cung zad kyang yod pa ma mthong la de 'dra ba'i rnam rtog rags pa log tsam kho na don du gnyer ba la ni/ stong pa dang mi stong pa'i dpyad pa gang yang sngon du 'gro mi dgos so/ /yang sngar gyi dpyad pa dang phyis kyi sgom pa ma 'brel bas/ thar pa'i don dang sgom pa'i don du dpyad pa de yang mi dgos par 'dod na/thug med kyi dpyad pa 'dis ci zhig bya ste rtsod pa lhur len kho nar zad do/ /de bas na dbu ma 'jug pa las/ rtog rnams log par gyur pa gang yin de/ /rnam par dpyad pa'i 'bras bur mkhas rnams gsungs/ /zhes 'byung ste/lta ba mtho ru re ba'ang thang che che mo/ /don go bde bde 'dra ba/ tshig rdi/sa

sher snying 'grel pa sngon meda'ags bshad/legs ltar snang ba 'di 'dra'i rigs mang pos/ rgya bod kyi mkhas par grags pa phal che ba yang bskus par gyur to/ /des na slob dpon klus byang chub sems 'grel las/ dngos po zhes bya rnam rtog ste/ /rnam rtog med pa stong nyid yin/ /gang la rnam rtog snang yod pa/ /de la stong nyid ga la yod/ /ces gsungs te/ de'i phyir stong nyid dngos ni ye shes yin la/ ye shes shar ba dang rnam rtog nub pa 'gros gcig pa las/ cir yang ma grub tsam gyi stong nyid ni de 'dra ma yin te/ rnam rtog gi snang ba ma nyams par yod kyang de'i snang ba yod pa yang mi 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /de bas na stong nyid tsam la spyi ldog nas/ rgyan las/ med pa'i stong pa nyid shes shing / /de bzhin yod pa'i stong nyid dang / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid shes na/ /stong nyid shes pa zhes brjod do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar kun btags rnams ni/ zhen yul du shar ba tsam ma gtogs/ gnas lugs la lta ci smos/ kun rdzob kyi shes pa rlang pos gzhigs na/ shes pa kun rdzob pa de'i ngor yang ma grub pa'i phyir/med pa'i stong pa nyid ces bya ste/ de'i phyir thos bsam sgom gsum gyi rim pas/ med par shes dgos pa tsam zhig yin pas shes byar bshad la/gzhan dbang ni med bzhin du dngos por 'khrul ba'i blo la dngos por gsal bar snang ba yin pas/ 'khrul snang rgyu dang bcas pa spang dgos pas spang bya dang / kun rdzob kyi shes pa la gsal bar snang ba yin pas yod pa'i stong nyid de rgya skad du sa ta zhes pa yod pa'i dngos po'i don no/ /yongs grub ni dri ma sbyang ba'i gzhi/ gdod nas chos kun gyi rang bzhin du yod pa yin rkokyang / /de ltar ma rtogs pa'i dri ma sbyong dgos shing / mngon sumadu rtogs shing thob par bya dgos pas na/ sbyang gzhi dang / thob bya dang / reg pa/ ༵ ba yin cing / rang gi ngo bo don dam yang yin/ spros bral gyi stong
