sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/nyid kyang yin/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin du gnas pa yang yin/ glo bur gyi dri ma'am 'khrul snang gis gdod nas stongs pa yang yin pas de la rang bzhin stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /de ltar na stong nyid rnam pa gsum gyi dbye ba 'di ma shes na/ 'khor lo gsum gyi mdo sde rnams las stong nyid kyi rnam gzhag mang po gsungs pa'i dngos bstan yang rtogs par mi 'gyur na/dgongs don lta smos kyang ci dgos la/ 'di shes pas na dngos bstan dang dgongs don mtha' dag la mkhas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo rnams las/ rab 'byor gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa chen po ni/ nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid bying / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yin no/ /zhes gsungs 'o na shes rab snying po'i mdo 'dir stong pa nyid bcu drug tshang bar gsungs sam ma gsungs zhe na/ 'dir stong nyid kho na brjod bya'i gtso bor gsungs mod/ dngos bstan tshig zin la bcu drug gi rab dbye mi gsal gsungs pa ma yin kyang / shugs la bcu drug rdzogs par bstan te/ mig med ces sogs kyis nang za ba po stong pa nyid dang / gzugs med 3)sa

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/sogs kyis phyi bza' ba stong pa nyid dang / khams bco brgyad med par bstan pas bzung snang dang rnam shes kyi sprel thag rten dang bcas pa bkag pas phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / gzugs sogs bkag pas/ gnas snod kyi 'jig rten chen po stong pa nyid dang / ye shes med ces pas/ lam gyi ye shes dang de'i rnam pa bkag pa'i phyir/ don dam stong pa nyid dang / stong nyid stong pa nyid gnyis bstan no/ /lam med ces pas/ 'dus byas kyi dge ba ste/ 'dus byas stong nyid dang / 'gog pa med ces pas 'dus ma byas stong nyid dang / thob pa dang ma thob pa med par bstan pas dge ba mi zad pa'i phyir dor ba med pa stong nyid dang / sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung med ces pas sems can la phan pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / sdug kun nyid 'khor ba yin na de bkag pas 'khor ba la spang byar zhen pa bkag pa'i phyir/ thog mtha' med pa stong nyid dang / dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad sher phyin zab mo 'di la bsten ces pas/rigs rnam par dag pa rang bzhin stong nyid dang / sngags kyi phan yon rnams kyis ni gzugs sku dang chos sku'i yon tan dag bstan pa'i phyir/mtshan dpe dang stobs sogs bsgrub pa'i phyir du rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid rnams bstan pa yin te/ de ltar na bcu bzhi yin cing / gang zag dang chos kyi bdag med pa ni dngos po med pa stong nyid de/ dbu zhabs thams cad du bstan la/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni/ stong nyid khyad gzhir byas nas/ gzugs sogs 'gog pa dang gzhan yang don dam gzhan stong chen po gsal bar —bstan pa'i tshig rnams kyis bstan to/ /mi dmigs pa stong nyid ni dngos med sto zlo nyid dang don gcig la ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni dngos med ngo bo nyid

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/dang don gcig go/ /ldog cha'i khyad par ni/ dngos med stong nyid ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas ma grub pa dang / mi dmigs pa ni ye shes kyi ngo bor dmigs su med cing mthong rgyu med pa'i don no/ /ngo bo nyid ni phyin ci ma log pa'i rang bzhin de lam gyis gsar du ma bcos pa'i don dang / dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi don ni dngos po rnams gdod nas ma grub pa'i shul na chos nyid mi g.yo zhing brtan par gnas pa'i don no/ /de bzhin du stong nyid nyi shu'i dbang du byas na/ rang gi ngo bo stong pa nyid ni/ dngos med stong nyid dang gcig la gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid ni dngos med ngo bo nyid dang gcig go/ /rnam gzhag 'di ni shin tu gsal bar sngags kyi theg pa bla na med pa'i rgyud gnyis las 'byung ba dang / mdo lugs kyi dbus mtha' rnam 'byed rtsa 'grel dang /yum gsum gnod 'joms dang / brgyad stong don bsdu sogs las shes par bya'o/ /de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo 'di ni/ spros pa'i mtha' bcu 'am/ rnam g.yeng gi rnam par rtogs pa bcu'i gnyen por yang gsungs pa yin te/ ji skad du/ rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis ni med dang yod pa dang / /sgro 'dogs skur ba'i rtogs dang gcig dang du ma nyid/ /rang dang khyad par rtogs dang ming don ji bzhin du/ /mngon par zhen pa'i rtogs pa yang dag spang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod ces bya ba ni/med pa'i rnam g.yeng gi gnyen por bstan to/ /phung po lnga po de dag kyang rang bzhin gyis stong pa zhes pa ni yod pa'i rnam g.yeng gi gnyen po'o/ /gzugs stong pa'o zhes pa ni sgro 'dogs pa'i gnyen po'o/ /stong pa nyid gzugs so zhes pa ni skur 'debs kyi gnyen po'o/ /stong pa nyid la gzugs med ces sogs ni/ stong nyid dang dngos po gcig par rtogs pa'i gnyen po~X/ /

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin/ stong pa nyid las kyang ṅkagazugs gzhan ma yin ces pa ni/ tha dad du rtogs pa'i gnyen po'o/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid de zhes pa ni/ kun rdzob kyi chos rnams rang gi ngo bos spub par rtogs pa'i gnyen po'o/ /ma skyes pa nas gang ba med pa'i bar ni skye ba la sogs pa khyad par du rtogs pa'i gnyen po'o/ /thob pa med ces pas/ chos rnams kyi thob tshul spyir bkag pas bye brag tu 'brel ba bkag par 'gyur la/ de'i phyir ming don gyi 'brel pa yang bkag pa ste/ ming ji lta ba bzhin don du rtogs pa dang / don ji lta ba bzhin ming du rtogs pa'i gnyen po'o/ /gzhan yang gzugs sogs dngos po nyid bkag pas/ kun rdzob rnams don du med pa'i ming rkyang tsam du go bar 'gyur bas/ don dam du ming don gnyis gdod nas ma thub cing / kun rdzob tu yang ming don gnyis blo kun btags kyis sprel ba ma gtogs/ don la ming gis stongs pa dang / ming la don gyis stongs pa yin no/ /de lta bas na/ rgyal ba ston pa nyid kyi zhal snga nas/ 'khor lo dang por gtogs pa stong pa nyid kyi mdo chen po las kyang / kun dga' bo de lta bas na/ gang la gang med pa de des stong ngo zhes bya bar/ yang dag par rjes su mthong yang des lhag ma gang yod pa de/ de la yod do zhes bya bar yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu shes te/kun dga' bo 'di lta ste/ zag pa rnams zad pas zag pa med cing mngon par 'dus ma byas pa rnam par grol ba gang yin pa 'di ni/ stong pa nyid la 'jug pa bla na med pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / chen po stong pa nyid kyi mdo las kyang / phyi dang nang dang phyi nang stong pa nyid gsum gsungs pa yang de dang 'dra la/ 'khor lo bar pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo rgyas pa nāms las kyang / de la gzhan gyi dngos po stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ de

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/bzhin gshegs pa rnams byung yang rung / ma byung yang rung / chos gnas pa nyid dang / chos nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings dang / chos skyon med pa nyid dang / de bzhin nyid dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid dang / gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' de ni gnas pa nyid de/de ltar gzhan gyis stong pa gang yin pa de ni gzhan gyi dngos po stong pa nyid ces bya'o/ /rab 'byor de ni byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa chen po yin no/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'khor lo tha ma'i mdo rnams las ni lhag par yang rgyas shing gsal bar gsungs te/ bka' 'khor lo gsum char gyi dngos bstan dang / shugs bstan dang / dgongs don gyi gtso bo'i stong pa nyid ni/gzhan stong dbu ma chen po kho na yin gyi/ srid tshad thams cad rang stong du 'dod pa'i lugs ltar gsungs pa ni med do/ /de lta bas na kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad gdod ma nas rang gi ngo bos stongs par 'jog pa'i grub mtha' ni/rang stong rnam dag rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin yang / mthar thug don dam dbyings kyang / rang gi ngo bos stongs par 'dod pa ni/ shin tu ches log par lta ba yin pas/ de gnyis bsdoms pa'i grub mtha' thal rang gi lugs 'di dag ni kha zas bzang po dug can dang 'dra la kun rdzob thams cad rang stong dang / don dam dbyings gzhan stong du 'khyer shes pa/ zung 'jug gi lta ba yon tan kun dang ldan pa 'di ni/ chos nyid kyi gnas lugs dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa'o/ /de'i rgyu mtshan choganyid rtag tu gnas pa bden thub la bden med do zhes skur ba btab pas/ don dam pa'i chos dkon mchog la sdig bsags pa dang / chos sku don dam de kun khyab yin pa la kun khyab min zhes dang / kun khyab kyi chos nyid yon tan kun ldan layon tan med ces don dam pa'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog la /ra

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/ba btab pa'i nyes pa chen po dang / 'phags chen rnams kyi mnyam bzhag rnam pa kun ldan yin pa la ci yang snang ba med do/ /zhes dge 'dun dkon mchog la smad pa'i kha na ma tho ba ches mi bzad pa dang bcas pa rnams ni thal rang par grags pa rnams la thog tu babs pa dang / gzhan stong smra ba rnams ni skyon de las grol ba'i phyir ro/ /da ni tshig gi don la 'jug par bya ste/ /1 rtsa ba'i sa brjikā spyad ṭī hār+sha :slang ba'i tshul gyi de yang mdo 'di 'chad par byed pa la/ dang por gling bslang ba'i tshul gyis ngo mtshar bskyed pa dang / bar du zab cing rgya che'i don gtan la dbab pa dang / mthar yi rang mngon par bstod pa ste don gsum las/shā po la/ gling gzhi'i tshig dang / mdo sde'i chos 'byung ba'i sgo gnyis dang po ni/ 'di skad pa// r+shahā ༈sa mi / zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ de la 'di skad ces pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa'i chos de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di skad dam 'di ltar te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das zhes pa nas rjes su yi rang ngo zhes pa'i mthar thug pa 'di skad du thos zhes pa yin pas/de ltar na chos phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /bdag ces pa ni bsdud pa po phyag na rdo rje bdag gis dngos su thos pa ste/ mdo sde dam pa 'di gsung ba'i dus na/ston pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs pa der mngon sum du rang nyid yod pas na/ gzhan las brgyud de thos pa ni ma yin no zhes pa'o/ /ston pa ni rnam pa12 'phrul ba sku ma lta bu la mnga' brnyes pa'i phyir/ dbyar dang ston la

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/sogs pa'i dus 'di lta bu'o zhes nges bzungs su ma brjod par/ dus —gcig na zhes yangs pa'i sgra smos te dus phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes pa la lha ga lhan gyi sgra las drangs na/ legs pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i phyir legs ldan nam/ nyes skyon dang 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad bcom zhing zhig pa dang /gzhan gyi nyes skyon rnams 'joms par mdzad pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan zhes bya la gang rang nyid skyon spangs shing yon tan kun dang ldan la/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal sel bar mdzad pa de ni/ skyabs dang skyob pa dang / skyes bu dam pa bla na med pa yin pas/ shākya thub pa bcom ldan 'das de ni/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /'das zhes pa'i sgra ni/'jig rten las 'das pa'am 'khor ba pa dang theg dman pa'i spyod yul las 'das pa'i don du sbyor zhing / 'jig rten gyi lha khyab 'jug nag po sogs la yang 'jig rten du legs ldan dang bcom ldan du grags pa las/ khyad par 'byed cing mi nor ba'i phyir dang po'i lo tsā bas bcug pa'o zhes grags pa ni/spyir de ltar yin la/ 'das pa'i skad dod med do zhes kun tu grags na/bha ga lhan zhes pa/ bha ga bcom pa dang / wān ldan pa'i skad dod yin pa bzhin du/ 'das pa'i skad dod zhig bcom pa dang ldan pa'i skad dod las logs su yod pa ma yin kyang / de nyid la 'das pa'i don yod du rung pa ni/bha ga zhes pa nyid kyi/ bha la yi ge bsnan pas/ a lha wi ṣ+pe ti ste 'byung bar mi 'gyur ba dang / ga ni ga ti ste song ba zhes pa yin pas/ song zhing mi 'byung ba ni/ yang dag pa'i gnas su song zhing log pa'i gnas su mi 'byung ba ste/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i don no/ /de'i phyir mi nor ba'i ched kho nar skad dod dang ma 'brel ba zhig glo bur du dbang che'i rig pas /spyan

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/pa ma yin gyi skad dod dang yang 'brel ba nyid yin no/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab kyi shar phyogs kyang yin la de'i sa yul du gtogs pa na/ dka' thub kyi gnas bya rgod phung po'i ri bo yod pa yin te/ de yang sems can phal pa rnams kyi snang ngo ltar na/ yul phyogs dang thong khyer de dang ri bo der snang ba yin la byang chub sems dpa' dbang thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis gzigs pa'i spyod yul ltar na/ ngo bo chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang bzhin/rnam par dag pa'i zhing mchog gzhal med khang dang bcas pa ste/ de skad du gser 'od dam pa sogs las kyang / bya rgod phung po chos kyi dbyings/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul na/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis phyi nang gi bya rgod phung po de ni/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po zhes pa la/ spyir byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong yang shin tu mang mod kyi/ 'dir dge slong zhes pa 'di ni nyan thos kyi yin la/ de las kyang phal che ba ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa yin pas/ don dam pa'i dge slong yang yin mod kyi/ khyad par du so so thar pa rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan dge slong gi sdom pa dang ldan pa kho na'o/ /kha cig gsol bzhi'i las kyi dge slong kho na'o zhes zer ba ni ma brtags pa ste/ ye shes khong chud kyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'ang mang du yod la/ tshur shog gi bsnyen par rdzogs pa ni shin tu mang ba'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun ces pa la/ phyir sems yang dag par bskyed pa'i so so skye bo yang byang chub sems dpa' yin mod kyi/'dir ni theg chen 'phags pa rnams bzung ste/ don dam pa'i sems rkobaskyed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyes pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems tsam bskyed pa na/ bla na med pa'i byang /ba kyi go 'phang la dmigs nas/ sems can thams cad de la 'god

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/pa ma yin gyi skad dod dang yang 'brel ba nyid yin no/ /grong khyer rgyal po'i khab kyi shar phyogs kyang yin la de'i sa yul du gtogs pa na/ dka' thub kyi gnas bya rgod phung po'i ri bo yod pa yin te/ de yang sems can phal pa rnams kyi snang ngo ltar na/ yul phyogs dang thong khyer de dang ri bo der snang ba yin la byang chub sems dpa' dbang thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis gzigs pa'i spyod yul ltar na/ ngo bo chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang bzhin/rnam par dag pa'i zhing mchog gzhal med khang dang bcas pa ste/ de skad du gser 'od dam pa sogs las kyang / bya rgod phung po chos kyi dbyings/ /zab mo sangs rgyas spyod yul na/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyis phyi nang gi bya rgod phung po de ni/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po zhes pa la/ spyir byang chub sems dpa'i dge slong yang shin tu mang mod kyi/ 'dir dge slong zhes pa 'di ni nyan thos kyi yin la/ de las kyang phal che ba ni/ nyan thos dgra bcom pa yin pas/ don dam pa'i dge slong yang yin mod kyi/ khyad par du so so thar pa rigs brgyad kyi nang tshan dge slong gi sdom pa dang ldan pa kho na'o/ /kha cig gsol bzhi'i las kyi dge slong kho na'o zhes zer ba ni ma brtags pa ste/ ye shes khong chud kyi bsnyen par rdzogs pa'ang mang du yod la/ tshur shog gi bsnyen par rdzogs pa ni shin tu mang ba'i phyir ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun ces pa la/ phyir sems yang dag par bskyed pa'i so so skye bo yang byang chub sems dpa' yin mod kyi/'dir ni theg chen 'phags pa rnams bzung ste/ don dam pa'i sems rkobaskyed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyes pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems tsam bskyed pa na/ bla na med pa'i byang /ba kyi go 'phang la dmigs nas/ sems can thams cad de la 'god

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/par 'dod pa'i sems pa tsam yod kyang / byang chub kyi rang bzhin mngon sum du ma mthong bas/ byang chub la ji lta ba bzhin du sems par mi nus la/'phags pa rnams kyi chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i chos nyid de byang chub kyi rang bzhin yin pas/ don dam sems bskyed thob pa na/ byang chub la dngos su sems nus pa'o/ /yang na sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs dang 'dra ba'i gnas skabs thob pa na/ byang chub kyi phyir du spyod pa mthu dang ldan par spyod pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyes pa la byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ste/ bo dhi sa twa zhes pa la/ bo d+dha ni byang chub yin la/ sems dpa'i skad dod sa twa zhes pa ni/ snying stobs sam mthu nus la yang 'jug pas so/ / dge 'dun zhes pa la spyir don mang du bshad du yod kyang /'dir re zhig tshogs pa dang 'dus pa'i don yin la/ chen po ni grangs mang ba dang / thams cad kyang 'phags pa kho na yin pa'i phyir ches bzang ba'i don no/ /de dag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la blta ba dang / dam pa'i chos nyan pa dang / sems can rnams la phan pa'i don du/ dgongs pa gcig pa dang / bya ba gcig pa dang / gnas gcig tu 'dus pas na thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa ste 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /yang na bka' bsdud pa po phun sum tshogs pa logs su bgrangs shing nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni 'khor tsam dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun ni ched du bya ba'i gdul bya phun sum tshogs pa ste/ phun sum tshogasapa bdun du rnam par bzhag kyang rung la/ yang na bsdud pa po tsam logs su byas nas/ khyad chos kyi phun sum tshogs pa lnga dang ldan pa'i khyad gzhi/ bstan pa dam chos phun tshogs zhes bshad kyang rung ngo / /dus gcig na zhes pa dus kyi khyad par ma nges pa dang / thos pa zhigapa dngos su thos pa kho na la 'jog pa ni/ theg pa spyan

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/po'i mdo phal che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ nyan thos kyi mdo phal che ba dus kyi khyad par nges pa can yin pa dang / bka' bsdu ba po kun dga' bo lta bus kyang / mdo sde dngos su thos pa yang yod/ dngos su ma thos par brgyud nas thos pa yang yod ces bshad cing / chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong las/ stong phrag nyi shu tsam brgyud nas thos par bshad pa yang yod pas/bshad sgros gcig gi phyogs zhen la brten nas/ rnam grangs du ma 'byung ba rnams dgag par mi bya'o/ /de bzhin du thos pa zhes pa thos pa tsam yin gyi/sangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo rtogs par ma nus so zhes 'chad pa yang chos kyi che ba dbyung ba'i skabs 'ga' zhig tu yin gyi rnam pa thams cad du 'chad dgos pa ma yin no/ /yang kha cig gling gzhi zhal nas gsungs pa'i bka' byas nas/ ston 'khor gcig pa'i rnam gzhag mdzad pa ni/ lugs gzhan yin pas pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / phar phyin theg pa 'di'i phyogs mtshungs kyi sngags rgyud rnams la sbyar bar mi bya'o/ /'di la dpal phyogs kyi glang po'i zhal snga nas/ ston pa dpang po 'khor dang ni/ /yul dang dus kyi ngas bstan pa/ /bsdud po rang nyid tshad mar ni/ /rab grub phyir yin 'jig rten na/ /yul dang dus kyang nyer mtshon cing / /dpang por bcas pa smra ba yi/ /smra bo tshad mar rjes su rtogs/ /zhes brgyad stong don bsdu las gsungs te/ ston pa dang yul dus nges pa dang / 'khor tshogs dpang por bzhag nas bshad pas/ smra ba po'i tshig yid ches can du 'gyur ba'i phyir dang /gzhung mdzes par 'gyur pas dad ldan 'jug pa'i yan lag go/ /ci'i phyir gzhung mdzes par 'gyur snyam na/ mdo sde phal che ba ni zhu ba dang / zhu lan spel ba'i tshul yin pas/ de 'dra la ni gleng gzhi ma smos par/ zhu lan kho na brdo/ thabs su bkod na/ mgo bcad pa'i shing bzhin mi mdzes par

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/'gyur ba las/ gleng gzhi bkod pas 'brel chags shing brjid bag chen por snang bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /dri med bshes gnyen na re/ 'khor gyi ming ma smos pas dpang po yin par yang mi grub cing / yul de dag tu song zhing dris na nges pa rnyed par 'gyur srid kyang / de ltar mi nus pa rnams kyis mdo don la nges pa mi rnyed par thal bar 'gyur ro zhes phyogs kyi glang po 'gog pa ni/ rigs pa yang ltar snang yin la/ dgag yul gyi sa mtshams yang ma zin pa'o/ /de'i rang lugs la chos nyan pa'i skal ba yod pa rnams 'dir smos pa yin zhes zer ba ni/ rang gi ji skad ston pa'i skyon de thog tu babs te/ ming ma smos pa'i phyir/ skal ba dang ldan pa yang su yin nges pa mi rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin du bzhugs te zhes pa'i skabs su/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i gnas pa rnam thar sgo gsum dang / lha'i gnas pa bsam gtan gzugs med kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / tshangs pa'i gnas pa tshad med bzhi'i sgo nas bzhugs zhes 'chad pa yang / don dang ma 'brel zhing / 'og tu zab mo snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs par bshad pas/de dag ni dgos med lhag po'i bshad par snang la/ yang sku spyod lam dang /gsung chos gsung ba dang / thugs ting nge 'dzin gyis gnas pas bzhugs zhes 'chad pa yang / spros bshad kho nar bas so/ /'di skad ces pa'isgroskabs su/ 'di skad kho na yin gyi/ tshul gzhan gyi sgo nas ma yin te/don gzhan nam tshig gzhan gyi rim pas byung ngam snyam pa'i the tshom gcod pa'o/ /yang 'di skad ces pas/ 'di kho na ltar yin gyi tshig dang don gyi rim pa gzhan ni ma yin no/ /zhes mdo tshig 'di dag la lhag chad la sogs pa'i 'khrul ba med par bstan no/ /zhes kyang 'chad pa rnam grangs su ni rung la/ 'khor gyi grangs la kha cig stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge 'dun kāng /

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/dge slong lnga stong tsam gyi dge 'dun zhes/ mdo sde gzhan dag las 'byung ba la/ kha yar ba stong phrag lnga la/ bzhi tshan du bsdebs na/ bzhi tshan pa stong nyis rgya lnga bcu 'byung bas/ de gnyis don gcig go zhes zer ba yang blun gtam du snang ngo / /mdo 'di la yang sher mdo rgyas pa bzhin du/ dge slong lnga stong dang / bzang skyong la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' zhes 'chad pa ni/ mdo 'di nyid las grangs dang dmigs bsal ma gsungs pa dang / sher mdo rgyas pa'i dus dang 'khor sogs dang / 'di'i dus dang pa/shā // pa sdu// pa kho na'i rgyu mtshan mi snang bas/ rang bzo'i bshad gnyis pa mdo sde/ sbyi/ma / // /spra r+shabyu sdo ba'i sdo/'i tshe bcom ldan 'das zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ de'i tshe zhes pa ni/ 'khor 'dus pa de'i tshe zhes pa yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang de'i tshe ched du bya ba'i gdul bya rnams yongs su smin pas chos 'di bstan na grol bar 'gyur nges pa'i dus yin par mkhyen pa'o/ /des na zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba la/ zab mo ni shin tu rtogs par dka' ba ste/ chos kyi dbyings spros bral nam du yang 'gyur ba med la rnam pa thams cad pa yang yin pa ste/ de mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes de snang ba ste/zab mo snang ba de dang ldan pa'i mnyam bzhag gi thugs ni zab mo snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin no/ /sgra bshad de ni sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa spyi la tshang ba yin kyang / spyi mang bye brag la btags pa'i tshul gyis/ bshad pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di 'byung ba'i rgyu ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par la de skad ces bya ba yin no/ 8/de yang dngos su na/ de bzhin gshegs pa ting nge 'dzin thams cad

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa yin pas/ skabs 'dir zab mo snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la gsar du mnyam par bzhag pa ma yin kyang / ched du bya ba'i gdul bya rnams kyi snang ngor/ ting nge 'dzin de la gsar du mnyam par bzhag par bstan pa yin no/ /yang dag par na sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa ni/ sangs rgyas kho na'i spyod yul las gzhan ma yin mod/ ston pa'i gzugs kyi sku ni gdul bya'i snang ngor bstan pa'i nges pa las/ gang gdul bya rnams kyis ji lta bu zhig mthong bar 'gyur ba/ de lta bur byin gyisasgrobarlabs pas de ltar snang ba yin te/ lung las kyang / ston pas 'jig rten pa'i thugs bskyed pa'i tshe/ srog chags grog sbyar phyin chad kyis kyang ston pa'i thugs shes so zhes 'byung ba lta bu'o/ /yang de'i tshe zhes pa ni/ de kho nar ma zad gzhan yang zhes pa ste/ ston pa nyid ting nge 'dzin de la mnyam par bzhag ma thag de'i tshe'o/ / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zhes pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' ni gong du bshad zin la/sems dpa' chen po ni/ dag pa'i sa la gnas pa dag la spyi khyab tu 'jug pa tsam yin yang / gtso bor 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur ba thob pa/de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyal tshab rnams so/ /de'i sgra bshad pa ni/ yon tan rin po che bsdus pa las/ ci phyir 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' bya zhe na/chags pa gcod byed kun nas chags pa zad par 'dod/ rgyal ba rnams kyi byang chub chags med 'gyur la reg des na 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i ming thob bo/ /ci phyir 'di ni sems dpa' che zhes bya zhe na/ sems can tshogs rnams mang po'i mchog tu gyur pa dang / /sems can khams kyi lha rnams chen po gcod pa ste/ /de phyir 'di ni sems dpa' che zhes rab brjod do/ /gtong ba che dang blo che ba dang mthu che dang / /rgyal ba rnams kyi theg byen

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/mchog la zhugs pa dang / /go cha chen po bsgos shing bdud kyi rgyu 'dul ba/ /de yi phyir na sems dpa' che zhes brjod pa yin/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /tshigs bcad 'di dag gi sbas don 'og tu yang 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs ni don gnas tshul la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid yin la/ 'jig rten khams gzhan mang po zhig tu sangs rgyas nyid du yang ston mod kyi/ sangs rgyas gzhan thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul yang ston pa'i phyir/ gdul bya rnams kyi snang tshul gtso che ba'i dbang du byas nas de ltar smos la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la spyod cing nyams su len pa'i tshul gyis yang dag pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog cing / lhag pa'i shes rab kyis rnam par blta la zhes spyir smos nas/ khyad par du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la 'jug pa'i sgo phung po lnga po de dag rang bzhin gyis te gdod nas stong par rnam par blta'o/ /de dag kyang ces kyang yi ge sgras/ khams dang skye mched la sogs pa 'jug sgo thams cad kyang bstan no/ /de yang mdo 'di'i rgyas bshad gsung ba po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin pas/ chos kyi rnam grangs kyi tshig 'di dag 'byung ba'i gzhi/ don dam stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes de gsar du bskyed pa'i tshul bstan pa yin zhing / phung po lnga sogs stong par bsgoms so zhes bstan pa ni/ rjes 'jug rnams kyis kyang phung sogs stong nyid du sdosgoms pas/ sher phyin gyi ye shes rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes go ba'i ched 50

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/2 rtsa ba'i sa bar+shar+sha sna/sna ༵ r+shakā hāshāb cing che ba'i gnyis pa bar du zab cing rgya che ba'i don gtan la dbab pa la/ dri sdushā tram̐ /snro nākā rgyas par gtan la phab pa dang / mthun gyur gyi sgo nas the gcig dris lan gyi sgonas sa par gtan la dbab pa/dang po la/ dris pa dang / lan gnyis so/ / (1)dri/kā/ po ni/ de nas sangs rgyasakyi mthus zhes pa la sogs pa ste/ de yang skabs de'i gdul bya rnams kyi snang tshul gyi dbang du byas te/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu ni shes rab can gyi mchog yin pa'i phyir/ zab mo'i chos 'di lta bu la gleng bar 'os pa yin la/ 'on kyang theg chen gyi chos zab mo 'di nyan thos rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin pas/ 'di 'dri ba yang rang stobs ma yin gyi sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthu yin no/ /don du ni/shā ri'i bu yang byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhig nyan thos kyi tshul bzung ba yin par nges pas/ theg chen gyi chos la dbang bsgyur bar mi nus pa ste ma yin mod/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi mthu ni yin te/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde dge thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mthu nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo zhes pa ni/ skyes pa dang bud med de/de las gzhan ma ning gi 'gro ba ni chos spyod pa la mthu chung bar dgongs 5sdus

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/ma smos pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyad pa spyod par 'dod pa ni zhes pa la/ spyir byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ theg dman la mos pa rnams kyi ched du byang chub phyogs mthun gyi spyod pa dang /theg chen la mos pa rnams kyi ched du phar phyin drug gi spyod pa dang / de gnyis ka mdun pa'i phyir du mngon shes kyi spyod pa dang / gnyis ka gdul ba'i phyir du sems can yongs smin gyi spyod pa ste bsdu dngos bzhi'o/ /de —thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod par mi 'du ste/ thams cad shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rtogs pa'i thabs yin pas so/ /de ltar yang rgyal tshab chen pos/ lus can theg pa chen po dang / /theg pa dman la mos pa rnams/ /gnyis ka mdun par bya ba dang / /gdul ba'i phyir ni brtan rnams kyi/ /spyod pa bzhi po mdo bzhin du/ /rjes su 'brangs nas bshad pa yin/ /ces so/ /don 'di ni 'phags pa dkon mchog brtsegs pa'i nang tshan gtsug na rin po ches zhus pa'i mdo las 'byung ngo / /de dag las kyang las dang po bas lag len du 'debs sla ba'i dbang du byas nas/ chos spyod bcu ste/ de ltar yang / yi ge 'bri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang len pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang sgom pa ste/ /spyod pa de bcu'i bdag nyid ni/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo sde la/chos spyod bcu'i sgo nas nan tan du bsgrubs pa ni/ sher phyin zab mo la spyad pa spyod pa ste/ 'dis ni sher phyin rtogs pa'i rgyu thabs kyi phyogs rnams kyang gsal bar bstan pa'o/ /'dir 'grel chen ltar na/ rigs kyi bu mo zhes pa mi 'don zhing / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang jig ces bod pa yang me/ 2par/ rigs kyi bu gang la la zhes 'don te/ rigs kyi bu zhes pa

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/sangs rgyas kyi sras yin pa'i phyir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la bod pa'i tshig tu bshad mod kyi/ don bsgyur zhing bshad na de ltar 'byung srid kyang /sgras zin ltar na/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la ma gas pa'i tshig tu py-i gyur bas/ mdo 'don tshul de dang bshad tshul de mi legs par mthong (2)drikā /sa/ pa la/ sher phyin la spyod tshul mdor bstan pa dang / sher phyin gyi ngo bo rgyas par bstan pa dang / de rtogs pa'i lam gyi yon tan dang /lam des thob pa'i 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur tshul dang / phan yon dang zlo/kā dṛ r+sha //rdo ༵ /gas bstagapa dang / don bsdu'i tshul du sher phyin dang po ni/ / kā kau py-i // shāl sdu /kā ba stan ṭ+wā/sa pa la sogs pa ste/gang la la ces pa snga phyi gnyis ni/ gang ci yang rung ba sher phyin la spyod par 'dod pa de thams cad ces pa'i don no/ /'di ltar rnam par blta bar bya zhes pa ni/ de ma thag tu 'chad par 'gyur ba 'di ltar shin tu sgom par bya zhes pa ste/ chos spyod bcudang phar phyin drug dang bsdu dngos bzhi sogs spyod pa bzhi po gang la 'jug kyang / rang gzhan snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i phung po lnga po de dag rang bzhin gdod ma nas stong par blta ba ste/ stong par mngon sum du mthong ba'am/ mos pa'am/ myong ba'i sgo nas shin tu rnam par te lan mang po dang / yun ring por sgom pa'o/ /kyang gi sgras rnam grangs gzhan bstan pa yang gong dang 'dra ste/ mdor na sbyin sogs spyonā pa

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/thams cad spros bral rtogs pa'i lta bas zin pa zhig dgos so zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa sher phyi/ ra/ shā gā ṭ+wāṃ pa ṭā sdo ṭā // da/ la/ / zab mo'i mtshan nyid rnam pa brgyad kyi sgo nas rang bzhin sher phyin gtan la phab/ mkhas ༵༵ ṭ+wāṃ ba'i dngos po drug la mkhas pa'i sgo nas lam sher phyin ji ltar sgom (1)chas skegarwa//shā trī sdu/gā rasar bzhin sheradang po ni gzugs stong pa'o sogs te/ stong pa nyid dang / mtshan nyid med pa dang / ma skyes pa dang / ma 'gags pa dang / dri ma med pa dang / dri bral med pa dang / bri ba med pa dang / gang ba med pa ste/brgyad las dang po stong nyid cung zad rgyas par bshad cing / lhag ma gzhan rnams des rigs bsgros na go bla bar dgongs nas ming tsam smos pa'o/ /de la phung po lnga sogs dang / de dag stong par shes pa la/ thog mar shes bya spyi'i rnam gzhag rgyas pa shes na ni legs la/ shin tu blo gros zhan pas kyang 'di tsam zhig shes dgos te/ 'dir shes par bya ba'i chos thams cad ni mdor bsdu na/ dngos po'i 'dus byas su gtogs pa dang / 'dus ma byas su gtogs pa gnyis so/ /dngos po'i 'dus byas de yang gzugs can du snang ba dang shes pa dang de dag gi gnas skabs la btags pa ste gsum du yod la/ dang po gnyis ni dngos po dngos yin la/ phyi ma ni btags pa paX / /de'i dang po ni yul dpyad pas gzugs su rung ba sto reg pa bskyed pa

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/dang / thogs pa dang bcas pa sogs/ dbang shes kyi spyod yul lam rten gyi mtshan nyid can no/ /de yang rgyu'i gzugs can ni/ sra ba dang / gsher ba dang / dro ba dang / g.yo ba'i rang bzhin gyi rdul te/ 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung rnams so/ /'bras bu'i gzugs can ni/ dkar dmar sngo ser la sogs pa kha dog dang / gru bzhi skuyopo la sogs pa dbyibs te gzugs dang / thos par bya ba snyan pa dang / mi snyan pa dang / yang na glu snye dbyangs lta bu sems can gyi rgyud du gtogs pa dang / chu sgra lta bu der mi gtogs pa ste sgra dang / snoms pa na zhim mi zhim gyi khyad par sogs dri dang /mngar skyur la sogs pa'i ro dang / 'jam tsub la sogs pa'i reg bya mang po zhig dang / mig rna ba sna lce lus kyi dbang po ste de rnams ni/ rgyu 'byung ba las byung zhing / dngos su 'byung ba rnams dang 'brel bas na/ 'byung ba las gyur pa'i gzugs zhes bya'o/ /spyir 'byung ba rnams kyang reg bya'i nang du 'du ste/ sra ba'i rig bya la sogs pa'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na gzugs sogs lnga dang / mig sogs lnga ste bcu po de dag ni/ gzugs kyi khams dang gzugs kyi skye mched nas/ lus kyi khams dang lus kyi skye mched kyi bar du/ khams bcu dang skye mched bcu yin la/ thams cad kyang gzugs can du snang ba yin pa'i phyir/ gzugs kyi phung po zhes bya'o/ /'gro ba drug gi lus dang / phyi rol gyi ri dang / ljon shing dang / chu bo dang /rgya mtsho dang / bza' ba dang btung ba la sogs pa/ gnas lus longs spyod 'di dag thams cad ni/ gzugs can bcu po de dag phan tshun du tshogs shing 'dres pa'i gong bu yin pas de dag las gzhan du mi bsam mo/ /gnyis pa shes pa ni/ dbang po lnga'i rnam shes dang / yid kyi rnam shes te drug ni rnam shes rags pa dang / bdag tu snang ba'i nyon yid ni 'bring po spyang /

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/de kun la khyab pa'i kun gzhi ni phra ba ste/ de dag thams cad rnam par shes pa'i phung po yin pa dang / mig gi rnam par shes pa'i khams nas yid shes kyi khams kyi bar du khams drug dang / yid khams te bdun ni/ skye mched kyi skabs yid kyi skye mched gcig pu yang yin te/ 'on kyang kun gzhi rnam shes ni chos khams su bsdu ba'ang snang ba logs su dpyad par byar yod do/ /dbang shes drug po de dag dang 'brel bar/ bde ba dang / sdug bsngal dang / btang snyoms gsum tshor zhing nyams su myong ba ni/ tshor ba'i phung po dang / phyi dang nang 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos gang la yang /'di ni bum pa'o/ /'di ni snam bu'o/ /'di ni bzang po'o/ /'di ni ngan pa'o/ /'di ni ring po'o/ /'di ni thung ba'o/ /'di ni ka zhes pa'o/ /'di ni ka ba zhes pa'o/ /zhes pa la sogs pa/ ming tsam du 'dzin pa dang / don tsam du 'dzin pa dang / ming kho na 'dzin pa dang / don kho na 'dzin pa dang / ming don gnyis ka 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma can gyi rtog pa rnams ni rgyu mtshan gtan tshigs la brten pa dang ma brten pa ji ltar yin yang rung ste 'du shes kyi phung po zhes bya'o/ /'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / dad pa dang / brtson 'grus la sogs pa'i dge ba dang / rtog dpyod la sogs pa ma nges pa dang / de kun la khyab pa yul yid la byed pa dang / yul la g.yo ba'i sems pa la sogs pa/ mdor na las byed pa dang 'brel ba'i rnam rtog thams cad ni/ mtshungs ldan 'du byed ces bya ste 'du byed kyi phung po'i phyed snga ma dang 'du byed dngos dang 'du byed kyi gtso bo yin no/ /de ltar rnam shes tshor ba/ 'du shes/ 'du byed kyi phung po'i phyed de/phung po phyed dang bzhi po de ni rig pa'am shes pa yin no/ /'dus byas rnams kyi /rlon nyid/ skye ba dang / gnas pa dang 'jig pa la sogs pa dang / mi

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/dang mi phan tshun 'dra ba la sogs pa'i skal mnyam dang / sdug bsngal thob pa dang / rgyal srid thob pa dang / sdom pa thob pa dang / lam dang 'bras bu thob pa la sogs pa'i 'gyur ba'i khyad par ni thob pa ste/ de dag la sogs pa gzugs sems kyi dngos po'i khyad par la btags pa shin tu mang ba dag ni/ldan min 'du byed ces grags te/ 'du byed kyi phung po'i phyogs gcig gam/phyed phyi ma ste/ btags pa'i 'du byed dang 'du byed rnam grangs pa'o/ /rnam pa rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs zhes pa ni sdom pa dang sdom min dang /dge ba'i brtul zhugs tsam po rnams la zer te/ 'di ming gi sgo nasaskyigazugs phung du bsdu yang / gzugs sems gnyis 'dus kyi gnas skabs la btags pa tsam yin pas/ dngos po btags pa ba'i nang tshan yin no/ /de ltar ni de dag ni phung po lnga ste chos kyi khams kyi phyed ma dang / chos kyi skye mched kyi phyed ma ma gtogs skye mchen bcu gnyis dang khams bco brgyad kyang de la tshang ngo / /phyed ma de yang ci snyam na/ 'dus ma byas su gtogs pa yang gnyis te btags pa ba dang dngos so/ /dang po ni/ nam mkha' dang 'gog pa gnyis dang / rigs spyi la sogs pa yin la 'di ni phung por ma gtogs par 'dod cing khams dang skye mched du ni 'dus te/ tshor 'du 'du shes 'du byed de phung po gsum dang 'dus ma byas btags pa ba 'di rnams —bsdoms pa ni chos kyi khams dang chos kyi skye mched do/ /gnyis pa 'dus ma byas dngos ni don dam pa'i sems nyid rnam pa thams cad pa rtag brtan zhi ba g.yung drung bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po/ chos dbyings de bzhin nyid do/ /de la 'dus ma byas btags pa ba ni/ dngos su na 'dus byas yin yang / rang gi mtshan nyid kyis med pas/ skye 'jig gnas pa'i dngos por med pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas gzhan rnams dang mtshan nyid mi 'anā ba

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/shin tu che ba'i phyir na 'dus ma byas su btags pa'o/ /lam gyi chos rnams ni 'dus ma byas rtogs pa'i thabs yin yang / ngo bo ni dngos po ste/ dad pa dang brtson 'grus dang shes rab la sogs pa'i sems byung dang rnam shes su 'dus pa yin no/ /'bras bus bsdus pa'i chos la ni/ nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par grol ba'i ye shes ni lam yin pa'i phyir dngos po nyid du 'gyur la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam grol lam dang / khyad par lam dang por thob pa yang de dang 'dra zhing / theg pa gsum la spang bya sgrib pa rnams 'gags pa'i spangs pa ni so sor brtags dgog yin pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas btags pa ba dang dngos med yin no/ /'gog bden dngos ni/ don dam chos sku gzhi lam 'bras bu kun gyi chos nyid/ sangs rgyas kyi snying po de yin te/ de dngos po dngos med gnyis ka ma yin zhing / 'dus ma byas ni dngos yin no/ /spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i dbyings dang / stong pa nyid ces bya ba yang sems nyid 'dus ma byas 'di kho na yin gyi/ gzhan ni yang dag par ma yin no/ /de ltar na chos nyid 'di/ res 'ga' chos kyi skye mched yin pa ltar bshad pa ni dgos pa'i dbang gis gsungs pa ste/ rig shes rjes dpag gis chos nyid 'di la dmigs nas don spyi'i tshul gyis spyod yul du byed pas dbyings 'di yang / yid kyi yul rjes mthun yin pa la dgongs so/ /nges par na des de yul du byed mi nus te/ rnam par shes pa dang rnam par rtog pa'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni dngos gnas la phung khams skye mched gang yang ma yin la/ rten 'brel las kyang grol ba'o/ /don dam pa'i ni phung khams skye mched dang rten 'brel du yang 'jog mod kyi/ phung sogs de dag kutā /ba kho nas rab tu phye ba yin pa'i phyir/ de yin pas de dag yin par
