sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/yin pas/ de la bden par mi 'dzin no zhes smras pas ci zhig bya/ de ltar na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes de ni/ shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i phyir rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yin no/ /spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i ye shes yin pas shes rab dang / chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs mthar thug pa'i phyir/ pha rol tu phyin pa yin pas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /dngos po gnyis pa lam tha//) ༷/ rdos/ pa nyid ni/ mdo las bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du lam gyi rnam pa 'tshol ba nyid byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lags/ rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ni nyan thos kyi lam gang yin pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi lam gang yin pa'i lam thams cad bskyed par bya zhing / lam thams cad shes par bya'o/ /de dag kyang / yongs su rdzogs par bya zhing /de dag gis lam gyi bya ba yang bya la/ smon lam yongs su rdzogs par ma byas pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par ma byas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su ma sbyangs par/ de dag gis yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du ni mi bya'o/ /de'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ces bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di la phal che ba dag lam gsum skye med du rtogs pa dang / lam gsum rang bzhin med par rtogs pa zhes zer zhing / de'i skye med dang rang bzhin med pa ni/ sher phyin yin par ston pa'i mtshan nyid kyi zur du bsams pa'o/ /de ltar yang rung ba ni yin mod kyi/ sher phyin gyi mtshan nyid de 'dra kho nar bzung dgos pa ༵༵ ma yin no/ /de lta mod kyi/ dper na gzugs sogs phung po sgro

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/dmigs pa'i rten du bzhag nas/ de bden med du sgom pa'am/ snang cha de'i rnam pa bden med du shar ba lta bur/ 'dir yang dmigs yul theg pa gsum gyi lam gyi mtshan nyid blo la nges par byas nas/ de 'dra'i mtshan nyid kyi rnam pa yid yul du shar ba de la dmigs nas 'di rang bzhin med do snyam sgom pa'am/ sa lam so so'i mnyam gzhag rjes thob kyi nyams myong shar ba rnams sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med pa'i don sgom pa tsam yang gnas skabs 'di'i lam skye med kyi go don min no/ /'o na ci zhe na/ lam gyi rnam pa skye med ces pa/ skye med rnam pa'i lam zhes pa'i don du 'gyur te/ rang rgyud kyi mnyam gzhag gam rjes thob kyi lam gang yin pa de yang / skye 'gag gnas gsum la sogs pa spros pa thams cad rang sar zhi ba'i rnam pa'am/ 'ga' zhig dngos su spros pa'i rnam pa tsam snang du chug kyang / mnyam gzhag spros med kyi shugs kyis zin pas/ spros pa'i mtshan ma stobs bri nas spros med dang 'dra rung du gyur pa ni/ skye med rnam pa'i lam yin la/ de rtogs tshul lam/ shes tshul ni/ mnyam gzhag la rang rig kho na dang / rjes thob la gnyis ga'o/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa spros bral gyi rnam pa can de ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub par byed pa'i lam dngos yin cing /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med pa rtogs pa la sogs pa de dag nyid kyi/ 'khrul med kyi ye shes gang yin pa de dang /rtogs tshul gang yin pa dang / yon tan gang yin pa dang / phan yon gang yin pa ji lta ba de 'dra re/ zhor byung gi yon tan du ma'i lhag dang bcas par/ de la tshang bas na theg pa gsum char gyi lam zhes bya zhing / de nyid rang rig pas shes pa'i phyir lam shes so/ rdzogs smin sbyang gsum ma snyistu kyi

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/dmigs pa'i rten du bzhag nas/ de bden med du sgom pa'am/ snang cha de'i rnam pa bden med du shar ba lta bur/ 'dir yang dmigs yul theg pa gsum gyi lam gyi mtshan nyid blo la nges par byas nas/ de 'dra'i mtshan nyid kyi rnam pa yid yul du shar ba de la dmigs nas 'di rang bzhin med do snyam sgom pa'am/ sa lam so so'i mnyam gzhag rjes thob kyi nyams myong shar ba rnams sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med pa'i don sgom pa tsam yang gnas skabs 'di'i lam skye med kyi go don min no/ /'o na ci zhe na/ lam gyi rnam pa skye med ces pa/ skye med rnam pa'i lam zhes pa'i don du 'gyur te/ rang rgyud kyi mnyam gzhag gam rjes thob kyi lam gang yin pa de yang / skye 'gag gnas gsum la sogs pa spros pa thams cad rang sar zhi ba'i rnam pa'am/ 'ga' zhig dngos su spros pa'i rnam pa tsam snang du chug kyang / mnyam gzhag spros med kyi shugs kyis zin pas/ spros pa'i mtshan ma stobs bri nas spros med dang 'dra rung du gyur pa ni/ skye med rnam pa'i lam yin la/ de rtogs tshul lam/ shes tshul ni/ mnyam gzhag la rang rig kho na dang / rjes thob la gnyis ga'o/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes/ chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa spros bral gyi rnam pa can de ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub par byed pa'i lam dngos yin cing /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi gang zag gi bdag med pa rtogs pa la sogs pa de dag nyid kyi/ 'khrul med kyi ye shes gang yin pa de dang /rtogs tshul gang yin pa dang / yon tan gang yin pa dang / phan yon gang yin pa ji lta ba de 'dra re/ zhor byung gi yon tan du ma'i lhag dang bcas par/ de la tshang bas na theg pa gsum char gyi lam zhes bya zhing / de nyid rang rig pas shes pa'i phyir lam shes so/ rdzogs smin sbyang gsum ma snyistu kyi

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/bar du/ yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du mi byed pa'i las can dang /skabs gzhan du nyon mongs ched du mi spong pa'i las can du bshad pa sogs ni/byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs nyid kyi dbang du byas pa'i lam shes la khyad par de dag tshang ba yin kyang / lam shes su 'jog byed la de ltar —dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /sangs rgyas ni 'bras bu mthar thug pa yin pas/rnam mkhyen gyi skabs su rnam brtags mtshan ma gsum gar bshad pa yin la/rdzutā /sdu/ sdi 'bras bu mtha' dag mngon du ma byas pas lam tsam zhig kho na dngos po gsum pa gzhi shes /)/gzhi /r+sha/ las/ bcom ldan 'das ci'i slad du thams cad 'tshal ba nyid nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi lags/ rab 'byor thams cad ni phyi dang nang gi chos rnams ji snyed pa tsam yin la/ de dag kyang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis shes kyi/lam thams cad kyis kyang ma yin la/ rnam pa thams cad du yang ma yin pas/de'i phyir nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ thams cad shes pa nyid ces bya'o zhes so/ /'dir gzhi phyi nang gi chos rnams shes pa zhes pa las shes tshul ji ltar yin mi gsal yang / nyan rang gi rtogs pa yin pa'i phyir na/ gang zag gi bdag med pa'i rtogs tshul yin dgos te/ mdo las/phung po gang zag bdag med par/ /rab tu rnam phye mthong gyur cing / /chos kyi dngos yod ma bshig pas/ /nyan thos de dag mngon rtogs 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /de lta bas na/ nyan rang 'phags pas chos kyi bdag med mardonā sum du ma rtogs te de'i phyir chos kyi bdag 'dzin spangs pa yang ma yin

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/no/ /'on kyang gang zag gi bdag med nyid rtogs pa'i shugs kyis/ dngos por 'dzin pa yang cung zad srabs par gyur ba ni yin la/ de dag gi mnyam gzhag na chos bdag gi snang ba ma log kyang / chos kyi bdag 'dzin mngon gyur pa yang med pas/ de 'dra'i mnyam gzhag de dag kyang chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i ye shes dang 'dzin stangs 'gal ba ma yin pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang cung zad rjes su mthun pa ni yin no/ /des na nyan rang 'phags pa'i ye shes de ni/ gzhi phyi nang gi chos phung khams skye mched thams cad la/ ji ltar rigs par mi rtag pa la sogs pa rnam pa'i shes pa bcu drug po de dag kun 'jug pa yin kyang / rnam pa'i gtso bo yin pa dang /spros bral dang cha shas mthun pa'i ldog pa nye bar bzung nas/ bdag med par ni shes la/ de shes pas nyan rang gi lam shes pa tsam du ni 'gyur yang spros pa dang bral bar ni ma shes pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rtogs tshul gyis ni/ lam de gnyis kyang ma shes la/ khyad par du lam gyi gtso bo theg chen gyi lam ni gtan nas kyang ma shes pa'i phyir/ nyan rang gi ye shes de lam shes par mi 'gyur zhing / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa thams cad mi shes pas na/ rnam pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid lta ga la zhig ste/ de'i phyir gzhi kho na shes pas gzhi shes zhes bya'o/ /'on kyang 'di ni nyan rang gi gzhi shes zhes bya zhing / mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi nang du gtogs pa tsam yin la/ gnyen po'i gzhi shes ni/ mkhyen gsum gyis zlas gye ba'i gzhi shes dngos sam btags pa ba gang du bzhag na legs zhes dpyod ldan rnams kyis rnam par dpyod cig dang / gzhi shes kyi skabs kyi mdo dang bstan bcos kyi/ gzhung dngos bstan gyi brjod bya'i gtso bo gzhi shes ni gnyen po'i gzhi shes 'di kho na yin la/ gzhung gi dngos bstan rdonā na/

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyang nyan rang gi de gtso mi che ste/ gtso bor byang chub sems dpa' so so skye bo dmigs pa'i lta ba can rnams kyi yin no/ /gnyen po gzhi shes de yang gang zhe na/ mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes spros pa thams cad spangs pa de la/ bdag dang byed po dang / rtag dngos dang / myong tshor bde ba sogs gang yang gdod nas ma dmigs par brtags pa'i cha gcig 'dug pa de nyid/ nyan rang gi lam shes pa'i lam shes yin la/ gnyen po gzhi shes kyang yin no/ /yang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i bag chags drung nas 'byin pa'i phyir/ gang zag gi bdag med pa ched gtad bsgoms pa na/ bdag ni rang bzhin gyis med par mthong zhing /lhag ma gzhan dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i spros pa rnams kyang zhir la rang bzhin med pa rtogs nas/ spros pa dang mtshan ma thams cad zhig pa'i rnam pa can te/ spros bral rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi sdong po bdag med pa'i rtsa ba can de ni gnyen po'i gzhi shes nyid yin no/ /bdag 'dzin gyi bag chags drung nas 'byin pa la/ spyi khyab kyi spros bral de kho na rtogs pas chog gi/gang zag med pa la gtso bor dmigs pas ci zhig bya snyam na/ ma yin te dmigs pa rnams kyi nus pa ni tha dad pa yin pas/ stong nyid kho nas chags sdang la sogs pa yang bzlog pa yin mod kyang mi sdug pa'i ting nge 'dzin spros bral gyi rnam pa can gyis 'dod chags kyi bag chags lhag par bzlog pa dang /byams pa'i sems spros bral gyi rnam pa can gyis zhe sdang gi bag chags lhag par bzlog pa bzhin no/ /rigs pas kyang 'thad de/ mi sdug pa dang / byams pa dang / bdag med pa de dag kyang de dang de mngon gyur 'phral du bzlog pa'i nus pa can ni yin la/ spyi'i gnyen po stong nyid de yang ma tshang ba med pa/ 1sdusgoms pa'i phyir/ gcig pu kho na las gnyis skar 'dzom pa stobs che

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/ba smos ma dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /rang rgyal gyis bzung ba chos kyi bdag med mngon sum rtogs sam ma rtogs zhe na/ ma rtogs zhes bya'o/ /'o na ji skad du/ gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang / /'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni/ /brten gyi bse ru lta bu'i lam/ /yang dag bsdus pa shes par bya/ /zhes —gsungs pa ma yin nam/ ce na/ rang rgyal rnams ni rten 'brel yun ring du goms pa las/ 'jig rten ma rig pa'i rkyen can du shes pas na/ de'i shugs kyis gzung ba'i rnam rtog shin tu nyams smad pa yin pas/ de lta bu'i rtogs pa de yang byang chub sems dpa'i lam shes kyi rtogs rigs kyi nang du 'dus te/ de yang byang chub sems dpa' skabs 'ga' zhig tu chos thams cad sems kyi snang ba tsam du rtogs pas/ nga bdag dang phyi rol gyi don gdod nas ma grub par rtogs shing / de nyid kyang spros pa thams cad dang gdod nas bral ba'i rnam pa can yin mod kyi/ 'dzin pa la ched gtad shugs byung nas stong par bsgom pa med pas/ gzung don gyi rtogs pa spong /'dzin pa'i rtogs pa mi spong zhes tha snyad mdzad pa yin gyi/ 'dzin pa'i mngon zhen dang bcas pa ni ma yin no/ /de lta bu'i ye shes des/ rang rgyal gyi rtogs pa gang yin pa de/ rigs mthun gyi tshul gyis bsdus pa yin pas rang rgyal gyi lam gyi ming gis btags pa tsam mo/ /de ltar bshad zin pa'i mkhyen pa gsum po de ni/ lam gyi bden pa'i dbang du byas la/ dngos po brgyad kyi skabs 'dir gtso bo yang lam bden 'di yin mod/ spyir chos nyid don dam pa'i ye shes bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po ni/ sher phyin mthar thug pa yang yin la/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang / lam shes pa nyid dang / gzhi thams cad shes pa nyid de/ 'di ni don dam 'gog pa'i bden pa yin cing / sher phyin gyi mdo dang gzhung gi sbas /spyan

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/mthar thug gi snying po yin par shes par bya'o/ /de ltar mkhyen pa gsum gyi ngo bo ni de 'dra yin la/ lam gyi bden pas bsdus pa'i mkhyen gsum gyi rtogs bya'am/ gnas lugs chos kyi dbyings spros bral gyi rig pa de ni bdag med gnyis sam/ rnam pa skye med/ lam skye med/ gzhi skye med/ ces sogs tha snyad du mas bsnyad de/ thos bsam gyis gtan la 'bebs pa'i yul dang /sbyor ba rnams kyi sgom bya dmigs pa'i yul yang yin no/ /dngos po bzhi pa rnam /r+shaX shāmi pa /ba/ gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams/ rang bzhin gdon nas stong pa nyid du mtshungs kyang /so so'i mtshan nyid rnam pa mi 'dra ba rnams ma 'dres shing ma 'dzings par blos rtogs nas/ thams cad spros pa dang bral bar ro snyoms shing / sems dngos po gang la yang mi gnas par yid la mi byed pa'i tshul du bsgoms mo/ /de la mi rtag pa lta bu'i gsal snang bsgrubs te spros bral du bsre nus pa nas/rnam rdzogs sbyor ba tsam rgyud la skye ba'i mgo brtsams pa yin la/ rnam pa gzhan thams cad kyang re ro bzhin rim pas bsgrubs shing spros bral gyi ngor rim gyis skye la/ mthar shes pa skad cig gcig la rnam pa thams cad dus mnyam du shar bar gyur pa na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mthar phyin pa yin te/tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi bar du 'di yod par 'dod pa ltar 'thad la/ 'di la mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus sgom gyi spyor ba zhes zer te/mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa ni gong du smos pa ltar/ lam gyi bden pa'i dmigs yul rtogs bya chos dbyings de'i rnam pa yin cing / dngos gnas la rnam pa/ sbyangs tshad bzung bar mi nus kyang / don gyi gtso bo rnams bsdus pa'i

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/phyir dang / gdul bya nye ba'i bsam pa la dgongs nas/ rnam pa brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum zhes grags so/ /bsdus sgom gyi go don ni/ dper na 'dus byas mi rtag par yid la byas shing / de yang rang bzhin med pa la bslabs pas/ gsal snang thob pa na/ zag bcas sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa yid la byed cing / de rang bzhin med pa la gsal snang sgrub bo/ /de yang thob pa na/ mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis ka dus gcig la yid la byed cing /rang bzhin med par gsal snang yang dus mnyam du sgrubs pas/ mnyam gzhag skad cig ma gcig po de la shes pa gcig po des/ 'dus byas kyi snang ba thams cad mi rtag pa'i rnam pa can du yang shes/ zag bcas kyi snang ba thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa can du yang shes/ gzhi 'dus byas dang zag bcas gnyis dang mtshan nyid mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal rnams kyang snang ba tsam ma gtogs/ rang bzhin gyis stong par mthong ba na/ mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus te sgom pa yin pas/bsdus sgom zhes bya'o/ /mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa ma 'gags pa dgos te/ de med na bsdus te sgom par mi 'gyur zhing / rnam pa'i rnam grangs mang po bshad pa rnams kyang don med du 'gyur bas so/ /snang cha de'i steng du spros pa dang bral bar 'jog ma shes na yang / mi rtag sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa tsam gyis sher phyin sgom par mi 'gyur zhing / gnas lugs la reg par mi 'gyur bas/ spyi dang khyad par gyi rnam pa thams cad sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de ltar yin no/ /'dir sbyor ba zhes pa ni nyams len sgom pa'i rnal 'byor yin te/ de ltar na 'di dag ni gzhan rnams la yang rigs 'gre'o/ /149

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/dngos po lnga pa rtse po'i sbyor /ni //myurab/ sdus sgom rab tu gyur pa zhes bya ste/ rab tu gyur ba'i go don shin tu byang ba dang gong 'phel du gyur pa ste/de la rnam rdzogs ni/ rnam pa gnyis kyi bsdus sgom nas rnam pa thams cad kyi bar du/ bsdus sgom ma thob pa thob par byed pa dang / thob pa mi nyams par byed pa yin cing / rtse sbyor 'di ni/ rnam pa gnyis nas rnam pa thams cad pa'i bar du so sor sbyar te/ bsdus sgom de dang de thob cing ma nyams par sngar nas byas pa de/ shin tu byang bas shugs 'byung la 'jug pa'i phyir dang / skabs de dang de'i yon tan rnams bsgrub pa'i phyir dang / mi rtag pa lta bu gcig la yang rtogs tshul mi 'dra ba du ma'i sgo nas/ shes rab kyi snang ba spel ba'i phyir sgom pa yin no/ /de ltar bsgomasapas gnas skabs de dang de dag tu de 'dra mngon du gyur ba na rtse mo'i sbyor ba thob pa zhes bya ste/sbyor lam drod nas rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi bar du yod do/ /dngos po drug pa mthar( rnyirdo ༵/ rtek+to shā/ ni/ bsdus sgom de nyid ma nyams bzhin du rim pa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs la bslabs pas/ 'phel ba'i rgyun de nyid byang zhing shin tu brtan par byed pa ste/ dper na sngar gyi bsdus sgom de nyid/ chu tshod gcig tu sgom par byed na/ chu sung bzhi lhag tsam zhig sems spros bral gyi snang cha mi rtag sdug bsngal sogs su cig char shar ba de/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rjes sbyin pa gtong ba'i sems pas mgo bsdus te sgom pa dang / de rjes rgyun de tsam zhig tshul khrims spo(5 ༷mas kyis mgo bsdus te sgom pa sogs/ phar phyin drug dang / rjes

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/dran drug dang / dngos med ngo bo nyid de bcu gsum la sbyar ro/ /de la goms nas dbugs bcu gsum gyi ring la chos bcu gsum sbyar te sgom pa lta bu dang / rim pas dus mtha'i skad cig ma bcu gsum la sbyar ba lta bu dang /mthar mtha' med pa'i bar du sbyar te/ 'di ni sbyor ba snga ma gnyis kyi rtsal sbyong ba yin la sbyor ba snga ma gnyis ni rnam pa mi 'dra ba du ma gcig tu bsdus te sgom pa yin la/ 'di ni bsdus zin de 'dra yongs rdzogs re re bzhin/skad cig re rer rnam pa mi 'dra ba du mar 'char ba la slob pa yin pas/rnam pa so sor phye ste sgom pa yin no/ /'o na phye ba'i phyir rnam pa nyung du song ba yin nam snyam na min te/ snga ma rnams las kyang ches mang bar 'gyur ro/ /dper na shes pa gcig la rnam pa bcu drug dus mnyam du 'char ba bsgrubs zin pa de/ slar yang rnam pa bcu drug po so so ma nyams bzhin du/ thams cad mi rtag pa'i rnam pa gcig tu 'char ba dang / thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa gcig tu 'char ba dang / thams cad stong pa gcig tu 'char ba la sogs pa/ skad cig re re bzhin du 'phos shing sgom pa yin te/ sngar gyi rnam pa mang po de dag kyang re re bzhin rnam pa nyis sgrag tu bslabs par 'gyur la/ sngar rnam pa mang po de dag stong nyid tsam gyis khyab byed du byed pa las gzhan med na yang / 'dir rnam pa thams cad la mi rtag pa'i rnam pas khyab pa dang / rnam pa thams cad la sdug bsngal gyi rnam pas khyab pa sogs/ rnam pa thams cad la re re bzhin rnam pa thams cad kyis khyab par bsgrubs pa'i phyir ro/ 'on kyang skabs 'dir/ bsdus sgom gyi rnam pa rnams sngar dus mnyam du grub zin pa'i rgyun de ka yin kyang rgyas 'debs byed rnams dus mnyam du ma grub pas/ snga phyi breng chags su byed dgos pa'i phyir/mthar gyis rim gyis sgrub pa zhes bya ste/ chos gcig bsgoms pas1 rdos

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/thams cad bsgoms pa dang / skad cig gcig la yang ting nge 'dzin du ma la sdang 'jug nus par 'gyur ba'i rgyu bla na med pa ste/ 'di'i sa mtshams la 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba mang yang / sbyor lam nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi bar du yod do zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ bdag gi rnam par rtog pa ni sbyor lam yang bzod pa la bya dgos par sems so/ /'dir chos bcu gsum bshad pa ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ chos kyi rnam pa mtha' yas pa mtha' dag go/ /de ltar na sbyor ba gsum po de dang / snga ma snga ma la brten nas phyi ma phyi ma skye zhing /phan tshun spel ba'i tshul du rgyud la skye ba yin te/ dper na rnam pa nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i bsdus sgom thob pa na/ rnam pa nyer bdun po de rnams nyid kyi rtse po'i spyor bas byang zhing 'phel ba la slob par byed do/ /de nas nyer bdun po de rnams re re bzhin nyer bdun po de dag thams cad du 'char ba'i phyir/ nyer bdun po la rnam pa re re bzhin gyis rgyas 'debs pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba sgom dgos te/ des rnam pa mang nyung thams cad la rigs 'gre'o/ /'on kyang sbyor ba gsum po de thog mar thob pa'i sa mtshams ni mi 'dra ste/ bsdus sgom ni tshogs lam na yang yod cing /bsdus sgom la byang zhing 'phel ba ni/ de na med pa'i phyir/ tshogs lam na rnam rdzogs yod kyi rtse mo med do/ /byang zhing 'phel ba sbyor lam drod rtse gnyis nas yod kyang / rnam pa mang pos rnam pa mang po la rgyas thebs pa de na med pas/ rtse sbyor yod kyang mthar gyis pa med do/ /bzod pa nas ni rgyas — thebs tshul de yod pa'i phyir mthar gyis pa yang yod de/ de nas bcoms te gsum ga spel mar 'byung ngo / /rtse sbyor ma thob pa'i sngon du mthar gyis pa yod par 'dod pa mi 'thad de/ de ni rtse sbyor gyi bsdus sgom 'phel ba'i rgyun de nyis sdu/ rim sgom du byed pa nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ kha cig sa bdun pa

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/man chad mkhyen gsum gyi mngon rtogs dang / brgyad pa yan chad la sbyor bzhi'i mngon rtogs yod par 'dod cing / de las kyang kha cig de dag re re la yang sbyor mthong sgom gsum gyi dge ba sogs byed pa ni 'thad par ma mthong la bka' gdams pa 'ga' zhig na re/ 'phags seng gis mngon rtogs kyi don rnams lam mthon po kho na la yang yang sbyar ba ni/ rang re da lta'i gang zag rnams la sku drin chung ste/ 'di thams cad la da lta nyid nas nyams su blang rgyu dgos gsung ba yang / rjes mthun gyi dbang du byas na bden pas/las dang po ba nyid nas dngos po brgyad kur gyi rgyu tshogs la bslab tu yod de/gzhan sbyor ba dang mngon rtogs kyi dbye ba ltar na/ rnam rdzogs sogs sbyor ba gsum po 'di la/ so skye'i gnas skabs na ni sbyor ba tsam yin la/'phags pa'i lam gyi de dang de ni mngon rtogs kyang yin no/ /dngos po bdun pa skardo sna/ ṭīzlo zlo/ kā/ ni/ spros pa dang bral ba/rab tu zhib/ rab tu dben pa'i ye shes skad cig ma gcig gis ji lta ji snyed kyi chos thams cad kyang cig char shes la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'di ni lam gyis bsdus pa'i ye shes dang yon tan dang dge ba'i chos thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur cing / 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus pa'i chos rnams kyi snang cha thams cad gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du shar bas ni/ chos thams cad skad cig gcig gis rtogs nus pa'i phyir dang / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub de ma thag tu thob nus pa'i phyir/ skad cig gcig gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa zhes bya'o/ /mngon rtogs 'di ni rgyun mtha'i skabs kho na yin kyang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas la dbang sgyur ba yin pas na/ 154da

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/cig la bskal bar ston pa sogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ dus yun ring thung 'di tsam zhes bsam par mi nus so/ /mthar gyis pa'i skabs su/ phan tshun yang yang rgyas btab pa'i nus pa rnams 'dir shin tu smin pas/ dge chos gcig la dmigs pas dge chos gzhan ma lus pa yang cig char 'byung ba yin pas na/ mthar gyis pa yongs su gyur nas/ skad cig mar song ba yin te/skabs 'dir brtag pa mthar bzung ste mthar chags su bsgom pa zhig gal te srid du chug kyang / mthar chags su mi yong bar kun 'dus su 'byung ba yin no/ /de yang shin tu dbang 'byor bas gal te 'dod na ni/ mthar chags su 'byung ba yang srid mod kyi/ skad cig ma grub nas mthar chags bsgoms pa la dgos pa med pa'i phyir 'dod par mi byed do/ /de la mthar chags rkyang par bsgoms pa'i nus pa yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ mthar gyis pa'i mngon rtogs legs par thob zin pa yin la/ de nas rgyas 'debs nyis thig tu byed de/ rnam pa thams cad sbyin pa dang tshul khrims gnyis kyis rgyas ——'debs pa/ snga phyi rim can ma yin par dus mnyam du byed do/ /de ltar nyis sgrag dus mnyam du rgyas thebs pa nas brtsams te/ rnam pa thams cad du rgyas 'debs mtha' med pa'i bar du sbyor ba ni/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba tsam yin te/ 'di ni rgyun mtha'i sngon rol nas yod cing / skad cig pa'i mngon rtogs ni ma yin no/ /rgyas 'debs de yang lhun thub kyi tshul gyis ske'abyung dgos te/ 'bad rtsol can yin na ni skad cig ma'i thun mong ma yin /༷ // sbya /gyur bas/ mi g.yo ba'i sa yan chad la ci rigasapa yod par 15 dngos po brgyad pa chos sku / /〉 kā /sa/ shing lus pa med pa'i chos sam
