sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos zhes pa'i go don/ 'bras bu rnam mkhyen de thob byed kyi rgyu lam gyi rim pa yin pa'i don yin gyi/ rnam mkhyen gyi rtogs bya'i yul bcu yin par 'chad pa mi legs la/ sems bskyed la sogs pa 'di dag la/ rnam mkhyen gyi sgra sbyor ba ni de bas kyang shin tu mi 'thad de/ rnam mkhyen gyi sgra bshad rgyu tsam yod du chug kyang / nyan thos kyi theg pa dang /pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / sngags kyi theg pa rnams las/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kho na la gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnas skabs thams cad du shin tu grags pa dang ha cang 'gal ches pas so/ /dper na sangs rgyas la lha tshe ring po'i sgra bshad du yod kyang / de ltar tha snyad sbyar na shin tu mi mdzes pa bzhin no/ /mtshon byed kyi chos de dag kyang ji skad du/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang / /nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi dang / /sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang / /dmigs pa dag dang ched dang ni/ /go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang / /tshogs ni ngesapar 'byung bcas rnams/ /thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ /ces gsungs na/ sems bskyed ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa la ngos 'dzin pa ni spyir btangs tsam yin la/de tsam zhig ni smon pa sems bskyed tsam yang yin no/ /de yang spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang 'brel na ni/ 'jug pa sems bskyed ces bya ste/ gang 'jug pa yod pa de la smon sems kyang yod do/ /sems bskyed tsam ni de ltar yin kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgrub pa sems bskyed du 'gyur ba la/ spros bral gyi lta ba sngon du song ba dgos shing de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la stong nyid la brten nas snying rje 'jug des kun nas snyobaslangs te sems bskyed pa yin pas/ dngos gzhi'i dus su yang ༵༵sa

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med gas bshad/sam rjes mthun ci 'dra yang 'khor gsum rnam par mi rtog pa'i stong nyid kyis zin pa zhig dgos pa yin no/ /de'i tshe sems bskyed dang sems bskyed kyi spyod pa thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam du 'gyur ro/ /de yang las dang po ba nas/ sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi sar ni de'i rigs rgyun dmigs pa med pa'i/ snying rje chen po ni yod kyang / sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid ni log pa yin cing / tshogs spyor gyi lam du ni sems bskyed de yang sher phyin gyi sgrub pa kho na yin gyi/ sher phyin dngos ma yin la/ mthong lam thob nas ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sems bskyed dngos yin par shes par bya'o/ /gdams ngag ni/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa' zhig gis/ slob ma byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gang la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos bstan pa'i ngag tshig gis rkyen byas te/ de'i rgyud la sher phyin gyi dbang du byas pa'i/ mnyam gzhag gi lam dngos rgyud la skyes pa'am/sngar skyes la bogs phyin pa'am/ nyes skyon gyi gegs sel bar gyur pa'i gnas skabs de ni 'dir bstan gdams ngag gi lam zhes bya'o/ /gnams ngag khyad par can ni chos rgyun gyi teng nge 'dzin thob nas/ de bzhin skyi gshegs pas mngon sum du 'doms pa la bya ste/ gdams ngag ces bya ba dngos bstan ltar na/ 'doms pa'i ngag tshig la zer yang / 'bras bu la rgyu'i ming gis btags nas/ de'i dngos kyi grub 'bras slob ma'i rgyud la skyes pa la bya'o/ /nges 'byed yan lag ni/ skabs 'dir theg chen sbyor lam ste/ nges pa ni chos nyid dang de 'byed pa ni mthong lam yin pas/ de'i yan lag ste rgyu tshogs ni de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sbyor lam de chos nyid la gsal sna15 snyi thob pa yin cing / mi rtog pa'i tshul gyis chos nyid cung zad rang

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/gis rig pa yang yin la/ rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum gyis rtogs pa ni ma yin pa dang / gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog glo bur ba rnams rim gyis 'gag par 'gyur ba yin pa dang / gang mngon gyur ba ma 'gags pa'i rtog pa de dang de yang / mnyam gzhag tu mi 'byung mod kyi/ rjes thob tu de dag 'byung zhing / de dag ma spangs pa'i stobs kyis mnyam gzhag kyang cung zad mi gsal ba yin no/ /sbyor lam gyi ye shes 'di kun yang mi rtog pa spros bral gyi rnam pa can yin pas/ bar bar na rnam par rtog pa'i 'dzin pa dang cung zad 'dres pa yod kyang rang gi ngo bo rtog pa nam yang ma yin cing / chos nyid cung zad tsam gsal la cung zad tsam mi gsal ba ni/ dper na seng ras kyis gdong g.yogs te dngos po la bltas pa bzhin no/ /de ltar sems bskyed cing gdams ngag mnos nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bsgoms pa las/nges 'byed yan lag rgyud la skyes te/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam chod par 'gyur bas rim pa de bzhin du bstan la/ spyir sems bskyed nyid dam gdams ngag nyid kyi nang du lam thams cad 'du ba yin pas go rim med kyang / go rim 'di dang por sems bskyed pa dang / dang por gdams ngag mnos pa'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /de ltar na tshogs spyor ni/ spyir rnam mkhyen gyi sgrub pa tsam yin kyang / khyad par can ni ma yin la/ sgrub pa khyad par can rnams ni 'phags pa'i lam yin pas/ lam de gtso bor bzhag pa'i dbang du byas nas/ ji ltar sgrub pa nyams su len pa thams cad kyi rten nam rgyu ni chos dbyings yin la/ chos dbyings de yang spros pa dang bral zhing rnam pa thams cad pa'o/ /de ni rang gi ngo bo'i stengs nas kun rdzob kyi chos gang gis kyang ma gos mod/ rnal 'byor can gyi blo la 'char tshul gyi dbang du byas nas/ tshogs lam gyi rten chos dbyings dang / sbyor lam gyi rten 1rdo/sgro

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/gis rig pa yang yin la/ rnal 'byor pa'i mngon sum gyis rtogs pa ni ma yin pa dang / gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog glo bur ba rnams rim gyis 'gag par 'gyur ba yin pa dang / gang mngon gyur ba ma 'gags pa'i rtog pa de dang de yang / mnyam gzhag tu mi 'byung mod kyi/ rjes thob tu de dag 'byung zhing / de dag ma spangs pa'i stobs kyis mnyam gzhag kyang cung zad mi gsal ba yin no/ /sbyor lam gyi ye shes 'di kun yang mi rtog pa spros bral gyi rnam pa can yin pas/ bar bar na rnam par rtog pa'i 'dzin pa dang cung zad 'dres pa yod kyang rang gi ngo bo rtog pa nam yang ma yin cing / chos nyid cung zad tsam gsal la cung zad tsam mi gsal ba ni/ dper na seng ras kyis gdong g.yogs te dngos po la bltas pa bzhin no/ /de ltar sems bskyed cing gdams ngag mnos nas pha rol tu phyin pa'i don bsgoms pa las/nges 'byed yan lag rgyud la skyes te/ tshogs sbyor gyi lam chod par 'gyur bas rim pa de bzhin du bstan la/ spyir sems bskyed nyid dam gdams ngag nyid kyi nang du lam thams cad 'du ba yin pas go rim med kyang / go rim 'di dang por sems bskyed pa dang / dang por gdams ngag mnos pa'i dbang du byas pa yin no/ /de ltar na tshogs spyor ni/ spyir rnam mkhyen gyi sgrub pa tsam yin kyang / khyad par can ni ma yin la/ sgrub pa khyad par can rnams ni 'phags pa'i lam yin pas/ lam de gtso bor bzhag pa'i dbang du byas nas/ ji ltar sgrub pa nyams su len pa thams cad kyi rten nam rgyu ni chos dbyings yin la/ chos dbyings de yang spros pa dang bral zhing rnam pa thams cad pa'o/ /de ni rang gi ngo bo'i stengs nas kun rdzob kyi chos gang gis kyang ma gos mod/ rnal 'byor can gyi blo la 'char tshul gyi dbang du byas nas/ tshogs lam gyi rten chos dbyings dang / sbyor lam gyi rten 1rdo/sgro

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/dbyings sogs lam lnga dang sa bcu'i rten gyi 'jug tshul byed do/ /chos rkodabyings de nyer len gyi rgyu dngos min kyang / 'dra ba'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i nyer len gyi tha snyad 'jog go/ /chos dbyings de rang bzhin gnas rigs yin la/thar pa'i rgyu dge chos 'phel ba'i rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs kyang de la brten te zhugs pa'i phyir/ de dang 'brel ba can yin pa'i rnam gzhag kyang byas so/ /sgrub pa'i dmigs pa tsam ni chos thams cad yin la/ dmigs pa'i gtso bo ni chos thams cad kyi chos nyid de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yin pas/don dam pa'i stong nyid de rten dang dmigs pa gnyis gar du rung ngo / /ched du bya ba ni sgrub pa byed pa'i skabs kyi 'dod don te/ 'di la rgya bod phal cher sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus pa'i spangs rtogs 'phrin las gsum mam sku bzhi'am/ mkhyen gsum sogs chen po gsum dang sbyor ba zhig snang yang /de'i thad kyi mdo dang mi mthun la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sgra bshad sangs rgyas la sbyor ba yang / 'tsham pa las 'das pa'i bshad pa yin pas/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' nyid kyi spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ 'phral 'phral du dgos pa'i 'dod don yin gyi/ mthar thug gi ched du bya ba kho na ma yin no/ /mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa'i sgra bshad kyi dbang du mdzad nas/ sems dpa' dang sems dpa' chen po'i sgra bshad kyis sems chen po dang / byang ba'i sgra bshad kyis spong ba chen po dang /chub pa'i sgra bshad kyis rtogs pa chen po bstan te/ mdo rgyas pa na/bcom ldan 'das kyis sems chen po dang / shā ri'i bus spong ba chen po dang / rab 'byor gyis rtogs pa chen po rnams gsungs la/ yon tan rin po che bsdud pa las/ ci phyir de ni sems dpa' che zhes bya zhe na/so/sdu can tshogs rnams mang po'i mchog tu gyur ba dang / /sems can khams

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/kyi lta rnams chen po gcod pa ste/ /de phyir 'di ni sems dpa' che zhes rab brjod de/ /gtong ba che dang blo che ba dang mthu che dang / /rgyal ba rnams kyi theg chen mchog la zhugs pa dang / /go cha chen po bsgos shing bdud kyi rgyu 'dul ba/ /de yi phyir na sems dpa' che zhes brjod pa yin/ /ces gsungs te/ 'jig rten pa rnams dang / nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi/ yon tan gyi tshogs rnams las ji ltar thos 'os su skad cig re re bzhin ma thob pa rnams thob par byed/ thob pa rnams spel bar byed pa'i 'jug pa sems bskyed dang ldan pas sems can gzhan thams cad kyi gtso bo dang mchog tu gyur ba ni sems chen po'o/ /bdag nyid kyis gzhan la chos bstan pas/ de rnams kyi bdag lta dang mthar lta la sogs pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ lam dang 'bras bu la 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa'i lta ba thams cad kyang spong bar byed pa ni spong ba chen po dang / sbyin pa chen po la sogs pa gzhan la med pa'i khyad chos dpag tu med pa mnga' ba rnams la yang / chos dbyings kyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i stobs kyis ma skechags pa ni rtogs pa chen po ste/ ri rab la mngon par dmigs na rgyu gro dha'i sdong po la che ba'i blo mi skye ba bzhin no/ /'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa gang spyod kyang / 'phral 'phral du ched gtad sbyor dgos pas/ ched du bya ba zhes bya ste/ 'phral 'phral du byed dgos rgyu'i don no/ /sgrub pa dngos ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug kur sher phyin gyis zin par byas nas lag len du 'debs pa yin te/ kha cig ngo bo phyin drug yin kyang sgrub pa'i ldog cha nas/ brtson 'grus min pas/ sgrub pa'i ngo bo ni brtson 'grus so zhes phal cher zer na/ de tsam zhig don la zhugs su ni rung yang / bshad pa'i nus pa bzang po ni min no/ /shes rab snying po/6 /do

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/'dir sgrub pa bzhi'i dbye ba ma gsungs pas skabs 'dir mi 'chad la/mdor na bdag nyid kyi yon tan rdzogs par byed pa'i sgrub pa dang / gzhan smin cing grol bar byed pa'i sgrub pa gnyis su ma 'dus pa med de/ rgyas par byang chub sems dpa'i sa las rtogs par bya'o/ /da ni lam shes pa nyid la mthong lam dang sgom lam gnyis su dbyer yod kyang / dmigs rnam gyi sgo nas mi 'dra ba med de/ mthong lam gyis ji ltar mthong ba'i don de nyid sgom lam gyis goms par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /sgom lam lam shes de yang ji lta bu snyam na/ ji skad du/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid/ /kun la mngon par 'du mi byed/ /chos rnams dmigs su med par ni/ /gtong bar byed pa don chen nyid/ /ces gsungs te/ mdo las kyang / sher phyin ni shin tu rnam par dag pa'i slad du snang bar bgyid pa'o/ /zhes sogs dang / sgrub pa med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ mun pa lta bu'i gzung 'dzin gyi snang ba sangs shing / ye shes kyi snang ba rgyas pa'i chos dbyings rnam pa kun ldan la mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ sgom lam mnyam gzhag de'i ngo bo nyid yin la/ de ni dge chos thams cad kyi mchog yin cing / gzugs sogs kun rdzob kun la sgrub pa mngon par 'du mi byed cing thob par yang mi byed la/ chos de rnams dmigs pa med pa'i dbyings su gtad pas/ don dam gyi dbyings der thim par byed pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa ste/ 'di ni mnyam gzhag sgrub pa sgom lam zhes bya zhing / rjes thob tu pos pa dang / bsngo ba dang rjes su yi rang gsum la slob dgos pa de ni mtshon byed de/ thabs mkhas kyi sgo thams cad la yang bslab par bya'o/ /rnam dag sgom lam zhes bya ba ni/ nyer lnga pa'i mdo 'a/sdu dngos su med kyang 'phros don tsam du zhor la 'phangs pa'ang yin te/

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/sgom lam gyis thob pa'i rnam dag gi ming ngo / /de yang ji skad du/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs/ /dag pa nyid de gang gi phyir/ /de gnyis tha dad ma yin cing / /dpyad du med pas dag par brjod/ /ces gsungs te 'bras bu'i dag pa dang / rang bzhin gyi dag pa dbye ba med pa de nyid/ ji ltar rigs par thob pa'i don no/ /de lta bu'i mthong lam dang sgom lam gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa na/ mdo rgyas pa las 'byung ba ltar phan yon sna tshogs pa rnams kyang 'byung ba yin no/ /gzhi shes kyi rang bzhin ni gong du bshad zin la/ nyan rang gi rgyud kyi gzhi shes sam byang chub sems dpa'i rgyud kyi yang /thabs mkhas dang mi ldan pa de ni/ chos kyi dbyings la thag ring pa yin cing / thabs mkhas dang ldan pa ni nye ba'o/ /'on kyang byang sems 'phags pa ni thabs la mi mkhas pa mi srid cing / so so skye bo'i de ni gzhi shes min pas/ theg chen pa la chos dbyings la thag ring ba'i gzhi shes med do snyam na/gzhi shes kyi sgrub pa la gzhi shes su btags pa yin pas/ so so skye bo la yod de/ mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes zer ba ni/ theg pa chen po rtogs par 'gyur ba la mi mthun phyogs kyi khyad par zhig gi ming ste/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes kyang de'i nang tshan yin mod kyi/ gtso bor byang chub sems dpa' rnams nyid/ gang zag gi bdag med pa sgom pa'i tshe/ dngos por 'dzin pa dang stong bar 'dzin pa skye na de'i ming yin te/ ji skad du/ gzugs sogs phung po stong nyid dang / /dus gsum rtog pa'i chos rnams dang / /sbyin sogs byang chub phyogs rnams la/ /spyod pa'i 'du shes mi mthun phyogs/ /zhes so/ /gnyen po'i gzhi shes ni/ byang chub sems dpa' gang zag gi bdag med pa sgom pa'i tshe yang / sangs rgyas la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i yin byed dam chags pa phra mos kyang ma gos par byed dgos na/ gzhan la sdurdon

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/cing chags pa 'gog pa lta smos kyang ci dgos pas/ gang zag gi bdag med sgom pa de yang / sems can nam phung po'i rnam pa ma log pa de 'dra ma yin par/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i rnam pa can no/ /de'i phyir bdag med des zin pa'i spyod pa yang 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa la rang gnas shing gzhan yang 'god pa'o/ /de ltar yang / sbyin la sogs la ngar 'dzin med/ /gzhan dag de la 'jug pa dang / /de ni chags pa'i mtha' 'gog pas/ /rgyal la sogs la chags pa phra/ /chos kyi lam ni rang bzhin gyis/ /dben pa'i phyir na de zab nyid/ /chos rnams rang bzhin ṣ+kagacig par ni/ /shes pas chags pa spong pa yin/ /ces gsungs te/ rang bzhin gcig pa ni rang bzhin 'od gsal bar gcig pas de shes pa'o/ /rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i rnam pa zhes bya ba ni/ chos nyid don dam pa rnam pa thams cad par gnas pa las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rnam par 'gro rgyu rnams ni/ yul gyi rnam pa ste/ deng sang don rnam zhes grags pa dmigs yul yin pas/ rnam kun dngos ma yin la/ dmigs yul de rnams la bsgoms pas/ me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar rang gi shes pa yang /rnam pa de dag dang mtshungs par shar ba ni/ yul can gyi rnam pa ste/ deng sang shes rnam du grags pa yin pas/ de ni rnam rdzogs nyid dang ngo bo gcig go/ /de la bstan bcos dang mdo rgyas pa las/ gzhi shes la bden bzhi'i rnam pa nyer bdun dang / lam shes la bden bzhi'i rnam pa so drug dang /rnam mkhyen la sna tshogs pa'i rnam pa brgyad dang bcu bshad pa las/ mkhyen pa dang po gnyis kyi rnam pa rnams bden bzhi'i rnam par 'dus so/ /de yang bden pa bzhi la dmigs nas kun rdzob rgyu mtshan gyi rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'a/sdu pa med kyang / rang bzhin spros pa thams cad dang bral bas khyad par

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/du byas pa nyid las nga bdag ma dmigs pa ni/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa dang /bden bzhis bsdus pa'i kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rten 'brel sgyu ma lta bu la/don dam par ci yang ma yin pa nam mkha' lta bu ste spros bral dang / rang gi nyams su bstar ba'i dge chos thams cad kyang / spros pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin nyid du gnas pa ni/ lam shes kyi rnam pa dang / don dam pa'i dbyings de ni nam mkha' ltar spros pa thams cad dang bral zhing / spros bral de nyid rnam pa thams cad par gdod nas shar ba dang / khyad par du yang byang phyogs dang phar phyin dang stobs bcu sogs dge chos thams cad kyi rnam par gnas pa ni rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa yin no/ /rnam pa de lta bu tshang bar byas nas ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni/ sbyor ba ste de yang mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba zhes bya ba/ dngos po dang mtshan ma dang dmigs pa gang la yang mi gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /des na chos gang dag skyes pa dang / byung ba dang / 'byung ba dang / gnas pa dang / 'phel ba dang yod pa sogs su mi 'dzin cing /de dag la sems mi gnas la/ 'gags pa dang / mi 'byung ba dang / ma byung ba dang / ma phrad pa dang / ma tshogs pa dang / 'gribs pa dang /med pa sogs la yang sems mi gnas te/ gang la yang mi gnas/ gar yang mi 'gro/ ci la yang mi 'gog gang du yang mi 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis mnyam par 'jog pa nyid yin te/ rtsol ba med pa'i phyir khyad chos mi sbyor ba'i sbyor ba sogs kyang de la tshang ba yin pas/ sbyor ba ni nyi shu'am lnga la sogs par grags kyang gcig kho na yin no/ /de ltar yang gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir/ de la sbyor ba bkag pa'i phyir/ zhes so/ /mdo 'di las dngos su ni mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba kho na bstan no/ /rtse mo'i sbyor ba dngos ni/mthong sgom bar chad med rtse gsum po yin na/ de rnams kyang shes ra/ ༵ pha

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/rol tu phyin pa'i rnam pa kho nar gcig pas/ dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba'i tshul du med mod/ 'on kyang / spang bya spong tshul dang yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i khyad par ni shin tu che la/ de la spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bzhi ni/gzung bya'i snang ba la brten nas kun nas nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog skye ba 'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa dang / de dag gi gnas ngan len la brten pa'i rnam rtog ni gzhi kun nas nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog gam gzung rtog ste dang po'o/ /gzung ba'i snang ba la brten nas skyes pa'i dad pa la sogs pa dge chos kyi rnam par rtog pa dngos por mngon par zhen pa'i mtshan nyid du 'dug pa de ni/ gnyen po gzung rtog ces bya ba yin no/ /phyi rol gzung ba'i snang ba la dngos su ma dmigs kyang / sems kyi rgyud tsam la dmigs nas/bdag gam chos rdzas yod du 'dzin pa ni/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa zhes bya la/sems kyi rgyud la dmigs nas/ gang zag gam chos btags yod tsam du 'dzin pa ni/ btags 'dzin rtog pa zhes bya'o/ /rnam rtog de dag las mngon gyur ba ni sbyor lam bzhis rim gyis spong pa yin la/ de rnams kyi nang nas chos nyid kyi ngo bo tsam mthong ba la sgrib pa mthong bas spang bar bya ba gang yin pa de dag ni mthong lam rtse sbyor gyis sa bon drung 'byin par byed cing /chos nyid kyi khyad par mthong ba la bar du gcod par byed pa/ sgom spangs su gtogs pa gang yin pa de ni/ sgom lam rtse sbyor rim can du byung ba rnams kyis rim gyis spong bar byed de/ sgom spang gi nang tshan gzhi kun nas nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog ces bya ba rnams ni/ bag la nyal gyi nyon sgrib la brten nas gnas pa'i rnam rtog yin cing / sa brgyad pa yan chad la ni de dag kyang mtshan ma med pa'i rnam rtog kho nar shes par bya'o/ /spang bya rnam rtog rardo ༵ yul snang ba dang bcas pa ni/ gdod ma nas ma grub cing / med

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/rol tu phyin pa'i rnam pa kho nar gcig pas/ dmigs rnam mi 'dra ba'i tshul du med mod/ 'on kyang / spang bya spong tshul dang yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i khyad par ni shin tu che la/ de la spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa bzhi ni/gzung bya'i snang ba la brten nas kun nas nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog skye ba 'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa dang / de dag gi gnas ngan len la brten pa'i rnam rtog ni gzhi kun nas nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog gam gzung rtog ste dang po'o/ /gzung ba'i snang ba la brten nas skyes pa'i dad pa la sogs pa dge chos kyi rnam par rtog pa dngos por mngon par zhen pa'i mtshan nyid du 'dug pa de ni/ gnyen po gzung rtog ces bya ba yin no/ /phyi rol gzung ba'i snang ba la dngos su ma dmigs kyang / sems kyi rgyud tsam la dmigs nas/bdag gam chos rdzas yod du 'dzin pa ni/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa zhes bya la/sems kyi rgyud la dmigs nas/ gang zag gam chos btags yod tsam du 'dzin pa ni/ btags 'dzin rtog pa zhes bya'o/ /rnam rtog de dag las mngon gyur ba ni sbyor lam bzhis rim gyis spong pa yin la/ de rnams kyi nang nas chos nyid kyi ngo bo tsam mthong ba la sgrib pa mthong bas spang bar bya ba gang yin pa de dag ni mthong lam rtse sbyor gyis sa bon drung 'byin par byed cing /chos nyid kyi khyad par mthong ba la bar du gcod par byed pa/ sgom spangs su gtogs pa gang yin pa de ni/ sgom lam rtse sbyor rim can du byung ba rnams kyis rim gyis spong bar byed de/ sgom spang gi nang tshan gzhi kun nas nyon mongs kyi rnam rtog ces bya ba rnams ni/ bag la nyal gyi nyon sgrib la brten nas gnas pa'i rnam rtog yin cing / sa brgyad pa yan chad la ni de dag kyang mtshan ma med pa'i rnam rtog kho nar shes par bya'o/ /spang bya rnam rtog rardo ༵ yul snang ba dang bcas pa ni/ gdod ma nas ma grub cing / med

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/bzhin du snang ba yin pa la de ltar rtogs pa ni spangs pa'i don yin te/ de skad du/ 'gog pa med pa'i rang bzhin la/ /mthong zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni/ /ci jig nyams shing ci zhig thob/ /rnam par rtog rigs ci zhig zad/ /skye med rnam pa ci zhig thob/ /gzhan gyi chos rnams kyang yod la/ /shes bya la yang ston pa yi/ /sgrib pa zad par brjod pa gang / /de la kho bos mtshar du brtsis/ /'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /bzhag par bya ba cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag blta/ /yang dag mthong na rnam par grol/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /mthong bas spang bar bya ba rnams ni/ dus gcig tu spong ba yin la/ sgom pas spang bar bya ba rnams ni rim gyis spong zhing yon tan yang rim gyis gang bar 'gyur te/ ji skad du/ yams nad 'di rnams zad nas ni/ /yun rings lon nas dbugs phyin ltar/ /rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba yi/ /bde sgrub yon tan phun tshogs kun/ /rgya mtsho che la chu bo bzhin/ /'bras bu mchog gis dpa' ba yi/ /sems dpa' chen po de la ni/ /rnam pa kun tu bsten par byed/ /ces 'byung ngo / /mthar gyis pas mthar chags su sgom pas ni/ rang rang gi ngo skal gyi spang bya phyin ci log gi bag chags phra mo rnams rim gyis spyong bar byed do/ /skad cig ma ni de ltar bag chags byang ba'i 'bras bu yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang phal cher 'dra ba/ skad cig gnyis par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i lam/bar chad med pa'i sbyor ba dang / rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba/ma rig bag chags kyi sa rtsa ba nas 'joms par byed pa de yin no/ /'bras bu chos sku'i mngon par rtogs pa la/ sku gsum dang 'phrin las te bzhi'o/ /de la ngo bo nyid sku ni/ chos dbyings shin tu dri ma med pa dag pa gnyis ldan de/legs pa'i yon tan gyi chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang / ngo sdo steng /

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/rnam par 'dug pa'o/ /de ltar yang / thub pa'i ngo bo nyid sku ni/ zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag thob gyur rnam kun rnam dag pa/ /de dag rang bzhin mtshan nyid can/ /ces gsungs te/ legs pa'i yon tan gyi chos de dag thams cad kyang / don dam gdod ma yin pas rang bzhin gyi ngo bor gnas kyi/ kun rdzob rnam 'gyur gyi tshul gyis ma yin no/ /'dir zag pa med pa'i chos zhes pa'i rgyas bshad la/ byang chub phyogs mthun sogs zag med kyi sde tshan nyer gcig gsungs pa yin pas/ gzhung gi gnas skabs de gnyis ngo bo nyid sku dang / rtogs pa ye shes chos sku zhes/ don tshan so sor 'byed pa ni mdo dang bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa ma yin no/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ni/ mtshan dpe mtha' yas pas nye bar brgyan pa'i ye shes kyi sku/ chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa cig char bskor ba po yin la/ sprul ba'i sku ni 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas par/ sangs rgyas kyi sprul ba rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ba rnams te/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis ston pa sogs la —mchog gi sprul pa'i sku zhes yongs su grags so/ /'dir ni de tsam zhig rnam par gzhag mod kyi/ sku gsum gyi rang bzhin ni sngar bshad zin pa ltar ro/ /'phrin las ni/ sems can thams cad la 'jug ste/ rang gi skal ba dang 'tsham par/ mngon par mtho ba'i bde ba dang / nges par legs pa'i phan pa la 'gon cing/ mthar thug gi 'azin las ni sangs rgyas rang nyid kyi go 'phang la 'gon pa'o/ /'o na mtshan dpe la sogs pa'i yon tan ni longs sprul gyi skabs su bshad cing / ngo bo nyid sku'am chos sku'i yon tan gyi skabs su med pas/ rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid can gyi yon tan min la/de ma yin pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyi grub pa'i bde gshegs snying po la/ mtshan da16 sdud par 'dod pa shin tu mi 'thad do snyam pa dang / rgyud bla ma las

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/kyang / gzugs sku la mtshan gyi yon tan so gnyis dang / chos sku la stobs sogs so gnyis bshad pas kyang ngo snyam na/ yon tan gyi sde tshan 'di rnams ni/ yang dag pa'i ngag dang / yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / de bzhin du skye ba la dbang ba dang / so so yang dag pa rig pa bzhi dang / mi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / sku dang gsung gi spyod lam bsrung ba mi mnga' ba dang / lha'i mig dang / rna ba dang / sku la 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba dang / gsung la ca co mi mnga' ba la sogs pa'i yon tan de dag kyang sku'i snang ba dang gsung gi snang ba med na khungs stongs par 'gyur la/ zad par dang zil gnon la sogs pa yang / sku dang 'brel ba las 'byung gi/ sku dang gsung gi snang ba med pa'i rig pa rnam med la ci zhig 'byung ste/ de dag gi spyod yul mthong ba po med pa'i phyir ro/ /sku'i spyod lam bsrung ba mi mnga' ba dang / sku la 'khrul pa mi mnga' ba de dgachos sku'i yon tan yin phyin/ 'khrul ba med rgyu'i sku de dang / bsrung ba med rgyu'i sku'i spyod lam de/ zhal phyag rnam pa'i gzugs brnyan can mtshan dpe can gyi sku la mi 'jog na/ mtshan dpe sogs gang yang med pa'i sku gzugs 'jim pa'i gong bu 'dra ba zhig yod dam ci/ ci ste chos kyi sku la sku lus med na ni/ de la 'khrul pa yod med kyi dpyad gzhi stongs te/ gzhan du na/ ri bong gi rwa la gas chag med pa yang ci'i phyir chos sku'i yon tan du mi 'jog sku de gzugs sku kho na yin na ni/ yon tan de dag kyang de nyid kyi spyod lam la sogs pa'i yon tan yin par 'gyur gyi chos sku'i ci'i phyir yin/chos sku'i nus mthu las gyur bas so snyam na ni/ mtshan dpe yang ci'i phyir chos sku'i mthu las ma byung / des na gang dag sangs rgyas ci med cang med du 'dod pa dang / sangs rgyas bya ba kha mig can gcig med kyi/ rdo 6rdo'i

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/skabs kyi rig pa hol thom me ba 'di ka chos sku zang ma yin cing / 'thab brtsod dang 'khrug long dang / nyo tshong dang / zhing las dang / zas gos dang / 'khrig pa'i longs spyod sogs don du gnyer ba/ nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gi lang long 'di ka chos sku'i rang 'od yin la/ sbyin sogs dang lha sgom pa la sogs pa gnas lugs las gol ba yin pas sgom du mi rung ngo / /zhes skad gsangs mthon pos lta ba mtho mtho por sgrog pa de ni/ mtshan dpe can gyi sku dang / gsung chos kyi sgra dbyangs dang / thugs shes bya thabs cad rig pa'i ye shes dang 'phrin las blang dor gyi gnas rnams/ rnam rtog tsam dang blos byas tsam yin no zhes mchog rnams g.yas chung du phab cing /nyon mongs rang ga ma yar bston nas sangs rgyas yin par thag gcod pa ste/dge chos sun 'byin cing / mi dge ba'i zhabs thog byed pa'i bla ma skyes chen bye ba khrag khrig byung ba 'di rnams ni/ gzhan 'phrul bdag po'i gcan pa kho nar nges so/ /yang 'di skad ces/ yon tan de dag ni chos sku dngos ma yin gyi/ chos sku'i nus pa la brten nas byung ba yin pa'i phyir 'dir smos so zhes pa 'di ni bden dgos te/ gzhan du na zad par la sogs pa 'khrul shes yin pa'i phyir chos sku dngos de ga la yin ce na/ chos kyi sku'i yon tan gyi sku dang zhing khams dang / mtshan dpe dang / zad par zil gnon la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul rnams kyang / 'khrul ba ma yin te yang dag pa'i ye shes nyag cig go/ /gdul bya gzhan snang du/ sa chu la sogs pa ston pa yang / kun rdzob bden pa la bltos te ni 'khrul snang du mi 'jog ste/so so skye bo rnams kyi las ngan gyi 'bras bu ni ma 'khrul la/ 'phags pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi spyod yul ni 'khrul lo zhes bya ba ni/ 'khrul ma 'khrul gyi da༈ zlo go log tu gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /ci ste las snang 'di kun rdzob tu bden na

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/ni/ gdul bya'i don du 'gyur ba'i tshe/ ri dang chu la sogs pa 'gro ba spyi mthun gyi snang ngor brtan par gnas pa yang mthong bas de dag bden cing gzhan dag mi bden no/ /zhes dbye ba ci'i phyir nus/ de lta bas na/ rgyal ༵ /rdzu /r+sha bcas pa la dad pa mi 'dor ba shin tu gal che'o/ /shin tu spros da ni shāX/ nga//mi/shā k+to // //ga /rdo mdzo/ /kā ba kyi/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo 'di nyid kyi tshig dang rim pa bzhin du sbyar bar — bya'o/ /de yang de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus zhes pa nas/ gang ba med pa'o zhes pa'i bar gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen nyid bstan pa yin te/ dri ba dri lan gyi skabs su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyad pa spyod par 'dod pa/ zhes pas sems bskyed dang / ji ltar bslab pa zhes dris pa la 'di ltar rnam par blta bar bya ste/ zhes gdams pas ni/ gdams ngag bstan pa dang / rang bzhin gyis stong par yang dag par rjes su blta'o/ /zhes pas ni sbyor lam gyi dmigs rnam bstan pas nges 'byed cha mthun no/ /de ltar yang / dmigs pa mi rtag la sogs pa/ /bden pa'i rten can de yi ni/rnam pa mngon zhen la sogs 'gog / ces gsungs so/ /gzugs stong pa'o zhes pa la sogs pas sgrub pa'i rten chos dbyings bstan no/ /de lta bas na chos thams cad stong pa nyid de sogs kyis sgrub pa'i dmigs pa dang /mtshan nyid med pa sogs kyis spong ba chen po la sogs pa ched du bya ba chen po gsum bstan no/ /bri ba med cing gang ba med pa zhes pas/ spang bya sgrib pa rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs shing / thob bya lam dang yon tan thamasdu 7rdod

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/kyang sgyu ma lta bur shes nas/ bri gang bsal bzhag med par rtogs kyang tshogs gnyis rlabs po che rgyun mi 'chad par spyod pa'i sgrub pa bstan pa yin te/'dir sgrub pa'i ngo bo tsam zhig bstan pas/ dbye ba go cha'i sgrub pa/'jug pa'i sgrub pa/ tshogs kyi sgrub pa/ nges 'byung sgrub pa'i khyad par rnams shugs la bstan pa yin no/ /de ltar na rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos bcu po bstan pas mtshon bya rnam mkhyen bstan pa yin la/ der ma zad zab mo'i mtshan nyid rnam pa brgyad dang ldan pa'i sher phyin bstan pa kho nas kyang don dam pa'i rnam mkhyen chos kyi sku nyid gsal bar bstan pa yin no/ /stong pa nyid la gzugs med ces pa la sogs pas phung po dang skye mched dang khams rnams rang bzhin med par bstan pa 'dis ni/ lam shes kyi dmigs pa'i yul gsal bar bstan pas/ de ltar rtogs pa'i lam shes nyid nges par bstan pa yin la/ dbye ba'i tshig mi gsal yang mthong lam dang / sgrub pa sgom lam gnyis rnam dag dang bcas pa shugs la bstan pa yin no/ /ma rig pa med sogs rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs 'byung lugs zlog bkag pas ni/dngos bstan gnyen po'i phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi dmigs rnam gsal bar bstan pa yin la/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi rten 'brel stong nyid du bstan pa'i shugs la/ nyan rang gi gzhi shes kyang 'phangs pa yin no/ /de bzhin du sdug bsngal ba dang sogs kyis/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i rnam pa rnams bstan te/ gzhi shes lam shes kyi rnam pa rnams ni/ bden bzhi spros pa dang bral ba'i rnam par 'dus la/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rnams ni ye shes zhes par 'dus so/ /thob pa med pa dang ma thob pa med pa zhes pas ni/ mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba dngos su bstan cing / de'i khyad chos mi sbyor ba'i sbyor ba so/sdu shugs la bstan la/ thob pa zhes pa yon tan dang 'bras bu thob pa kho

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/na la 'chad pa ltar na/ slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs la sogs pa/ don tshan phyi ma bzhi yang don gyis bstan par 'gyur ro/ /thob pa med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la brten cing gnas zhes pa ni/ mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba'i rgyun shin tu goms shing byung ba la gnas pa'i don te/rtse mo'i sbyor ba dngos yin la/ sgrib pa med cing skrag pa med ces pas mthong sgom gyi rtse sbyor gyis/ spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa spong tshul bstan te/chos nyid mthong ba la bsgrib pa'i mthong spangs med cing / chos nyid kho na la gnas mi nus par skrag pa'i sgom spangs med do zhes dngos su bstan la/ rtse sbyor gyi rtags dang / log sgrub spong ba rnams kyang shugs la 'phangs so/ /phyin ci log las shin tu 'das nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar phyin to/ /zhes pas mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba bstan te/ bslab pa gsum la phyin ci log pa'i gnyen por pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / rtag pa la mi rtag par 'dzin pa sogs log lta bzhi'i gnyen por rjes dran drug dang / mi rtag pa la rtag par 'dzin pa la sogs pa lta ba phyin ci log gi gnyen por bdag med gnyis kyi don la sgom pa dngos med ngo bo nyid kyi mthar gyis pa gsungs te/ spyir mthar gyis pa'i rnam pa la tshad bzung du med de/ sbyor ba snga ma gnyis kyi rnam pa thams cad las 'di rnam pa mang mod kyang / chos bcu gsum gyi grangs su bcad pa ni/ phyin ci log gi gnyen por dgongs pa'i phyir te/phyin ci log las shin tu 'das zhes pas mthar gyis pa bstan to/ /dus gsum du sogs pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ste sangs rgyas thams cad gang rkobasgoms pa la brten nas/ dngos su sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur ba'i lam shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de ni/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba yin te/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes kyi ming gi rnam grangs so/ /sngags kyi phan yon rnams ni /sdu sku

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/mdzad pa dang bcas pa ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags zhes pa mdor bstan dang rig pa chen po zhes pa ngo bo nyid sku dang / bla na med pa zhes pa longs sku dang / 'jig rten khams su mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa ni sprul pa'i sku ste sku gsum dang / sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa ni 'phrin las te chos sku'i mdzad pa'o/ /chos kyi sku 'gyur med yongs grub de ni/ mnyam gzhag ye shes 'khrul ba dang bral bas nyams su myong bya yin pa'i phyir/ bden par grub pa yin la/ brdzun pa kun rdzob 'khor ba'i chos thams cad las gdod nas grol ba'i phyir/ mi rdzun pa ste brdzun pa ma yin pa'i don no/ / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags zhes pa ni/'phrin las kyi khyad par chos sku'i rgyu mthun pa'i rig sngags so/ /kha cig sngags don la/ lam lnga dang sbyor ba ni skabs 'dir yang blang ste/ ga te ni song pa ste tshogs lam/ ga te gnyis pa ni sbyor lam/ pa ra ga te ni mthong lam ste/ pa ra zhes pa mchog ste 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ye shes yin pa'i phyir ro/ /pa ra sam ga te ni de bas kyang lhag pa yang dag par song ba'i ye shes te sgom lam mo/ /bo d+dha ni byang chub ste 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa 'o/ /zhes skyes bu dam pa 'ga' zhig gsungs so/ /da ni sher( phyi rdo d+dhi /ra /zlo dzo//sna // 1 k+ta / rā ma sna shā ṭ+wāṃ/ma gyi lag len cung zad brjod par bya ste/ de yang thub pa'i bstan pa la brtul zhugs yang dag par blangs nas/ theg pa chen po'i sde snod la thos bsam ci rigs par bya'o/ /tshe 'dir mang du thos pa kho na ma lcags na yang / gong du ji skad ba/nā pa ltar mdo sde dam pa 'di nyid kyi/ dngos bstan tshig don dang

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/'grel ba'i go ba rnams legs par rtogs shing / the tshom med pa blo la gsal po 'byung ba zhig nges par gal che'o/ /khyad par stong pa nyid kyi lta ba dang /snying rje chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnams la nges pa rnyed pa dang / chos la yid ches dang dad pa brtan por gyur gyi bar du yang yang bsam pa gal che na/ de'i don du skyes bu gsum gyi rim pa lta bu sngon 'gror byas na legs so/ /de nas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing / 'grub na —'jug sems kyi sdom pa yang blang bar bya'o/ /spyir mdo sde'i rgyan las gsungs pa ltar/ dmigs pa'i sems drug dang yid la byed pa bcu gcig dang /sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu la sogs pa dgos kyang / 'dir don gyi snying po mdo tsam ni 'di lta bus sgom par bya ste/ dang por gnas khang gtsang mar/sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs dang mdo sde 'di'i glegs bam bzhugs su gsol/mchod pa ji ltar 'os pa bshams/ khrus la sogs pa gtsang spra dang ldan pas/yan lag bdun pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas ste/ lus rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan par bya/ sna nas rlung lan gsum bsal/dbugs rang babs su bzhag ste/ bdag gang la bsten nas sgom zhing sgrub pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo 'di'o/ /zhes yid la dran cing gzhan gang la yang ma yengs par/ 'di ltar bsam ste/ sho lo ka nyer lnga'i tshad tsam 'di ni sher phyin snying po'i mdo yin no/ /bdag ni 'di la brten nas sangs rgyas sgrub bo snyam pa de nyid lan brgya tsam dran par byas nas/bar der dge ba byang chub tu bsngos te/ khams gseng zhing / 'chag pa la sogs pa ji ltar bde bas ngal gsos la/ yang sngar gyi tshad tsam du sgom par bya'o/ /de ltar thun bcu tsam byas pas zhag gcig la/ yid la byed pa stong phrag gcig tu 'gyur la/ thun gyi tshad nyi grib la sogs pa nges pa /nā du

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/byas nas/ gal te khams dub na nyi ma gcig gam gnyis sam gsum du thun thams cad nas cha zi ba'am/ thun 'ga' zhig cha phri ba'am/ gang mi bde ba'i thun 'angog pa lta bu ji ltar 'os pas ngal gso/ thog ma'i thun gyi tshad ni ring thung rang gi blo dang 'tsham par sbyang bas rung ste/ de nas cung zad goms shing sgom pa la spro bar gyur pa'i tshe/ thun cung zad cung zad bskyed cing / yang khams log na cung zad cung zad zi'o/ /de la cung zad goms pa na/ mdo sde 'di la ni dang por gling gzhi dang / de nas gleng bslang ba dang / de nas zab mo brgyad kyi stong nyid dang / mkhas par bya ba drug phan yon dang bcas pa yi rang gi bar du yod do/ /don 'di ni bdag gi sgom bya yin pa sogs gong bzhin bsam ste/ 'di dmigs pa theb pa'i phyir/dmigs thengs re la snga ma las yun gsum bzhi tsam gyis ring bar 'jog dgos te/ thun re'i nang du lan bzhi bcu'am lnga bcu la sogs pa sgom par bya'o/ /'di yang ring du goms nas/ thun so so'i mgor sngon bzhin ca bsgoms te/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su/ mdo 'di las bstan pa'i zab mo brgyad dang ldan pa'i stong nyid ces bya ba ni/ gzhan zhig yod pa ma yin pa 'di lta ste/ bdag gzhan snod bcud kyi chos sna tshogs par snang ba 'di/rang sems 'khrul ba'i snang ba tsam shar ba ma gtogs cung zad kyang ngo bos med pa nyid do/ /zhes yang yang bsams shing / de ltar bsam pa lan nyer gcig sogs song ba na/ yang sngar gyi dmigs pa gnyis po sngon du 'gro bar byas nas de 'dra nyer gcig sgom pa lta bu bya'o/ /de la cung zad goms nas/ma skyes pa la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan gcig gam gnyis sam mang po rang gi blo'i 'khobs dang bstun nas dran par byed pa yang bsnon no/ /yang de bzhin du phurdo lhaswā zhes bya ba ni rang gzhan snod bcud kyi steng na gnas pa 'di dang 'di

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/dag yin la/ de thams cad kyang gdod ma nas ma grub po zhes gcig du bral la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan cung zad dran par byas te 'dun pa shugs drag po sbyangs/ de bzhin du khams dang skye mched dang rten 'brel dang bden bzhi dang / gnas dang gnas min la yang sbyor dgos te/ blo rgya che na rim can du sgom/ rgya chung na de dag las gang yang rung ba blo la bde zhing gsal ba cig sgom ste/ de dag ni sngon 'gro 'jug pa'i rim pa yin no/ /da ni dngos gzhi la/ yan lag bdun pa nas/ mdo don bsam pa'i bar tshar gcig song nas/ rang gzhan snod bcud 'khor 'das thams cad ji ltar snang ba 'di sgyu ma lta bu yin/ yang dag par na cung zad kyang ma grub bo/ /gcig du bral la sogs pa cung zad gcig dran par byas nas nges shes kyang bskyed/de ltar rang gzhan snang ba thams cad kyi steng du bsnyams pa'i tshe/ gang yang ma grub pa de la che re mnyam par gzhag tshul des bden med du bsam pa dang / nges shes bskyed pa dang / ngang la 'jog pa gsum po de dag yang yang bskyar te/ bcu'am nyer gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa song ba na/yang mdo don dran pa sngon du song bas dmigs pa nyer gcig la sogs pa bya'o/ /de dag gi bar bar du sher phyin gyi mdo 'di'i phan yon dang /gsung ba po sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dran nas/ sangs rgyas dang chos spyi dang /dgos su 'di la pos gus dung nge ba re bsgom/ sems can 'khrul pa rnams la snying rje lhag pa re yang gsal btab/ de ltar gnad du 'gro bar byung na/ zhag bdun bdun tsam re nas/ bsam med du mnyam par 'jog pa de cung zad cung zad re yun ring du btang / de yang mi rtog pa'i blo ngo na ci yang ma yin pa'i rnam pa de 'char gyi 'dug na de yun ring du gtong ba yin gyi/shes pa mi gsal ba mun chun par yod na shes pa bzo med du bzhag snyizlo mi

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/phan pas/ gnad snga ma gnyis la shugs bskyed pa gal che/ de dag gi skabs su sgom thun yun ring por thub na thun mtshams su ngal gso zhing /chos spyod kyi rim bcu mdo tsam re byas pas chog la/ thun yun phung ngu las mi byed na/ thun mtshams kyi chos spyod gal che ste/ de la thun mtshams kyi spyod pa ni spyir chos spyod sgo thams cad nas yin kyang / khyad par mdo sde 'di nyid ye ger 'bri ba dang / 'di'i glegs bam la mchod pa dang /glegs bam klog pa dang / kha don du byed pa dang / mdo'i don 'chad pa'am/ nyan pa'am/ bsam pa la sogs pa'o/ /de dag goms nas/sems gnas pa dgu'i rim pas stong nyid la dmigs pa'i zhi gnas dang /rang sems kyi ngo bo nyid dang / khyad par yang yang btsal bas cha shas tsam gyi lhag mthong la brten nas stong pa nyid la nges pa rnyed par 'gyur ba sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /de'i tshe rang bzhin gang du yang ma grub pa'i ngang nas sems kyi gsal snang dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyi gzugs sna tshogs 'byung ste/ gtso bor mi rtog pa'i stobs las 'byung gi/ dpyad pa'i skabs su 'byung ba ni nyung ngo / /de ni sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba dang / rang bzhin rnam pa thams cad pa yin pa'i rtags su ngo sprod par bya'o/ /sgom tshul gnad kyi snying po de ltar bzung nas/ rnal 'byor gyi sa bzhi'am/ theg pa chen po'i thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam gtan bzhi'am/ rnal 'byor gyi sa lnga la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa dang sbyar te bshad pas rung zhing / dngos gzhi'i skabs su dpyad mthar mi rtog par 'jog pa dang / thog ma'i dus su dpyad pa byed cing phyis mi rtog pa kho nar 'jog pa dang / thog ma nyid nas kyang mi rtog pa nyid la 'jug pa dang / sngags kyi theg pa dang go mthun du sgrurdo /la sogs/ thams cad kyang gang zag so so'i blo dang bstun na legs

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/par 'gyur ba sha stag go/ /shin tu zab pa'i mdo sde 'di/ /rang blo'i stobs dang sbyar te bshad/ /ha cing mangs na rtogs dkar 'gyur/ /dka' 'grel tshul du mdo tsam bkrol/ /dge ba 'di yis sems can thams cad/ /sangs rgyas rtag pa'i go 'phangs thob gyur/ /de srid du yang legs bshad mang sgropos/ /phan bde phyogs kun khyab par gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i 'grel pa/ sngon med legs bshad ces bya ba 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas sbyar ba'o/ /mdo 'di la dri me/ 2/rdo/ r+shar+sha kau k+ta rdo/sdu ṭī rā/ 'grel yin nges bstan pa snga dar la 'gyur ba de dang / de la 'grel bshad rngog lo chen pos mdzad pa dang / de gnyis kyi dgongs 'grel klags chog ma/ ar byang chub ye shes kyis mdzad pa dang / bcom ldan rig ral gyi tshig nyung la don bzang ba'i 'grel chung zhig dang / rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan gyi 'grel pa dang /mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan shākya mchog ldan gyi 'grel pa dang / bstan 'gyur du chug pa la/ jo bo rjes mdzad zer ba'i 'grel pa legs po zhig dang / dzñā na mi dris mdzad zer ba dang / pra shasta su nas mdzad zer ba dang / mahā dza nas mdzad zer ba rnams kyang snang ngo / /phyi ma 'dis gzhan stong gi tshul du yang 'grel zhing / de dag phal cher bshad sgros dri med bshes gnyen gyi 'grel chen dang phyogs mthun rung ngo / /gang ltar mkhas pa rnams kyi dpyad gzhir gyur pa'i 'grel pa de dag mthong zhing / gzhan yang rtse thang 'bum ri pa'i ṭī ka sogs blo gsar ba'i rnam rtog 'ga' re dang / bal po a su'i ngag sgros bstan 'gyur du chud pa cig dang / lce sgom ljong bas mardonā pa

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/dang / gzhan yang bar skabs su byung ba'i phyag rdzogs zhi byed kyi lugs su bkral ba sus byas mi shes pa sna tshogs dang / dngos grub dpal 'bar bas rang gi yon tan sgrog pa kho na lta bur blangs pa'i ṭika chung sogs phyis byung gi ston sgom du 'dod pa sna tshogs pas sbyar ba'i 'grel pa shob thag can 'ad 'ud mang po yin snang ngo / /'dir ni bi ma la'i bzhin pa logs su bkod pa ma gtogs gzhan de dag gang gi yang rjes su ma 'brangs par/ rang blo'i stobs kyis bshad pa'o/ /'o na parnyi ta dang lo tsā ba chen po dang / sde snod 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug rnams kyis bshad pa byas zin pa'i phyir/ khyod kyis 'dir rnam bshad byed mi dgos la/ de dag dang bshad sgros mi mthun par byed pa yang 'os pa ma yin te/ chen po dag gi gsung la gras btod pa ni smra kham ha cing ches so snyam na/ spyir gzhan la phan pa'i rgyu rang bzos rnam bshad byed dgos pa ma yin pa dang / de dag bas bdag cag blo gros kyi stobs mchog tu gyur pa yang ma yin pa dang / de dag gi bsod nams dang ye shes dang / tshul khrims kyi tshogs la/ bdag cag gis char yang bsgrun par nus pa ma yin pa ni bden no/ /'on kyang rang gi blo gros goms pa'i phyir byed pa dang / ches che ba dag gis ni gzhung phra mo dag la che thang du ma mdzad pa yang snang zhing / blo gros chung bas kyang bsgrims pa na/ blo chen dag gis ma rnyed pa'i legs bshad ci rigs pa rnyed pa yang srid pa ni yin no/ /de dag gi yon tan la mchog tu gus pa dang / sku drin dran pa ni yod mod kyang /de dang des bshad pa gang la gnod byed gsal bar mthong ba dang / de dag gis ma bshad pa dag la yang rtags dang rgyu mtshan tshad ma mthong ba'i nges shes skyes pa'i tshe/ rkyen gang gis kyang zlog par ma nus te 'di tsam zhig smra ba la nyesdu 8sdu ci yang med do/ /bdag cag 'phags pa'i blo can ma yin pas 'khrul

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/bar smras su zin kyang 'os pa'i cing / phyogs 'dzin tsam gyi chags sdang ma yin par nges pa nyid du nor bar shes na ni/ kho bo cag gi bshad pa 'di yang ci bder spongs shig dang / bdag gi khro ba dang 'khon pa'i sems bskyed par mi byed do ci ste lung rigs gsal zhing nges pa yod na kho bos kyang len par bgyi'o/ /stod lung rgya dmar ba chen po'i zhal na re/ ma rab mtho sar phyin pa dag / gzhan gyis byas la bskyor 'byin bzhin/ /dam pa'i legs bshad spangs nas ni/ /gzhan du rnam 'jog mi rigs mod/ /rnam dag yid ches ma skyes pas/ /dbang med rnam dpyod 'di ltar rig / ces dang / rje btsun dam pa mkhas rnasas kyi/ /bzhed dang mi mthun mang bshad kyang / bram ze gtsang spra kun spyod bzhin/ /rnam dpyod rtog ge pa yi tshul/ /des na mkhas rnams mi mnyes med/ /bla ma dag gi drin yin mod/ /rang gi sbyangs ba'i khyad las kyang / /rnam dpyod rtog ge sems la shar/ /dkyus sa bstan pa'i rta bzhin du/ /rtog dpyod yul la kha mi thub/ /gzhung mang gyur kyang rang dbang med/ /skye bo blo yi nor ldan rnams/ /phyogs 'dzin spangs pa'i yid kyis dpyod/ /skal ldan 'di la dga' mchog skye/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bdag kyang smra ste/ blun po'i dad pa phyogs gcig pas/ /dam pa snga ma'i gsungs rjes su/ /'brang na shin tu brling mod kyi/ /blo gros chung yang gnod byed dang / /sgrub byed tshad ma mthong ba'i tshe/ /spru ba po de ches bzang yang / /'gal ba'i rjes su 'jug ma 'dod/ /yang smras pa/ zhe sdang khro bas smras na yang / /dam pa rnams ni bzod mdzad na/ /grub pa'i sems ni ma btang bas/ /mi dgyes par ni ci la 'gyur/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i slob ma la/ /gang gi blo gros mchog skyes pa/ /'di yang de de'i drin yin ces/ /gus pa'i tshul ni nyams pa med/ /rgyal po'i rgyal po'i blon po sogs/ /stobasdu 8snying

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/bar smras su zin kyang 'os pa'i cing / phyogs 'dzin tsam gyi chags sdang ma yin par nges pa nyid du nor bar shes na ni/ kho bo cag gi bshad pa 'di yang ci bder spongs shig dang / bdag gi khro ba dang 'khon pa'i sems bskyed par mi byed do ci ste lung rigs gsal zhing nges pa yod na kho bos kyang len par bgyi'o/ /stod lung rgya dmar ba chen po'i zhal na re/ ma rab mtho sar phyin pa dag / gzhan gyis byas la bskyor 'byin bzhin/ /dam pa'i legs bshad spangs nas ni/ /gzhan du rnam 'jog mi rigs mod/ /rnam dag yid ches ma skyes pas/ /dbang med rnam dpyod 'di ltar rig / ces dang / rje btsun dam pa mkhas rnasas kyi/ /bzhed dang mi mthun mang bshad kyang / bram ze gtsang spra kun spyod bzhin/ /rnam dpyod rtog ge pa yi tshul/ /des na mkhas rnams mi mnyes med/ /bla ma dag gi drin yin mod/ /rang gi sbyangs ba'i khyad las kyang / /rnam dpyod rtog ge sems la shar/ /dkyus sa bstan pa'i rta bzhin du/ /rtog dpyod yul la kha mi thub/ /gzhung mang gyur kyang rang dbang med/ /skye bo blo yi nor ldan rnams/ /phyogs 'dzin spangs pa'i yid kyis dpyod/ /skal ldan 'di la dga' mchog skye/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bdag kyang smra ste/ blun po'i dad pa phyogs gcig pas/ /dam pa snga ma'i gsungs rjes su/ /'brang na shin tu brling mod kyi/ /blo gros chung yang gnod byed dang / /sgrub byed tshad ma mthong ba'i tshe/ /spru ba po de ches bzang yang / /'gal ba'i rjes su 'jug ma 'dod/ /yang smras pa/ zhe sdang khro bas smras na yang / /dam pa rnams ni bzod mdzad na/ /grub pa'i sems ni ma btang bas/ /mi dgyes par ni ci la 'gyur/ /dngos dang brgyud pa'i slob ma la/ /gang gi blo gros mchog skyes pa/ /'di yang de de'i drin yin ces/ /gus pa'i tshul ni nyams pa med/ /rgyal po'i rgyal po'i blon po sogs/ /stobasdu 8snying

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/bsod nams blo che yang / /de dag rnams kyis ma go ba/ /zhing pa blun pos rig pa'ang yod/ /de bzhin bdag gis 'dir yang ste/ /sngon med legs bshad gsar ba'i 'phreng / /blo ldan rnams kyi mgul rgyan du/ /byin pa 'di la yi rang byos/ /zhes pa'ang smras te rnam par bshad pa 'di gcig pur ma zad/bdag cag gis nye bar sbyar ba'i bstan bcos thams cad la go dgos so/ /yang kha cigazhu shā/ sngo//da/ k+ṣiṃ ba// shā lo zlo rdo /dri bshā sdur/ cig chen po rnams kyis ma bshad pa'i legs bshad mang du smras so bya ba 'dug na/ khyen kyi smra ba 'di rnams kyi nang na/ sngon gzhan sus kyang ma bshad pa'i legs bshad ni gang yin/ de yang ston dgos so zhe na/ de la smras pa/ spyir dam pa snga ma dag gis gtan nas ma bshad pa'i legs bshad kho bo la yod pa ma yin te/ de 'dra ba ni yod kyang ngo mtshar mi che'o/ /'on kyang sher phyin snying po'i mdo 'di'i steng du/ brjod bya'i don zab mo 'di dang 'di yod do zhes ston pa na/ mdo 'di'i 'grel byed sngar byung dag gis ma bshad pa ni mang du yod do/ /de la thog mar 'di yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa ni/ sher snying gi don 'grel khyad par can du 'dug pa la/ sngon chad de ltar yin pa'i kha skad tsam yang mi snang mod/ 'dir bstod pa des mdo 'di'i don legs par bshad de bkral ba ni sher snying gi 'grel pa sngon chad byung ba su la yang med cing ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i legs bshad dang po'o/ /bsdus don gyi gnas skabs su/ gzugs stong pa'o zhes sogs zab mo'i mtshan nyid brgyad po gnas lu/sdu spros bral dmigs pa'i yul gtan la 'bebs byed du 'chad pa dang

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/zab mo brgyad po stong nyid gsum dang sbyar te 'chad pa ni gnyis pa'o/ /stong pa nyid la gzugs med ces sogs mkhas par bya ba'i dngos po drug dang sbyar te/ gnas lugs de sgom pa'i tshul dang sbyor ba ni gsum pa'o/ /de lta bas na zhes sogs de ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon ston pa rnams kyis/ sa lam gyi rim pa rgyud la skye tshul 'chad pa ni bzhi pa'o/ /yang shugs bstan gyi dbang du byas nas/ stong pa nyid la gzugs med ces pa nas phan yon gyi bar gyis/bdag tu lta ba rnam pa bcu'i gnyen por/ gang zag gi bdag med rgyas pa bstan pa'i tshul du 'chad pa ni lnga pa'o/ /mdo tshig dum bu brgyad du byas nas/dngos po brgyad 'chad par sbyar ba na/ shin tu gsal zhing 'grig par byung ba 'di ni drug pa'o/ /'di ni rigs pa dang yang mthun te/ spros bral gyi stong nyid tsam ston pas/ mdo rgyas pa'i snying po'i don 'dus pa'i phyir snying por 'jog na ni/ sum brgya pa la sogs pa yang ci'i phyir sher phyin gyi snying por mi 'gyur/ tshig nyung ba kho nas snying por 'gyur na ni/ 'di bas kyang yi ge gcig ma nyung ba'i phyir de la snying po'i tha snyad ci'i phyir mi sbyor/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mngon rtogs lam rim gyi gtso bo de/ dngos po brgyad kyi rim pa 'di yin na/ sbas don gyi tshul gyis de 'dra mi ston na ni/mdo thams cad kyi snying po'i sgras brjod pa yang don med par 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir 'di ni sher phyin gyi yan lag tsam gyi mdo ma yin te/ don gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa yang yin la/ rnam grangs kyi spros pa dor ba'i phyir snying po'o/ /yang sems bskyed dang gdams ngag la sogs pa nyams len sgrub pa'i don gyi rnam grangs bco brgyad/ tshig don la shin tu gsal bar 'byor bar bshad de/ 'di yang sngon med pa'i legs bshad bdun pa'o/ /mdo 'dis stong nyid bcu drug gam bco brgyad tshig zur gyis gsal bar thon pa/ 8rdol

sher snying 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad/dang sgom pa rnam g.yeng gi rnam rtog bcu'i gnyen por 'chad pa 'di yang sngon med pa'i legs par bshad pa brgyad pa'o/ /'dir dngos bstan dang sbas don gnyis ka 'chad pa las thun mong rnams chabs gcig tu 'chad pa dang /thun mong ma yin pa rnams dngos bstan la sbas don ma 'dres shing / dngos bstan dang sbas don dmigs phyed par 'chad pa 'di yang sngon med pa'i legs par bshad pa ste dgu pa'o/ /gling bslang ba'i skabs su/ phung lnga stong par sgom pa sher phyin la 'jug pa'i thabs su bshad pas/ sher phyin dngos dang stong rkyang mi gcig par bsgrub pa dang / stong nyid gzugs so zhes sogs dang / bri gang med pa'i tshig dang / stong nyid khyad gzhir byas nas 'dus byas bkag pa dang / bden par shes par bya ste/ zhes pa ste khyad par gyi tshig lngas/ dbu ma'i mthar thug gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i don gsal bar 'chad pa 'di ni bcu pa yin te/ de rnams kyi nang tshan las gye ba'i sngon med legs bshad kyi khyad par shin tu mang por 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir 'di ni dge legs phun sum tshogs pa rab tu 'phel bar byed pa'o/ //lha /'ang kun dga' snying pos 'phros don du brjod pa'o/ /dge legs —184

oṃ su ste/ don dam 'o/ ni/kāṭā ༵༵ dbyings ye shes 'khor 'das kun khyab las/ /'jam dbyangs gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa bla ma'i tshul 'chang ba/ /kun mkhyen tā ra nā tha rgyal bstan mdo sngags yongs kyi bdag / lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi gtsug gi rgyan du bkur/ /nyid kyi mdo 'grel sngon med legs bshad kyis/ /mtha' bral byams klu'i dgongs don 'gal med du/ /gzhan dring mi 'jog lung rigs yang dag gis/ /mdo don mthar thug gzhan stong dbu mar bsgrubs/ /bstan bcos khyad 'phags 'dzam gling spyi nor 'di/ /gcig las du ma 'byung ba'i 'phrul gyi gzhi/ /chos sbyin 'dzad med chu bo'i rgyun la 'gran/ /'dzong bo skyabs mgon sku phreng gnyis pa mchog/ngag dbang shes rab rdo rje gang nyid kyis/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i thugs bskyed zla bral mthus/ /bstan 'gro'i don du dmigs nas yon sbyar te/ /yig — tshogs zad med 'phrul gyi sgo chen phyes/ /legs byas 'di'i mtshon rgyal sras rab dkar mdzod/ /gcig tu bsdoms pa'i rnam dkar bsod nams kyis/ /bstan 'dzin yongs kyi sku tshe 'du byed brtan/ /chabs gcig rgyal bstan rdzogs ldan dar zhing rgyas/ /'gro mang bde skyid dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin/ /sbyin bdag phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bral/ /bstan 'dzin sde rgyas thugs mthun 'dul khrims gtsang / /thos bsam sgom pa'i brtson pa lhod med shog/rab dkar 'di'i mtshon skye 'phags bsod nams kyis/ /pha ma 'brel thogs rigs drug sems can rnams/ /'khor ba'i sdig rgyun kun chad mngon mtho'i rten/ /thob nas mdo sngags nyams rtogs skye bar shog / rten 'di /sdu na

bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs su/ /dus 'khrugs kun zhi chab srid brtan pa dang / /lo phyugs kun legs tshe ring nad med kyi/ /bskal pa bzang po nam yang nyam med shog /de ltar smon don ji bzhin 'grub pa'i gnyen/ /don dam mchog gsum gnas lugs chos kyi dbyings/ /gdod nas bzhugs pa dus gsum rgyal kun gshis/ /nam yang ris 'jog med par myur mngon shog / ces skyes thob yon tan gyi che ba yongs su rdzogs shing lam bslab pa gsum dang /thos bsam sgom gsum gyi spangs rtogs mthar phyin pas rang don tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs shing / gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum dang dbang lung gdams ngag ma lus pa la brten nas mdo sngags gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mgrin pa gzengs su mtho ba dang / khyad par mdo don mthar thug gzhan stong dbu ma chen po'i lta ba'i rkang byas te/ sngags gsar rgyud kyi gsang sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen por bzhugs shing /mtshan brjod par dka' ba don rgya chen po'i slad du mtshan nas smos na rje tā rā nā tha'am/ jo nang rje btsun kun dga' snying po zhes mtshan gyi snyan pa srid 'dir lha'i rnga bo che ltar grags shing / mtshan gyi zegs ma'i cha shas tsam 'gro kun gyi rna bar lhung bas kyang / ngan 'gro'i las kyi dpung bsnyil zhing bde skyid ma lus pa ster bas/ snyigs dus su nges gsang gi rgyal bstan slar yang skyong bar dgongs te/ bsam bzhin du sku skyes gzhon nu'i tshul du byon pa gang gis mdzad pa'i shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa sngon med legs bshad ces bya ba'i shing par ar yas tshul ldan gyis bzhings skabs su dpar byang smon tshig gnas lugs rtogs pa'i nyams myong bskrun byed 'di yang rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me byi lo'am 'dzin byed ces bya ba'i hor zla drug pa chu stod tshes da/8 /za' lhag pa skar ma sa ku'i skabs rnam dkar gang bsags 'bum

'gyur du 'gro ba'i dus chen nyin mtha' legs par spub skabs chu skyes sna tshogs bzhad pa chu mtsho rkang 'thung rab tu rgyas shing sman sna'i myu gus dri ngad sna tshogs lding ba dang / bya tshogs mdzes pa'i skad snyan sna tshogs pas mchog gsum la mchod pa'i rnam 'gyur ngom pa dang / phyi nang gi mthun rkyen legs tshogs ma lus pa 'byung ba'i skabs su khong gi dud tshang gi bya lag yul srol ltar rnam dkar du gtsang dag byas rjes su rgyu rdzas phran tshegs tsam lhag yod pas de lugs ltar yon sbyar byas te/ nyid kyis bskul ba ltar ngag dbang yon tan bzang po ste/ blo bzang chos 'phel bas gtsang chen 'du khang pho brang dmar lding ma'i nang du dge 'dun pa brgya phrag gcig dang lnga bcu tsam gyis phur pa'i sgrub chen 'don zhor du bris pa de la sbyin bdag gi ming tsam bsgyur cing rje btsun bla ma'i thugs dgongs ltar gus phran bdag gis zhus dag dang dpar sgrun byas pa lags na tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / dge legs 'phel/ sarba man lam/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /gzhan gyi mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa/ /gser gyi lhun po lta bur mdzes pa'i sku/ /shākya'i rgyal po khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos 'khor gsum gyi dgongs pa ji bzhin mkhyen/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi de nyid thugs su chud/ /'gro ba kun la ma nor lam ston pa/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /rab rgyas phan bde 'byung gnas rin po che/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gcig sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /khyab bdag ngo bo rje btsun srid zhi'i mgon/ /kun dga' snying po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun 'phrin las 'phags ma'i blo gros gter/ /gsang gsum grags snyan bsdushā la

'gyur du 'gro ba'i dus chen nyin mtha' legs par spub skabs chu skyes sna tshogs bzhad pa chu mtsho rkang 'thung rab tu rgyas shing sman sna'i myu gus dri ngad sna tshogs lding ba dang / bya tshogs mdzes pa'i skad snyan sna tshogs pas mchog gsum la mchod pa'i rnam 'gyur ngom pa dang / phyi nang gi mthun rkyen legs tshogs ma lus pa 'byung ba'i skabs su khong gi dud tshang gi bya lag yul srol ltar rnam dkar du gtsang dag byas rjes su rgyu rdzas phran tshegs tsam lhag yod pas de lugs ltar yon sbyar byas te/ nyid kyis bskul ba ltar ngag dbang yon tan bzang po ste/ blo bzang chos 'phel bas gtsang chen 'du khang pho brang dmar lding ma'i nang du dge 'dun pa brgya phrag gcig dang lnga bcu tsam gyis phur pa'i sgrub chen 'don zhor du bris pa de la sbyin bdag gi ming tsam bsgyur cing rje btsun bla ma'i thugs dgongs ltar gus phran bdag gis zhus dag dang dpar sgrun byas pa lags na tshe rabs kun tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig / dge legs 'phel/ sarba man lam/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs/ /gzhan gyi mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa/ /gser gyi lhun po lta bur mdzes pa'i sku/ /shākya'i rgyal po khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ /chos 'khor gsum gyi dgongs pa ji bzhin mkhyen/ /rgyud sde bzhi yi de nyid thugs su chud/ /'gro ba kun la ma nor lam ston pa/ /kun mkhyen chos kyi rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /rab rgyas phan bde 'byung gnas rin po che/ /'gro ba'i skyabs gcig sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos/ /khyab bdag ngo bo rje btsun srid zhi'i mgon/ /kun dga' snying po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal kun 'phrin las 'phags ma'i blo gros gter/ /gsang gsum grags snyan bsdushā la

sman pa'i zil/ /cher snyigs mongs mun cung tsam gzhil ba'i 'od/ /kun nas nyer 'chang rje la gsol ba 'debs/ /sems kyi gnas lugs don dam bla ma'i thugs/ /chos sku kun khyab yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter/ /'khor 'das gshes bzhugās mdza/ bzang nyer stsol mkhan/ /dmigs med rang gsal skengang nas pa/kā trī sdo /kā dī/sa/ nges don dbu ma'i phul/ /mdo sngags zab gsang gzhan stong dbang gi rgyal/ /'dzin skyong spel ba'i rkang drug gzhon nu yi/ /nor 'dzin dga' tshal ma lus 'gengs gyur cig/par 'di shar 'dzam thang bsam 'thub nor bu'i gling du bzhugs/ /188

mjug byang /thub bstan e waṃ dpe tshogs deb dang po 'di 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i yang rtse ru mkhas grub gnyis ldan mkhyen kong mi pham dge chos sogs kyis bsngags pa kun mkhyen kun dga' snying po'am yongs grags su rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha'i mdzad pa'i shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa khag gsum po 'di gzhan stong ba 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i dgon pa 'bras srungs dang mdo smad 'dzam thang chos grwa chen po'i dpe mdzod khang gi ma dper gzhi byas nas bsgrun pa yin/'di'i nang don gtso bo ston pa'i chos 'khor bar tha 'gal med du bsgrubs shing / dngos shugs kyi bstan bya dbu ma gzhan stong gi rnam bshad dang /sbas don mngon rtogs dngos po brgyad kyi sgos sngon med pa'i legs bshad bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ spros yod pas rang ga'i bstan bcos bye ba las lhag go/ /kha cig kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i chos nyid sgrub pa rang dbang ba sogs 'dod ces yig cha chad chod re drangs te dgag khul byed pa ni/ rje'i 'dod pa ngos ma zin par bston de kho bo cag gi smra tshad de ltar yin zhes pa lta bu khrel bgad kyi gnas so/ /sgrub pa tsam yang khas ma blangs par ma shes shing de 'dra smra ba ni/ rang gi brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhabs 'dren dang / rang gzhan phung la sbyor ba'i rgyu min nam/ rje tā ra nā bas/ rang stong smra bas phyogs kyang ma go na/ /de la dgag pa nam yang byas pa med/ /ces gsungs pa kho nar bstan bcos 'dis kyang shes so/ /nan gyis khas blangs so zer na yi ge ston ciga'akhor lo bar ba'i dgongs 'grel gyis tha ma la gnod byed gtong ba ni ltar snang du sus kyang shes/ dbu sems thun mong ba'i mdo'i khyad par ma phyed pas nongs so/ /tshur mthong rang blor shong tsam gyi sgra rtog mngon sum ༵༵ ba

mjug byang /thub bstan e waṃ dpe tshogs deb dang po 'di 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i yang rtse ru mkhas grub gnyis ldan mkhyen kong mi pham dge chos sogs kyis bsngags pa kun mkhyen kun dga' snying po'am yongs grags su rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha'i mdzad pa'i shes rab snying po'i 'grel pa khag gsum po 'di gzhan stong ba 'jam dbyangs chos rje'i dgon pa 'bras srungs dang mdo smad 'dzam thang chos grwa chen po'i dpe mdzod khang gi ma dper gzhi byas nas bsgrun pa yin/'di'i nang don gtso bo ston pa'i chos 'khor bar tha 'gal med du bsgrubs shing / dngos shugs kyi bstan bya dbu ma gzhan stong gi rnam bshad dang /sbas don mngon rtogs dngos po brgyad kyi sgos sngon med pa'i legs bshad bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ spros yod pas rang ga'i bstan bcos bye ba las lhag go/ /kha cig kun mkhyen jo nang pa'i chos nyid sgrub pa rang dbang ba sogs 'dod ces yig cha chad chod re drangs te dgag khul byed pa ni/ rje'i 'dod pa ngos ma zin par bston de kho bo cag gi smra tshad de ltar yin zhes pa lta bu khrel bgad kyi gnas so/ /sgrub pa tsam yang khas ma blangs par ma shes shing de 'dra smra ba ni/ rang gi brgyud pa'i bla ma'i zhabs 'dren dang / rang gzhan phung la sbyor ba'i rgyu min nam/ rje tā ra nā bas/ rang stong smra bas phyogs kyang ma go na/ /de la dgag pa nam yang byas pa med/ /ces gsungs pa kho nar bstan bcos 'dis kyang shes so/ /nan gyis khas blangs so zer na yi ge ston ciga'akhor lo bar ba'i dgongs 'grel gyis tha ma la gnod byed gtong ba ni ltar snang du sus kyang shes/ dbu sems thun mong ba'i mdo'i khyad par ma phyed pas nongs so/ /tshur mthong rang blor shong tsam gyi sgra rtog mngon sum ༵༵ ba

ci rigs dbang btsan par byas te/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mthar thug nga rang gi 'dod pa 'di kho na yin no zhes kha tshon mi gcod par ris med kyi mdo rgyud kun dpang por ba'ag nas chos la thos bsam byed pa gal che'o/ /sngon byon dam pa rnams kyis pha mas bu'i lo rim ltar gos bzo ba bzhin gdul bya'i dbang gis cung zad mi 'dra ba re dang / phan tshun dgag bzhag re byas yod na'ang don la dgongs pa mthar thug mi 'gal bar sngon byon mkhas grub du mas gsungs/ don la'ang yin dgos te min na bod 'dir bstan pa rnam dag ma dar bar khas len dgos snyam/ spyir 'dzam gling 'dir chos lugs sna tshogs mchis pa'i khrod du rang cag sangs rgyas chos lugs ni ches nyung bas gangs can sgrub brgyud shing rta brgyad kyis bsdus pa'i srun zla rnams lag sbrel byas te/ bshad sgrub las gsum gyi bya ba dang / kun mthun zhig la dmigs 'dun byed dgos par snang ngo / 'di la thos bsam sgom gsum byas na byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od dang ldan te/ rje btsun rang gi rnam thar ma bcos lhug pa las/ /sher snying gi 'grel chen tshar ba'i nyin mo sprin gseb nas stong gzugs kyi rang bzhin rgyal ba mi pham pa la lha rnams kyis mchod pa byed tshul sogs ya mtshan pa'i ltas mang du byung zhes gsungs/ bdag gi 'dren pa gcig chog gi bla ma rje jo nang bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun ngag dbang yon tan dpal bzang pos 'di nyid dpe skrun bya rgyu'i gnang ba bstsal yang lo shas 'gor 'gyangs su lus/ da lan mchog sprul a lags shes rab rdo rjes sbyin bdag dang / rtse chen chos sde'i mchog sprul spos khang pa sgrol bzang phun tshogs kyis grogs bzang po gnang zhing gzhi nas ris med mkhas /me+e /// /ga spyan sngar 'dren thub tsam byung bas bstan 'gror dge legs 190
